instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara onye ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nwere ike iji ghara ịtụkwasị obi ma ọ bụ zere ọrụ nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ nke oge a (orthodox veterinary services) ọbụlagodi mgbe ha dị?
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi nwere ike ghara ịtụkwasị obi na ọrụ ndị nke oge a n'ihi ọkọnọ ọgwụ na-adịghị akwụsi ike, oke ọnụ ahịa ọgwụ anụmanụ, akụrụngwa nkwukọrịta adịghị mma, enweghị ndị ọrụ zuru oke n'ime obodo, na ahụmịhe gara aga banyere ntinye ọnụ na-eweta nsonaazụ ọjọọ. Ụzọ ọdịnala ndị a na-atụkwasị obi, dị ọnụ ala, ma na-adị ngwa n'oge ọ bụla.

instruction: Ụzọ ọdịnala ndị ọzụzụ ehi na-eji amata mmalite nke trypanosomiasis na ehi
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi ọdịnala na-enwe nkà nke ịmata ihe ịrịba ama mmalite nke trypanosomiasis, nke a makwaara dị ka 'tryps,' na ehi tupu nyocha ahụike enwee ike ikwenye nchoputa ahụ. Ha na-eleba anya maka 'staring coat,' nke bụ ọdịdị adịghị mma, na-egbuke egbuke na ajị anụmanụ ahụ, yana anya mmiri ma ọ bụ ịkwa ákwá (lacrimation) karịrị akarị. Ọzọkwa, ha na-ahụ mgbanwe kpọmkwem na ije anụmanụ ahụ, nke nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịrịba ama nke mmetụta nje ahụ nwere na usoro akwara (nervous system) anụmanụ ahụ. Site n'ịhụ mgbanwe ndị a dị nta, ndị ọzụzụ ehi nwere ike ịmata anụmanụ ndị nwere ike ibute ọrịa n'oge ma mee ihe iji gbochie mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: Na njikwa ehi ọdịnala nke ugwu Nigeria, kedu ihe kpatara ndị ọzụzụ ehi ji kpachapụrụ anya zere ịhapụ ehi ha ka ha na-ata nri n'akụkụ osisi ndị na-enye ndò?
response: A na-ezere osisi ndị na-enye ndò n'ihi na ha jikọtara ya na oke ahụhụ (tick infestation). Ahụhụ (Ticks) na-agbakọta na ebe ndị dị jụụ, nwere ndò, na iru mmiri (humid microhabitats), na-eme ka ebe ndị a dị ize ndụ maka ehi.

instruction: Tụnyere ụdị ehi mmiri ara (dairy breeds) nke Nigeria maka pilot azụmahịa
response: A na-ewere Sokoto Gudali ebe nile dị ka ehi mmiri ara kachasị mma na Nigeria, karịsịa maka mkpokọta mmiri ara ọ na-enye na pasentị abụba mmiri ara (milk fat) ya dị elu. A na-ama ụdị a maka imepụta mmiri ara ya dị egwu, nke nwere nkezi nke ihe dị ka lita 3,000-4,000 kwa afọ. Ọzọkwa, ehi Sokoto Gudali nwere pasentị abụba mmiri ara (milk fat) dị elu, na-eme ka ha bụrụ nhọrọ magburu onwe ya maka ndị ọrụ ugbo mmiri ara (dairy farmers) na-achọ imepụta mmiri ara dị mma maka ebumnuche azụmahịa. Ikike ha nwere imeghari na gburugburu ebe obibi dị iche iche na usoro inye nri na-emekwa ka ha bụrụ nhọrọ a ma ama maka ọrụ ugbo mmiri ara na Nigeria.

instruction: Kedu ụdị ọrịa ndị ọrụ ugbo kachasị mma na ndị kasị njọ na ijikwa n'iji ụzọ ọdịnala?
response: Ndị ọrụ ugbo na-akacha mma n'ijikwa ọnọdụ na-adịghị ala ala ma ọ bụ nke obere site n'ụzọ ọdịnala, dị ka ịgwọ afọ ọsịsa, ọnyá, na okpurukpu. Otú ọ dị, ha na-esikarị ike ịlụso ọrịa nje (bacterial diseases) siri ike ọgụ, nke nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịma aka pụrụ iche ijikwa n'iji usoro ọdịnala. Ọnọdụ ndị dị ka Anthrax na Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) bụ ihe atụ nke ọrịa nje siri ike nke nwere ike isiri ike ịchịkwa n'iji ụzọ ọdịnala.

instruction: Kedu otu esi agafe ihe ọmụma ethnoveterinary, gịnịkwa mere nke a ji bụrụ nchegbu?
response: Ihe ọmụma ethnoveterinary na-esikarị na ọdịnala ọnụ (oral tradition), site n'otu ọgbọ gaa na nke ọzọ site na ịkọ akụkọ na ịkọrọ ahụmịhe. Ụzọ ọdịnala a nke ịkekọrịta ihe ọmụma na-enye nsogbu n'ihi na ọ nọ n'ihe ize ndụ nke ịla n'iyi ka ndị na-achị ehi (pastoralists) na-aghọ ndị bi otu ebe ma ọ bụ ka a na-anapụ ha ala ha. Ka obodo na-agbanwe na usoro ndụ ọdịnala na-akwụsị, ihe ọmụma na omume ndị agbakọtara kemgbe ọtụtụ narị afọ nọ n'ihe ize ndụ nke ichefu, na-ahapụ ndị ọrụ ugbo na ndị ọzụzụ ehi n'enweghị nka ha chọrọ iji lekọta ụmụ anụmanụ ha nke ọma.

instruction: Kedu osisi ndị ọzụzụ ehi n'ebe ugwu Nigeria na-akpọ Duma rafi, kedu kwa ihe ha na-eji ya agwọ n'ahụ ehi?
response: Duma rafi bụ aha obodo maka Ipomoea isarifolia, nke a makwaara dị ka Ipomoea repens. A na-eshi ya ma nye ya ehi ka ọ ṅụọ dị ka ọgwụgwọ maka ịba (malaria) na ehi.

instruction: Kedu uru ogbugbo 'Khaya senegalensis' (Mahogany) bara n'ọgwụ ethnoveterinary nke Fulani?
response: Khaya senegalensis, nke a makwaara dị ka Mahogany, ka a na-eji na ọgwụ ethnoveterinary nke Fulani dị ka ihe na-egbu okpurukpu na iji gwọọ ọrịa afọ na ehi. A na-eji ọgwụ ọdịnala a akpọrọ ihe maka ịdị irè ya na idozi nsogbu afọ na eriri afọ na ntiwapụ nje n'ime anụ ụlọ.

instruction: Kedu ihe okwu 'nagana' pụtara na omume ethnoveterinary nke Africa?
response: Nagana bụ aha sitere na Zulu maka trypanosomiasis na anụmanụ ụlọ, nke nje tsetse-fly-transmitted trypanosomes na-ebute. Ọ na-ebute anaemia, ọnwụ ibu, na ọnwụ na ehi. Ọ dị iche na ọrịa ihi ụra (sleeping sickness), nke bụ ụdị na-emetụta mmadụ.

instruction: N'ọdịnala ọzụzụ anụ ụlọ n'Africa, kedu ihe dị na ụfọdụ osisi kpatara ahụhụ (ticks) iji dapụ n'ahụ ehi ma anụmanụ ahụ richaa ha?
response: Ihe nnu dị elu n'ime osisi ahụ kpatara ahụhụ iji dapụ. Ndị ọzụzụ ehi na-enye ụmụ anụmanụ nri nwere osisi jupụtara na nnu dị ka ụzọ ọdịnala iji gbuo ahụhụ (indigenous acaricide method).

instruction: Nkezi afọ mgbe ha mụrụ nwa nke mbụ na mmepụta mmiri ara maka ehi Bunaji na Guinea Savanna
response: Maka ehi Bunaji na usoro njikwa ọdịnala nke Guinea Savanna, nkezi afọ mgbe ha mụrụ nwa nke mbụ dị ihe dị ka ọnwa 42-45. N'ihe gbasara mmepụta mmiri ara, ehi ndị a nwere ike ịmịpụta ihe dị ka 2300kg nke mmiri ara n'otu oge ha na-enye mmiri ara (lactation), nke bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ a ma ama na-atụle ọnọdụ siri ike nke mpaghara Guinea Savanna.

instruction: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi ọdịnala na Nigeria ghọtara usoro abụọ maka ịgwọ ọrịa ehi. Otu metụtara ọgwụ ọgwụ (herbalism). Kedu ihe bụ nke ọzọ, kedu kwa otu esi eme ya?
response: Usoro nke ọzọ bụ ọgwụgwọ Anwansi-Okpukpe (Magic-Religious healing), nke a na-eme site n'ịgụ amaokwu sitere na Koran n'elu anụmanụ ndị na-arịa ọrịa. Mgbe ụfọdụ a na-edekwa amaokwu Koran na-ekechi ha na ọtụmọkpọ (amulets) nke ụmụ anụmanụ na-eyi.

instruction: Na omume ethnoveterinary nke Hausa, kedu ihe ọ pụtara mgbe onye ọzụzụ ehi kwuru na anụmanụ chọrọ ka ewepụ ya n'ọbara e mebiri emebi ('spoiled blood')?
response: Ọ na-ezo aka na nkwenkwe ọdịnala na ọrịa na-agbakọta dị ka ọbara ọjọọ ma ọ bụ e mebiri emebi n'ahụ. Ọgwụgwọ ya bụ ịchalị (scarification) — igbubi akpụkpọ ahụ — na ịhapụ ọbara iji wepụ ọbara e mebiri emebi, nke a na-ejikọtakarị ya na iji efere uhie na-ekpo ọkụ gbaa ebe ọnyá ahụ ọkụ.

instruction: Kedu nzube nke ịkpọ ọkụ n'ọnụ ụzọ nke ebe a na-edebe ehi n'ụtụtụ na omume ịzụ ehi nke ugwu Nigeria?
response: Ụmụ nwanyị na ụmụaka na-achịkọta ahụhụ n'ahụ ụmụ anụmanụ tupu ìgwè ehi ahụ ahapụ ebe a na-edebe ha wee tụba ha n'ọkụ na-enwu nso n'ọnụ ụzọ. Nke a bụ emume mwepụ na mbibi ahụhụ kwa ụbọchị, ọ bụghị naanị maka ikpo ọkụ.

instruction: Ọgwụgwọ ọdịnala maka 'foot rot' (ere ụkwụ) na-agụnyekarị iji gịnị?
response: Ntụ osisi na-ekpo ọkụ (hot wood ash), copper sulphate, ma ọ bụ poultices dị iche iche nke mkpalaakwụkwọ bụ ọgwụgwọ ọdịnala maka ere ụkwụ. A na-etinyekarị ntụ osisi na-ekpo ọkụ kpọmkwem n'ebe ahụ metụtara iji nyere aka wepụ ọrịa ahụ, ebe enwere ike iji copper sulphate mee ka ọnyá ahụ dị ọcha. Enwekwara ike itinye poultices mkpalaakwụkwọ, emere site na osisi dị ka neem ma ọ bụ turmeric, n'ebe metụtara iji kwalite ọgwụgwọ ma belata mbufụt (inflammation).

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ Taura na ọnọdụ ịzụ ehi nke ugwu Nigeria, kedu kwa ọnọdụ ọ na-agwọ?
response: Taura bụ aha obodo maka Delarium senegalense, osisi a na-eshi ma nye ehi ka ha ṅụọ iji gwọọ afọ ọsịsa.

instruction: Onye ọzụzụ ehi na-ahọrọ oke ehi (bull) ọ ga-eji maka ọmụmụ dabere n'akụkọ ahụike nke anụmanụ ahụ karịa ịdị arọ ma ọ bụ ọdịdị. Kedu ụkpụrụ ụmụ amaala (indigenous principle) ka nke a na-egosipụta?
response: Nke a na-egosipụta omume ụmụ amaala nke nhọrọ ọmụmụ dabeere n'ọrịa (disease-based breeding selection) — ịhọrọ ụmụ anụmanụ maka ọmụmụ dabere n'iguzogide ọrịa na ụmụ ahụhụ ha gosipụtara, nke bụ ụdị nhọrọ mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa ọdịnala (traditional genetic selection) maka iguzogide ọrịa.

instruction: Ọgwụ ọdịnala maka ọnyá Foot and Mouth Disease (Tutan Baki) na Nigeria
response: Maka Foot and Mouth Disease, ọgwụ ọdịnala ejiri mee force na Nigeria na-agụnye itinye potash na-ekpo ọkụ ma ọ bụ ntụ osisi kpọmkwem na ụkwụ emetụtara. A na-ejikarị ọgwụgwọ a eme ihe iji nyere aka jikwaa ọnyá metụtara Tutan Baki, mana ọ dị mkpa iburu n'uche na ọgwụgwọ a nwere ike ọ gaghị agwọ isi kpatara ọrịa ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-enyo enyo na anụ ụlọ gị nwere Foot and Mouth Disease, ọ dị mkpa ịchọrọ ndụmọdụ n'aka onye ọrụ ahụike anụmanụ nke ime obodo maka nchoputa ziri ezi na ọgwụgwọ. Ha nwere ike inye nduzi maka usoro kachasị mma iji hụ na ahụike na ọdịmma nke ụmụ anụmanụ gị.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'Tutan Wuta' na Hausa, kedu kwa otu esi agwọ ya na ọdịnala?
response: Na Hausa, 'Tutan Wuta' na-ezo aka na Anthrax, ọrịa nje siri ike nke na-emetụta anụ ụlọ. Ndị na-agwọ ọrịa ọdịnala na-adụkarị ọdụ maka usoro akụkụ abụọ: nke mbụ, ha na-atụ aro ili anụmanụ bu ọrịa ahụ iji gbochie mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ, nke abụọ, ha na-atụ aro ịṅụ aṅụrụ ọkụ ('smoking') na mpaghara e liri anụmanụ ahụ iji nyere aka mee ka ala ahụ dị ọcha ma gbochie mmetọ. Usoro ọdịnala a nwere ike ọ gaghị adị irè dị ka ọgwụgwọ anụmanụ nke oge a, mana ọ nwere ike inye aka belata ihe ize ndụ nke ọrịa ọzọ na ime ka mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ dị nwayọọ.

instruction: Kedu uru ogbugbo 'Parkia biglobosa' (Locust bean) bara na njikwa anụ ụlọ nke ime obodo?
response: A na-eji decoction nke ogbugbo Parkia biglobosa agwọ ọrịa anụ ahụ na ịsa ọnyá na njikwa anụ ụlọ nke ime obodo. Ọ bụ ọgwụ ọdịnala ejirila mee ihe ruo ọtụtụ narị afọ iji kwalite ọgwụgwọ na igbochi ọrịa n'ọnyá. Njirimara mgbochi nje (antimicrobial properties) nke ogbugbo ahụ na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ọgwụgwọ dị irè maka ọnọdụ akpụkpọ ahụ, a na-ejikwa ya na ọgwụgwọ okike ndị ọzọ iji kwalite ahụike na ọdịmma n'ozuzu na ụmụ anụmanụ.

instruction: Ọgwụgwọ ọzịzà agwọ (snakebites) n'iji Securidaca longepedunculata
response: Maka ịgwọ ọzịzà agwọ, ndị na-achị ehi na-eji osisi Securidaca longepedunculata site n'itinye mgbọrọgwụ emere ka ọ bụrụ ntụ ntụ kpọmkwem n'ebe emetụtara. Ọzọkwa, a na-aṅụ mgbọrọgwụ ntụ ntụ ahụ n'ọnụ iji nyere aka ịlụso nsi (venom) ọgụ. A na-ejikarị ọgwụ ọdịnala a eme force na ime obodo ebe ụlọ ọrụ ahụike nwere ike dị ụkọ.

instruction: Ịmata ọgwụ nkwụnwụ (local anesthetics) na usoro ọdịnala nke Nigeria
response: N'usoro ọdịnala nke Nigeria, a na-eji mmịpụta sitere na 'Datura stramonium', nke a makwaara dị ka jimsonweed, dị ka ọgwụ nkwụnwụ (local anesthetic) ma ọ bụ ọgwụ na-eme ka ahụ jụrụ oyi (sedative). Otú ọ dị, ọ dị oke mkpa iburu n'uche na iji mmịpụta osisi mee ihe maka nzube ahụike nwere ike ịdị ize ndụ ma ọ bụrụ na ejighị ya nke ọma, yana ịdị irè na nchekwa ha nwere ike ịdị iche. Tupu ijikwa mmịpụta osisi ọ bụla, jide n'aka na ị ghọtara ihe egwu ndị nwere ike ime ma jụọ onye ọkachamara ahụike ma ọ bụ onye ọkachamara mpaghara n'ịgwọ ọrịa ọdịnala.

instruction: Kedu ihe a na-eji 'Gishiri' eme na ọgwụgwọ ịgba nnu (salt-loading therapy) nke ọdịnala?
response: A na-eji Gishiri eme ihe na ọgwụgwọ ịgba nnu nke ọdịnala iji gwọọ adịghị ike n'ozuzu ya na imeziwanye mmịpụta mmiri ara n'ahụ ehi. Ọ bụ omume na-ahụkarị na ụfọdụ obodo ndị na-arụ ọrụ ugbo na Nigeria, ebe a kwenyere na Gishiri nwere njirimara mweghachi nke na-enyere aka ịkwalite ahụike n'ozuzu ya na mmepụta nke ehi mmiri ara.

instruction: Kedu usoro ọdịnala a na-eji achịkwa ijiji n'ogige ehi (cattle kraal)?
response: Ọkụ anwụrụ ọkụ (Smudge fires) iji akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ na nsị anụmanụ, nke a makwaara dị ka 'smoking', bụ usoro ọdịnala a na-eji achịkwa ijiji n'ogige ehi. Nke a na-agụnye ịkpọ ngwakọta nke akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ na nsị anụmanụ ka o mepụta ikuku anwụrụ ọkụ nke na-enyere aka ịchụ na igbu ijiji. A kwenyere na anwụrụ ọkụ na-esi na smudge fire nwere njirimara igbu ụmụ ahụhụ (insecticidal properties) nke na-enyere aka ịchịkwa ọnụ ọgụgụ ijiji ma belata ihe ize ndụ nke mgbasa ọrịa na ehi.

instruction: Kedu otu esi eji 'Vitex doniana' eme ihe n'ịgwọ bovine trypanosomiasis na ọdịnala?
response: Decoction nke ogbugbo 'Vitex doniana' ka a na-aṅụ n'ọnụ na ọdịnala iji lụso ahụ ọkụ na anaemia ọgụ n'ahụ ehi metụtara bovine trypanosomiasis.

instruction: Kedu osisi ndị Fulani na-eji eme ka ehi wepụta akpa nwa ngwa ngwa (placental expulsion)?
response: Ndị Fulani na-ejikarị mmịpụta sitere n'ogbugbo nke 'Guiera senegalensis', osisi sitere na West Africa, iji mee ka ehi wepụta akpa nwa. Omume a gbanyere mkpọrọgwụ n'ihe ọmụma ọdịnala ha banyere osisi ọgwụ na iji ha eme ihe n'ịzụ anụ ụlọ.

instruction: Kedu uru 'Calotropis procera' (Tumfafiya) bara n'ịgwọ ọrịa ara (mastitis) n'ime obodo?
response: A na-eji mmiri ara osisi sitere na Calotropis procera, nke a makwaara dị ka Tumfafiya, ete kpọmkwem na nlezianya n'ebe ahụ metụtara, ma ọ bụ a na-eji akwụkwọ ya mee poultice iji nyere aka gwọọ mastitis. A na-eji ọgwụ ọdịnala a eme ihe n'ime obodo, e kwenyere na mmiri ara osisi ahụ ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ya nwere njirimara na-ebelata mbufụt (anti-inflammatory properties) nke na-enyere aka ibelata ọzịza na ịkwalite ọgwụgwọ.

instruction: Ọgwụgwọ ọdịnala nke afọ mbịkọ (Haba) na ehi
response: Ndị na-agwọ ọrịa ọdịnala na-agwọkarị afọ mbịkọ (bloat), nke a makwaara dị ka Haba, na ehi site n'inye ngwakọta nke jinta a kwọrọ akwọ (ground ginger) na potash gwara mmiri. Ọgwụgwọ a bụ ihe a na-ejikarị eme ihe n'ime obodo ebe ohere ịnweta nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ nke oge a nwere ike dị ụkọ. Ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ na usoro nkwadebe ziri ezi nwere ike ịdị iche dabere na ahụmịhe onye na-agwọ ọrịa na omume obodo ahụ, mana otu ụkpụrụ ahụ ka dị. Ọ dị mkpa iburu n'uche na ọ bụ ezie na ọgwụgwọ a nwere ike inye ahụ efe, ọ bụghị ihe nnọchi anya nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ kwesịrị ekwesị. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-enwe nsogbu banyere afọ mbịkọ na ehi gị, ọ kacha mma ịjụ dọkịta anụmanụ nwere ikike maka nchoputa ziri ezi na ọgwụgwọ.

instruction: Kedu uru 'Zanthoxylum zanthoxyloides' (Fagara) bara na nlekọta anụ ụlọ nke ọdịnala?
response: A na-eji Zanthoxylum zanthoxyloides, nke a na-akpọkarị Fagara, eme ihe na nlekọta anụ ụlọ nke ọdịnala maka ike igbu nje ya (antiseptic properties). A na-ejikarị ya agwọ ọnyá butere ọrịa n'ahụ anụmanụ, na-enyere aka igbochi nsogbu ọzọ na ịkwalite ọgwụgwọ. Njirimara egbu nje nke Fagara na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ọgwụgwọ okike dị oke ọnụ ahịa na nlekọta ụmụ anụmanụ, ọkachasị na mpaghara ebe nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ nke oge a nwere ike ịdị ụkọ.

instruction: Kedu ihe a na-eji 'Kanwa' eme n'oge ọkọchị na omume ethnoveterinary?
response: Na omume ethnoveterinary, a na-eji 'Kanwa' eme ihe iji kpalie agụụ nri na inye mineral, karịsịa Potash, nke dị mkpa n'oge ọkọchị mgbe anụmanụ nwere ike ịdọgbu onwe ha n'ọrụ ịchọta ezigbo nri na-edozi ahụ.

instruction: Kedu mmịpụta osisi a na-ejikarị agwọ ụdị ọrịa akpụkpọ anụ (Kyasbi) n'ewu ndị Nigeria?
response: A na-ejikarị mkpụrụ 'Annona squamosa' (Sugar apple) a kwọrọ akwọ gwara mmanụ agwọ ọrịa akpụkpọ anụ (mange) n'ewu ndị Nigeria.

instruction: Kedu uru 'Azadirachta indica' (Neem) bara n'ịchịkwa ahụhụ (tick) n'obodo?
response: Akwụkwọ nke Azadirachta indica, nke a na-akpọkarị Neem, nwere nnukwu uru n'ịchịkwa ahụhụ n'obodo. A na-eshi akwụkwọ ya ma jiri mmiri ya (decoction) tee kpọmkwem n'ahụ dị ka acaricide, na-enyere aka nke ọma ijikwa mmụba ahụhụ (tick infestations) ma belata ihe ize ndụ nke ọrịa ahụhụ na-ebute na mpaghara gị.

instruction: Kedu otu esi eji 'Aloe vera' (Sabbara) eme ihe na njikwa ọkụkọ ime obodo na Nigeria?
response: A na-eji Aloe vera, nke a makwaara dị ka Sabbara, eme ihe na njikwa ọkụkọ ime obodo na Nigeria site n'ịgbakwunye ya na mmiri ọṅụṅụ nke nnụnụ gị. Nke a na-enyere aka igbochi ọrịa Newcastle (Newcastle disease) na ịkwalite ọgụ ahụ ha (immunity), na-eme ka ìgwè ọkụkọ gị nwee ahụike na ume.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'Bakin Kibiya' n'ihe gbasara ịmata ọrịa ọdịnala?
response: Bakin Kibiya na-ezo aka na Blackquarter, ọrịa a na-amata site na ọzịza na-adakpọ adakpọ n'ubu (crepitant swelling). A na-eji okwu ọdịnala a eme ihe n'omume ọgwụgwọ anụmanụ nke ime obodo iji kọwaa ọnọdụ na-emetụta ehi, nke ejiri afụ jupụtara na gas na-etolite n'okpuru akpụkpọ ahụ, na-eduga na ọzịza na ahụ erughị ala mara.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa anụ ụlọ a na-ahụkarị nke ndị agropastoralist na Oyo State na-achọ ọgwụgwọ dabeere na osisi?
response: Ikpuru afọ (Gastrointestinal worms ma ọ bụ helminths) bụ ọrịa anụ ụlọ a na-ahụkarị nke ndị agropastoralist na Oyo State na-achọ ọgwụgwọ dabeere na osisi maka ya. Ikpuru ndị a nwere ike ibute oke ọnwụ ibu, mbelata ọmụmụ, na ọbụna ọnwụ n'ọnọdụ ndị siri ike. Ndị agropastoralist na Oyo State na-agakarị na ọgwụgwọ dabeere na osisi dị ka tannins sitere n'akwụkwọ ụfọdụ osisi, saponins sitere na soapbark, ma ọ bụ njirimara anthelmintic nke ụfọdụ mkpalaakwụkwọ mpaghara iji chịkwaa mmụba ikpuru afọ na anụmanụ ha. Otú ọ dị, ọ dị mkpa iburu n'uche na ọ bụ ezie na ọgwụgwọ dabeere na osisi nwere ike ịdị irè, ha nwere ike ọ gaghị adị ike dị ka synthetic anthelmintics, na ịdị irè ha nwere ike ịdị iche dabere na ụdị ikpuru akọwapụtara yana ịdị njọ nke mmụba ahụ.

instruction: Kedu otu esi eji anụ mkpụrụ 'Adansonia digitata' (Baobab) eme ihe na ọdịnala maka ụmụ ehi?
response: N'ọdịnala, a na-agwa anụ mkpụrụ Baobab (fruit pulp) na mmiri iji gwọọ afọ ọsịsa na afọ ọbara (dysentery) n'ụmụ ehi. Ọgwụgwọ okike a na-ejikarị eme ihe n'ime obodo ebe ohere ịnweta nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ nke oge a nwere ike ịdị ụkọ, ọ bụkwa ihe akaebe maka ịdị iche iche na uru ọgwụgwọ nke ụdị osisi a dị ịtụnanya.

instruction: Kedu ụdị ehi Zebu nke ụmụ amaala Nigeria nke e debere na sayensị na o nwere ikike iguzogide ọrịa kachasị elu
response: A maara ụdị White Fulani nke ọma maka iguzogide ọrịa dị ịrịba ama, karịsịa megide trypanosomiasis na ọrịa ndị ọzọ ahụhụ (tick-borne illnesses) na-ebute. Ọmụmụ sayensị egosipụtala na-aga n'ihu na ụdị a nwere ọkwa nkwụsi ike dị elu ma e jiri ya tụnyere ụdị ehi Zebu nke Nigeria ndị ọzọ. Nke a bụ n'ihi ọdịdị mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa ya pụrụ iche na mmegharị ya na gburugburu ebe okpomọkụ siri ike nke ugwu Nigeria. N'ihi ya, White Fulani aghọwo nhọrọ a ma ama n'etiti ndị ọrụ ugbo Nigeria na-achọ imeziwanye ahụike na mmepụta nke ìgwè ehi ha.

instruction: Usoro nzaghachi mbụ nke ndị na-achị ehi Fulani maka ụmụ anụmanụ na-arịa ọrịa
response: Ndị na-achị ehi Fulani na-agbasokarị usoro ọdịnala mgbe ha na-emeso anụmanụ na-arịa ọrịa. Ha na-ahọrọ iji omume ethnoveterinary na mbụ, na-adabere na ihe ọmụma ha banyere osisi na ọgwụgwọ mpaghara iji gwọọ ụmụ anụmanụ ha. Usoro a na-abụkarị nke na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na-enye ha ohere ijikwa nsogbu ahụike ndị a na-ahụkarị na-enweghị mkpa ntinye ọnụ nke dọkịta anụmanụ n'èzí. Otú ọ dị, ọ bụrụ na usoro ọdịnala anaghị eweta nsonaazụ, ha nwere ike ịchọ enyemaka dọkịta anụmanụ n'oge ahụ, na-akọwapụta mkpa nke ngwakọta nke usoro ọdịnala na nke oge a n'ime nlekọta ahụike ụmụ anụmanụ.

instruction: Gịnị ka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na-eji ogbugbo osisi Baheda (Terminalia bellirica) agwọ?
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na-eji ogbugbo osisi Baheda, nke na-esite na osisi Terminalia bellirica, iji gwọọ ọzịzà agwọ na anụ ụlọ ha. A na-ejikarị ọgwụ ọdịnala a na nchikota ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ iji nyere aka ijikwa mgbaàmà ahụ na igbochi nsogbu ndị na-esi na nsi agwọ (snake venom) pụta.

instruction: Kedu osisi a na-eji na ọdịnala dị ka anthelmintic (ihe na-egbu ikpuru) na ugwu Nigeria?
response: Na ugwu Nigeria, Terminalia avicennioides, karịsịa ogbugbo ya, ka a na-eji na ọdịnala dị ka anthelmintic, ma ọ bụ dewormer, n'akụkụ Khaya senegalensis. Ejirila osisi ndị a mee ihe ruo ọtụtụ narị afọ iji nyere aka ịchịkwa ikpuru dị n'ime anụ ụlọ, na ojiji ha na-anọgide na-abụ akụkụ bara uru nke omume ọgwụgwọ anụmanụ ọdịnala n'ógbè ahụ.

instruction: Maka kedu ọnọdụ ka a na-eji 'ịhapụ ọbara' (blood-letting) nke ọdịnala eme ihe mgbe ụfọdụ?
response: Ọzịza n'ozuzu ya ma ọ bụ enyo enyo nke 'oke ọbara' (excess blood ma ọ bụ plethora) n'ụfọdụ nkwenkwe nke ụmụ amaala.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ afọ a na-ahụkarị mgbe a mụrụ nwa mbụ (AFC) maka nwa ehi nwanyị (heifers) nke White Fulani n'okpuru njikwa ọzụzụ ọdịnala?
response: Nkezi afọ mgbe a mụrụ nwa mbụ (AFC) maka ụmụ ehi nwanyị nke White Fulani n'okpuru njikwa ọzụzụ anụ ụlọ ọdịnala dị n'agbata afọ 4 ruo 5. Ihe ndị dị ka nri na-edozi ahụ, mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa, na ahụike n'ozuzu nke ụmụ ehi nwanyị na-emetụta oge afọ a. N'ọnọdụ ọzụzụ ọdịnala, ebe ohere inweta nri dị mma na nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ nwere ike ịdị oke, ụmụ ehi nwanyị nwere ike iwe ogologo oge iji tozuo ma rute n'oge ọmụmụ ha. N'ihi ya, AFC nke afọ 4 ruo 5 na-atụle dị ka ihe jikọtara ọnụ maka ụmụ ehi nwanyị White Fulani n'okpuru ọnọdụ ndị a.

instruction: Na mgbanwe ọdịnala 'Cattle-for-Manure' (Ehi-Maka-Nri-Ala), kedu ihe onye ọrụ ugbo na-enye onye ọzụzụ ehi?
response: Na mgbanwe ọdịnala 'Cattle-for-Manure', onye ọrụ ugbo na-enyekarị onye ọzụzụ ehi ọka, ego, ma ọ bụ ikike ịta nri n'ihe fọdụrụ n'ihe ubi (crop residues). Mgbanwe a bụ ndokwa bara uru na ibe ya ebe onye ọrụ ugbo na-enweta nri ala (manure) maka fatịlaịza, ma onye ọzụzụ ehi na-enweta nri na ebe nri maka ehi ha.

instruction: Ụzọ ndị ọzọ eji egbu ikpuru ehi mgbe ivermectin adịghị
response: Mgbe ivermectin adịghị, ihe ọdịnala a na-eji achịkwa ikpuru ehi bụ iji mmiri (decoctions) sitere n'ogbugbo na akwụkwọ nke ụdị osisi ụfọdụ. A na-ejikarị ụdị Acacia na Terminalia eme ihe maka ebumnuche a. Enwere ike ime decoctions ndị a site na ishi ogbugbo na akwụkwọ osisi ahụ n'ime mmiri iji mepụta ọgwụgwọ okike nwere ike inye aka chịkwaa nje ndị dị n'ime na ehi. Otú ọ dị, ọ dị mkpa iburu n'obi na ịdị irè nke decoctions ndị a nwere ike ịdị iche, a ga-ejikwa ya na ezigbo usoro njikwa anụmanụ, dịka inye ọgwụ ikpuru mgbe niile, idozi gburugburu ebe obibi, na ịgbanwe ebe ịta nri.

instruction: Ihe ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na Niger State na-eji eme maka ọgwụgwọ Mastitis
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na Niger State na-ejikarị paste e ji akwụkwọ Yangyang mee iji gwọọ mastitis (ọrịa ara) n'ehi ha. Ọgwụgwọ ọdịnala a bụ omume a na-ejikarị eme n'ógbè ahụ, ma a kwenyere na akwụkwọ Yangyang nwere njirimara na-ebelata mbufụt nke na-enyere aka iweghachi ọnọdụ akpa ara ahụ emetụtara wee belata ihe mgbu. Otú ọ dị, ọ dị mkpa iburu n'uche na ọ bụ ezie na paste a nwere ike inye ahụ efe, ọ bụghị ihe nnọchi anya nlekọta ahụike dọkịta kwesịrị ekwesị. Ọ bụrụ na ị chere na mastitis dị n'ìgwè ehi gị, ọ dị mkpa ịkpọtụrụ dọkịta anụmanụ mpaghara maka nchoputa na ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị. Ha nwere ike ịkwado usoro kachasị mma ma nye nduzi otu esi ejikwa ọnọdụ ahụ n'ụzọ dị irè.

instruction: Ịmata ụdị ehi ụmụ amaala Nigeria
response: Ụdị ụmụ amaala Nigeria ahapụtara dị ka West African Dwarf (WAD) shorthorn taurine bụ ụdị Muturu. Ụdị a na-adaba n'ọnọdụ ihu igwe obodo ma a na-ejikarị ya maka mmiri ara ehi na mmepụta anụ n'ọrụ ugbo pere mpe.

instruction: Kedu ihe ọdịnala bụ 'konta,' kedu kwa ihe a na-eji ya eme?
response: Konta bụ ihe ọdịnala a maara dị ka soda/potash ncha, nke a na-ejikarị eme ihe dị ka ihe na-egbu nje na ihe na-ehicha ọnyá. Ọ bụ ọgwụgwọ bara uru ma dị irè maka ebumnuche dị iche iche, ọkachasị n'ime obodo ebe ụlọ ọrụ ahụike nke oge a nwere ike ịdị oke.

instruction: Kedu ụdị osisi ole ndị Fulani na-akwagharị akwagharị na ndịda Adamawa na-eji eme ihe maka anụ ụlọ?
response: Ndị Fulani na-akwagharị akwagharị (nomadic Fulani) na ndịda Adamawa bụ ndị a maara na ha na-eji ụdị osisi dị iche iche eme ihe maka anụ ụlọ ha. Nnyocha achọpụtala ngụkọta nke ụdị osisi 51 obodo ndị a na-eji eme ihe maka ebumnuche dị iche iche, gụnyere ahịhịa nri (fodder), nri (browse), na osisi ọgwụ. Ụdị osisi ndị a na-ekere òkè dị mkpa na ịkwado ahụike na nrụpụta nke anụ ụlọ ha, na-ekwe ka ndị Fulani nọgide na-enwe ndụ ịkwagharị ọdịnala ha n'ógbè ahụ.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ Kanwa na kedu ihe bụ uru ya?
response: Kanwa bụ ụdị potash ma ọ bụ evaporite, nke bụ ihe na-eme n'okike jupụtara na mineral. O nwere ọtụtụ ojiji, ọkachasị na ntụziaka maka njikwa ọrịa n'ahụ anụ ụlọ, yana mgbakwunye mineral n'oge ọkọchị iji kwado ahụike na ọdịmma nke ụmụ anụmanụ gị.

instruction: Kedu ihe abụọ na-abụghị osisi (non-plant ingredients) dị mkpa na ntụziaka ethnoveterinary nke Adamawa State?
response: N'ime Adamawa State, ihe abụọ dị mkpa na-abụghị osisi a na-eji na ntụziaka ethnoveterinary bụ mmiri ara ehi, nke a makwaara dị ka Madara ma ọ bụ Nunu, na Potash, nke a makwaara dị ka Kanwa. A na-eji ihe ndị a n'ọdịnala gwọọ nsogbu ahụike anụmanụ dị iche iche.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'Kanwa', kedu ihe mere ndị na-azụ ehi ji enyekarị ya ehi ha?
response: Kanwa bụ nnu okike ma ọ bụ natron a na-eji dị ka mgbakwunye mineral iji nye sodium na obere ihe ndị ọzọ dị mkpa (trace elements). N'ọdịnala, ndị na-azụ ehi na-enye ehi ya n'ihi na ọ na-enyere aka iweghachi mineral ndị dị mkpa, karịsịa sodium, nke na-adịghịkarị na nri anụmanụ na-ata ahịhịa n'akụkụ ụfọdụ. Mgbakwunye a dị ezigbo mkpa maka idowe ahụike na ọdịmma nke ehi ahụ n'ozuzu ya, na ojiji ya bụ omume kwụụrụ ọtọ ogologo oge n'ọtụtụ obodo ndị na-azụ anụ ụlọ n'Africa.

instruction: Kedu ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ amaala jikọrọ aka na MCI Santé Animale (Morocco) maka nkesa ọgwụ mgbochi (vaccine)?
response: Ambuvets Konsult jikọrọ aka na MCI Santé Animale maka nkesa ọgwụ mgbochi (vaccine).

instruction: Kedu ụdị ehi ụmụ amaala sitere na Nigeria, kedu kwa ihe e jiri kpọrọ ha ihe ma e wepụ mmepụta anụ?
response: Ụdị ehi ụmụ amaala Nigeria gụnyere Red Bororo, White Fulani, Sokoto Gudali, Muturu, Keteku, na Ndama. E jiri ha kpọrọ ihe maka anụ ehi (beef), mmiri ara ehi, akpụkpọ anụ, dị ka ihe nnọchianya nke ọnọdụ (status symbol), na ike ịdọrọ ihe n'ugbo (traction power) — ọ bụghị naanị maka anụ.

instruction: Na omume ethnoveterinary, gịnị ka a na-eji agwọ 'Kirchi' (Dermatophilosis)?
response: Ngwakọta nke mmanụ injin e jichara mee ihe (spent engine oil) na sọlfọ (sulphur), ma ọ bụ mmịpụta mkpalaakwụkwọ dị ka Allium sativum (garlic) ka a na-eji agwọ 'Kirchi' (Dermatophilosis) na omume ethnoveterinary.

instruction: Kedu pasentị nke ehi Nigeria dị n'aka ndị na-emepụta ọdịnala?
response: Ihe karịrị pasent 90 nke ehi Nigeria dị n'aka ndị na-emepụta ọdịnala, ndị na-adaberekarị n'usoro ọmụmụ ọdịnala na nwere ike ọ gaghị enwe ohere ịnweta nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ ma ọ bụ usoro nri nke oge a. Nke a nwere ike imetụta ahụike na nrụpụta nke ìgwè ehi ha n'ozuzu ya, na-eme ka ọ dị mkpa maka ọrụ mgbatị (extension services) na nkwado ịbịarute ndị na-emepụta ihe ndị a ma nyere ha aka imeziwanye usoro njikwa ha.

instruction: Ịghọta nlele ụmụ (Progeny Testing) na Ịzụ Ehi Ọdịnala
response: Nlele ụmụ (Progeny testing) bụ usoro ọmụmụ a na-eji enyocha ikike mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa nke oke ehi site n'ịtụle mmepụta mmiri ara ehi nke nne ya na ụmụnne ya nwanyị. Ụzọ a na-enyere ndị na-azụ ehi aka ịmata oke ehi nwere àgwà ndị na-achọsi ike, dị ka mmepụta mmiri ara ehi dị elu, wee jiri ha mee ọmụmụ. Site na ịhọrọ oke ehi dabere na arụmọrụ nke ndị ikwu ya, ndị ọrụ ugbo nwere ike ịbawanye ohere nke imepụta ụmụ nwere mmiri ara ehi dị mma na mma n'ozuzu ya. Usoro a bara uru nke ukwuu n'ịzụ ehi ọdịnala, ebe ịnweta nnukwu data na akụrụngwa nwere ike ịdị oke.

instruction: Nkwenkwe ọdịnala Fulani banyere ihe kpatara 'Gira' (Heartwater)
response: Nkwenkwe ọdịnala Fulani bụ na 'Gira' ma ọ bụ Heartwater na-esite na iri ụfọdụ ahịhịa ma ọ bụ 'ifufe ọjọọ', n'agbanyeghị na ọ dị mma iburu n'uche na a na-aghọta njikọ ya na ahụhụ (ticks) n'ọtụtụ ebe ugbu a.

instruction: Ịmata osisi ndị na-egbu egbu n'ahụ ehi Savanna nke ugwu
response: Dichapetalum madagascariense bụ osisi na-egbu egbu a na-ahụ na Savanna nke ugwu nke nwere ike ibute ọnwụ mberede na ehi. Ọ dị mkpa ịmata osisi a ma zere ya n'ebe ị na-ata ahịhịa. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-enyo enyo na ehi gị eriwo Dichapetalum madagascariense, jiri nlezianya nyochaa ha maka ihe ịrịba ama nke nsị, nke nwere ike ịgụnye ịgbọ agbọ, afọ ọsịsa, na obi ịkụ ngwa ngwa. N'ọnọdụ siri ike, ọ nwere ike ibute ọnwụ mberede, yabụ ime ihe ngwa ngwa dị oke mkpa. Dobe ehi gị pụọ n'ebe a maara na Dichapetalum madagascariense na-eto, ma tụlee ịjụ dọkịta anụmanụ obodo maka nduzi na njikwa ahụike ehi na Savanna nke ugwu.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'local fowl' (ọkụkọ obodo)?
response: Ọkụkọ obodo nke na-achọgharị nri (scavenging village chicken), nke na-adabarakarị n'ọrụ ugbo pere mpe n'ógbè gị, bụ ụdị siri ike ma nwee ike ịmegharị ahụ nke nwere ike ịdị ndụ na nri dị iche iche nke irighiri ihe na ọka.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'boka'?
response: Boka bụ onye na-agwọ ọrịa ọdịnala nke na-eji ọgwụ osisi na usoro ethnoveterinary agwọ anụmanụ. Ha na-ejikọkarị ihe ọmụma mpaghara na ahụmịhe bara uru iji mepụta ọgwụgwọ dị irè maka ọrịa dị iche iche nke anụ ụlọ.

instruction: Gịnị ka 'san iya' pụtara n'ihe gbasara ahụike?
response: N'ihe gbasara ahụike, 'san iya' bụ ahịrịokwu Hausa nke pụtara 'A ma m otu esi agwọ ya.' Ọ bụ ndị ọrụ ugbo na-ahọrọ ọgwụgwọ ọdịnala karịa nlekọta anụmanụ na-ejikarị ya, yabụ ọ dị mkpa ịghọta echiche na usoro ha mgbe a na-atụle nsogbu ahụike anụmanụ.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ omume nke 'tutan wuta'?
response: Ịnwụrụ anwụrụ ọkụ (Smoke-fumigating) na ụlọ ehi iji chụpụ ijiji tsetse (tsetse flies) bụ omume nke 'tutan wuta', usoro ọdịnala ndị ọrụ ugbo Nigeria na-eji echebe anụ ụlọ ha pụọ na mbuso agha ijiji tsetse. Nke a na-agụnye ịmepụta gburugburu anwụrụ ọkụ n'ime ụlọ ehi iji gbochie ijiji, nke nwere ike gbasaa ọrịa dị ka trypanosomiasis. Site n'iji 'tutan wuta', ndị ọrụ ugbo nwere ike inye aka belata ihe ize ndụ nke ọrịa ndị ijiji tsetse na-ebute ma kwalite gburugburu ebe dị mma maka ehi ha.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'agbo'?
response: Agbo bụ Yoruba maka mmiri mkpalaakwụkwọ ọdịnala (traditional herbal decoctions) a na-eji agwọ anụ ụlọ. A na-ejikarị ngwakọta osisi na ahịhịa dị n'obodo emepụta ọgwụgwọ ọdịnala ndị a, na a na-ejikarị ha na njikwa anụmanụ nke Nigeria iji dozie nsogbu ahụike dị iche iche n'ahụ anụ ụlọ.

instruction: Nkezi oke mmiri ara na bọta (milk-to-butter ratio) maka usoro ọdịnala
response: N'usoro mmiri ara ehi ọdịnala, nkezi oke mmiri ara na bọta (milk-to-butter ratio) na-abụkarị gburugburu lita 1 nke mmiri ara ehi ruo gram 100 nke bọta. Oke a nwere ike ịdị iche dabere n'ihe ndị dị ka ụdị anụmanụ, mma nri, na usoro nhazi, mana 1:100 bụ ihe nlereanya a na-ekwu maka ya maka obere ọrụ mmiri ara ehi ọdịnala.

instruction: Gịnị bụ ogologo oge a kọrọ maka inye mmiri ara (lactation) maka ehi na usoro ọdịnala Nigeria?
response: N'usoro ọdịnala Nigeria, ogologo oge a kọrọ maka inye mmiri ara (lactation) maka ehi na-abụkarị ihe dịka ụbọchị 280 ruo 300. Ogologo oge a nwere ike ịdị iche dabere n'ihe ndị dị ka ụdị anụmanụ, nri na-edozi ahụ, na ahụike nke ehi ahụ n'ozuzu ya, mana ụbọchị 280 ruo 300 bụ oke a na-ekwukarị maka inye mmiri ara na ehi Nigeria.

instruction: Kedu ụdị ahịhịa ụmụ amaala Nigeria a na-ewere dị ka nke kachasị mkpa maka ịta nri okike (natural grazing)?
response: A na-ewere Andropogon gayanus, nke a na-akpọkarị Gamba grass, ebe nile dị ka ụdị ahịhịa ụmụ amaala Nigeria kachasị mkpa maka ịta nri okike. Ikike ya itolite n'ọnọdụ dị iche iche, site na savannas ruo na ahịhịa, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nri na-adịgide adịgide maka ọtụtụ ndị na-azụ anụ ụlọ n'ógbè ahụ. Ahịhịa Gamba abụghị naanị ebe nri a pụrụ ịdabere na ya maka ehi na anụmanụ ndị ọzọ na-ata ahịhịa kamakwa ọ na-enye ezigbo mkpuchi ala, na-enyere aka igbochi mbuze ala (soil erosion) ma nọgide na-enwe ahụike ala.

instruction: Àgwà imeju na nnukwu Fascioliasis (acute Fascioliasis)
response: N'okwu nke nnukwu Fascioliasis, imeju na-ebutekarị ibu, nwere udidi na-emebi emebi (friable texture). Ị nwekwara ike ịhụ tracts ọbara (haemorrhagic tracts) na ọnụnọ nke flukes yiri akwụkwọ n'ime oghere bile (bile ducts). Flukes ndị a nwere ike ịkpata nnukwu mmebi na anụ ahụ imeju, na-eduga na mgbanwe a hụrụ na ọdịdị. Ọ dị mkpa ịgakwuru dọkịta anụmanụ maka nchoputa na ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị iji gbochie nsogbu ọzọ.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'Bursali' n'ihe gbasara njikwa ehi Fulani ọdịnala?
response: Bursali bụ usoro ọdịnala eji amata anụmanụ a na-eji na njikwa ehi Fulani. Ọ na-agụnye ịbipu ntị (ear-notching) ma ọ bụ itinyere akara n'anụ (branding), nke na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ihe nchọpụta pụrụ iche maka anụmanụ ọ bụla. Omume a na-enyere aka na ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ehi dị iche iche, karịsịa na nnukwu ìgwè ehi, na ọ bụ ngwá ọrụ dị mkpa maka idebe ndekọ ziri ezi (accurate records) ma gbochie ohi anụmanụ.

instruction: Kedu akụkụ osisi nke Neem tree (Azadirachta indica) ka a na-eji eme ihe na ọdịnala agwọ ectoparasites (ụmụ ahụhụ dị n'elu ahụ) na ehi?
response: Enwere ike iji akwụkwọ nke osisi Neem gwọọ ectoparasites na ehi, na-abụkarị dị ka ọgwụ ịsa ma ọ bụ mmiri eshiri eshi (decoction). Dị ka ihe ọzọ, mmanụ mkpụrụ Neem ka a na-ejikwa maka ebumnuche a.

instruction: Kedu otu ndị na-azụ ehi na Nigeria si ajikwa afọ mbịkọ ehi (cattle bloat) na ọdịnala na-ejighị ngwaahịa azụmahịa?
response: Ndị na-azụ ehi na Nigeria anọwo na-ejikwa afọ mbịkọ ehi na ọdịnala na-enweghị ngwaahịa azụmahịa site n'iji usoro okike dị iche iche. Otu ụzọ bụ inye mmịpụta osisi n'ọnụ, nke nwere ike inye aka ibelata ahụ erughị ala na mgbu jikọtara na afọ mbịkọ. Ụzọ ọzọ bụ itinye osisi n'ime afọ anụmanụ (rumen) iji kpalie ịgba asụsụ, ma ọ bụ ịze ezigbo (belching), nke nwere ike inye aka ịtọhapụ gas tọrọ atọ. N'ọnọdụ ụfọdụ, ndị na-azụ ehi nwere ike isoro anụmanụ emetụtara jee ije n'elu ugwu iji nyere aka ịgbanwe gas ma belata afọ mbịkọ. Ọzọkwa, ha nwere ike iji ahụekere ma ọ bụ mmanụ nkwụ (groundnut or palm oil) iji nyere aka tee usoro mgbari nri (digestive system) mmanụ ma mee ka gas pụọ n'ụzọ dị mfe. Usoro ọdịnala ndị a nwere ike ịdị irè na ijikwa afọ mbịkọ ehi, karịsịa ma ọ bụrụ na ejiri ezigbo usoro ịzụ anụmanụ na nri dị mma mee ihe.

instruction: Kedu ka ụdị ọgwụ mgbochi T1sr maka CBPP si dị iche na T1/44?
response: T1sr enweghị nje (virulence) fọdụrụnụ mana ọ na-enye naanị nchebe ọnwa isii, ebe T1/44 na-enye nchebe otu afọ mana nwere mmetụta ndị ọzọ (side effects) karịa.

instruction: Kedu ihe mere ndị ọrụ ugbo n'obodo (communal farmers) ji enwekarị mmetụta n'ọrịa ndị a?
response: Ndị ọrụ ugbo obodo na-adị mfe ibute ọrịa n'ihi na ha na-enwekarị obere ikike imegharị ahụ (adaptive capacity) na akụrụngwa maka ọgwụ mgbochi. Nke a pụtara na ha nwere ike ọ gaghị enwe ụzọ iji tinye ego n'usoro mgbochi ọrịa dị irè, na-eme ka ha nwekwuo ohere ịmalite ọrịa (outbreaks). Ọzọkwa, ndị ọrụ ugbo obodo nwere ike ọ gaghị enwe otu ọkwa nlekọta anụmanụ ma ọ bụ ọkachamara dị ka nnukwu ugbo azụmahịa, na-eme ka adịghị ike ha ka njọ.

instruction: Kedu ọrụ DVPCS metụtara NAFDAC?
response: NAFDAC na-ahụ maka ndebanye aha na nchekwa, ebe DVPCS na-ahụ maka mmanye ahụike ọha na usoro nchịkwa ọrịa.

instruction: Kedu aha ụdị edebanyere aha (registered brand name) nke Pasteurella (Haemorrhagic Septicaemia) cattle vaccine na ngalaba MCI/Ambuvets?
response: Aha njirimara edebanyere aha (registered brand name) nke Pasteurella (Haemorrhagic Septicaemia) cattle vaccine na ngalaba MCI/Ambuvets bụ Bovipast.

instruction: Gịnị bụ nchegbu nchekwa banyere 'ngbanwe mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa' (genetic reassortment) na ọgwụ mgbochi RVF?
response: Enwere nchegbu na ọgwụ mgbochi dị ndụ ewepụrụ ike (live attenuated vaccines) dị ka Clone 13 nwere ike ijikọta ya na ụdị nje ọhịa (virulent field strains), na-eduga na nje dị ike karị. Mgbanwe mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa a nwere nnukwu ihe egwu nchekwa, n'ihi na ọ nwere ike imebi ịdị irè nke ọgwụ mgbochi ma ọbụna duru gaa n'ichepụta ụdị ọrịa ka njọ. Ọ dị mkpa iji nlezianya nyochaa ihe ize ndụ na uru dị n'iji ọgwụ mgbochi dị ndụ ewepụrụ ike, karịsịa n'ebe RVF jupụtara.

instruction: Kedu njikọ aka na-emepụta ọgwụ mgbochi (vaccines) na-eji ụdị nje kpọmkwem (endemic strains) dị na Nigeria?
response: MCI Santé Animale na Ambuvets Konsult bụ njikọ aka na-emepụta ọgwụ mgbochi na-eji ụdị nje kpọmkwem (endemic strains) dị na Nigeria. Njikọ aka ndị a dị oke mkpa n'ịmepụta ọgwụ mgbochi a kwadoro maka ọnọdụ mpaghara yana nje ndị jupụtara na Nigeria, na-ahụ maka ịdị irè na nchekwa nke ọgwụ mgbochi maka anụ ụlọ nke mba ahụ.

instruction: Kedu aha ụdị (brand name) nke ọgwụ mgbochi ọkụkọ na-eguzogide okpomọkụ maka Newcastle Disease n'okpuru ngalaba MCI Santé Animale?
response: Aha njirimara (brand name) nke ọgwụ mgbochi ọkụkọ na-eguzogide okpomọkụ (avian thermostable) maka Newcastle Disease n'okpuru ngalaba MCI Santé Animale bụ Avivax ND-I2.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara AI nwere ike iji tụọ aro ọgwụ mgbochi dị iche iche (heterologous - sheep/goat pox) maka LSD, kedu kwa ihe bụ uru na ọghọm ya (trade-off)?
response: Ha na-ebute mmetụta ndị ọzọ (side effects) dị ntakịrị mana ha anaghị adịkarị irè karịa ụdị nje yiri ya (homologous strains).

instruction: Nkezi afọ mgbe ha mụrụ nwa mbụ maka Ugbo Gọọmentị (NVRI, Vom)
response: Maka Ugbo Gọọmentị (Government Farms) na National Veterinary Research Institute (NVRI) na Vom, a kọrọ na nkezi afọ mgbe a mụrụ nwa nke mbụ dị gburugburu ọnwa 37. Nke a bụ ọkọlọtọ a ma ama maka mmepụta nke ìgwè ehi ha, na o kwesịrị ịma na ihe ndị dị ka ụdị anụmanụ, nri na-edozi ahụ, na ahụike n'ozuzu nwere ike imetụta afọ a na-amụ ehi nke mbụ.

instruction: Kedu ka tylosin si emetụta CBPP?
response: E gosipụtara na Tylosin na-ebelata ihe ịrịba ama ahụike na mgbasa nje bacteria metụtara contagious bovine pleuropneumonia (CBPP), mana ọ dị mwute na ọ naghị eweta ọgwụgwọ zuru oke. Nke a pụtara na ọ bụ ezie na tylosin nwere ike inye aka ibelata ụfọdụ mgbaàmà ma mee ka mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ dị nwayọọ, ọ bụghị ihe ngwọta kwụụrụ onwe ya maka ịgwọ CBPP.

instruction: Nkwenye na ezigbo trypanocide maka onye na-azụ ehi na Nigeria
response: Nnwale ịdị mma nke ọgwụ na-esiri ike na nkà na ụzụ ma na-efu nnukwu ego, na-efukarị ọtụtụ narị dọla US maka otu nlele (sample), nke nwere ike ịbụ nnukwu ihe ịma aka maka onye na-azụ ehi na Nigeria. Nnukwu ọnụ ahịa a nwere ike ịbụ nnukwu ihe mgbochi iji gosi ma trypanocide ọ bụ ezigbo ya, ebe ọtụtụ ndị na-azụ ehi nwere ike ghara inwe ohere ịnweta akụrụngwa ndị dị otú ahụ. N'ihi ya, a pụrụ ịhapụ ha ka ha dabere n'ụzọ ndị ọzọ, dị ka ịlele nkwakọ ngwaahịa (packaging) ma ọ bụ isoro dọkịta anụmanụ mpaghara nwee mkparịta ụka, iji chọpụta na trypanocide bụ ezigbo ya.

instruction: Kedu mmetụta kwa afọ a gbakọrọ maka mfu ozugbo nke FMD n'Africa maka afọ 2011?
response: Mkpokọta mmetụta n'ihi mfu ozugbo (direct losses) na ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ka a na-eme atụmatụ na ọ ga-efu ijeri USD 2.

instruction: Kedu ụdị trypanosome na-ebute ọrịa n'ahụ anụmanụ na-eji anya abụọ (ruminants) nke Nigeria kachasị anabata Berenil — T. vivax ka ọ bụ T. congolense?
response: T. vivax na-anabatakarị Berenil karịa T. congolense. Berenil bụ trypanocide a na-ejikarị agwọ African trypanosomiasis n'ahụ anụmanụ ruminants na Nigeria, na ịdị irè ya dịgasị iche n'etiti ụdị trypanosome dị iche iche. Ọ bụ ezie na enwere ike iji Berenil gwọọ ma T. vivax ma T. congolense, T. vivax na-adịkarị mma ịnabata ọgwụ ahụ, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nhọrọ kachasị amasị maka ọgwụgwọ na mpaghara ebe ụdị a jupụtara.

instruction: Kedu ọgwụ trypanocidal kachasị dị mfe a na-ere na ụlọ ahịa agroveterinary na ahịa mepere emepe na Nigeria, kedu kwa ihe na-arụ ọrụ na ya (active ingredient)?
response: Berenil, nke ihe na-arụ ọrụ ya bụ diminazene aceturate, abụwo trypanocide kachasị ere na ahịa anụ ụlọ Nigeria kemgbe 1955.

instruction: Kedu otu ọkachamara (professional body) bu ụzọ manye NAFDAC ka ọ na-achịkwa ahịa ọgwụ anụmanụ na Nigeria?
response: Nigerian Veterinary Medical Association (NVMA) bụ otu ọkachamara bu ụzọ manye NAFDAC ka ọ na-achịkwa ahịa ọgwụ anụmanụ na Nigeria. Ka ọ na-erule afọ 2011, NVMA jiri ihu ọha chọọ ntinye aka NAFDAC iji gboo nsogbu ahụ.

instruction: Kedu otu esi enyekarị ọgwụ mgbochi IBD (Gumboro) na ugbo ọkụkọ obodo?
response: A na-enyekarị ọgwụ mgbochi IBD (Gumboro) n'ọnụ site na mmiri ọṅụṅụ, ma ọ ka mma ime nke a n'ụtụtụ. A na-ejikarị usoro a na ugbo ọkụkọ obodo n'ihi na ọ dị mfe ma dị irè.

instruction: Kedu ihe achọrọ maka nchekwa (storage requirement) NAFDAC na-amanye maka ọgwụ mgbochi si mba ofesi ebubata?
response: NAFDAC chọrọ ihe akaebe nke ụlọ ọrụ mmiri oyi na-arụ ọrụ (functional cold chain facility) maka ọgwụ mgbochi si mba ofesi ebubata, na-ahụ na a na-echekwa ma na-ebufe ọgwụ mgbochi na okpomọkụ kwesịrị ekwesị iji nọgide na-enwe ike na ịdị irè ha.

instruction: Kedu ihe mere ndị dọkịta anụmanụ ji esi ọnwụ na usoro ịnye ọgwụ Berenil dabeere na ịdị arọ?
response: Ndị dọkịta anụmanụ na-esi ọnwụ n'ịnye ọgwụ dabeere n'ịdị arọ maka Berenil n'ihi na oke ịdị arọ maka ehi dị ukwuu, na-agbasa site na 250 ruo 665 kilogram. Ọ bụrụ na ejiri ọgwụ e debere edebe (fixed dose), ọ ga-etinye ihe ize ndụ nke ịda mba ma ọ bụ nsị (toxicity), nwere ike ịkpata mmebi ụbụrụ ma ọ bụ imeju. Nke a bụ ya mere ndị dọkịta anụmanụ ji ahọrọ ịhazi ọgwụ ka ọ dabara n'ịdị arọ nke anụmanụ n'otu n'otu, na-ahụ na ọgwụgwọ ahụ dị irè ma na-ebelata ihe ize ndụ nke mmetụta ọjọọ.

instruction: Kedu ọgwụ mgbochi (vaccines) nke Ngalaba Ọgwụ Mgbochi Nje (Bacterial Vaccine Division) nke NVRI na-emepụta?
response: Ngalaba Ọgwụ Mgbochi Nje nke NVRI na-emepụta ọtụtụ ọgwụ mgbochi dị mkpa, gụnyere Anthrax, Black Quarter, CBPP, na Haemorrhagic Septicaemia vaccines. Ọgwụ mgbochi ndị a dị mkpa maka ichebe anụ ụlọ pụọ n'ọrịa nje (bacterial diseases) dị iche iche ma bụrụ akụkụ dị mkpa nke ịnọgide na-enwe ahụike na nrụpụta nke ugbo gị.

instruction: Kedu ụlọ ọrụ bụ isi na-emepụta ọgwụ mgbochi anụmanụ na Nigeria, oleekwa ebe ọ dị?
response: National Veterinary Research Institute (NVRI) bụ isi ụlọ ọrụ na-emepụta ọgwụ mgbochi anụmanụ, ọ dị na Vom, Plateau State.

instruction: Kedu otu ọnụnọ nke ụdị dị iche iche (diverse topotypes) na ntiwapụ FMD n'Africa si eme ka ọ dị mkpa iji ọgwụ mgbochi quadrivalent?
response: Ọdịiche dị elu chọrọ ọgwụ mgbochi quadrivalent e mere kpọmkwem maka ụdị mpaghara (dịka, A, O, SAT1, SAT2) iji hụ na nchebe.

instruction: Gịnị bụ kpọmkwem ihe egwu metụtara 'Smithburn' RVF vaccine?
response: Ọgwụ mgbochi Smithburn RVF nwere ike ịlaghachi na ọrịa (virulence), nke pụtara na ọ nwere ike ịlaghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya na-akpata ọrịa. Ọzọkwa, ọ nwere ike ịkpata oke ime ọpụpụ (abortion rates) na anụmanụ dị ime, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nnukwu nchegbu maka ndị na-azụ anụ ụlọ na ndị ọrụ ugbo.

instruction: Kedu ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa nje (viral disease vaccines) ndị ọzọ NVRI Vom na-emepụta ma ewepu PPR na ND?
response: Ewezuga Poultry Pox na Newcastle disease, NVRI Vom na-emepụta ọgwụ mgbochi maka Fowl Pox, Rabies, na Infectious Bursal Disease, nke a makwaara dị ka Gumboro disease, nke na-emetụta ụmụ ọkụkọ ma nwee ike iduga na nnukwu mfu ma ọ bụrụ na a gwọghị ya.

instruction: Kedu aha edebanyere aha nke njikọ ọgwụ mgbochi CBPP na LSD bivalent maka ehi?
response: Aha njirimara edebanyere aha nke njikọ ọgwụ mgbochi CBPP na LSD bivalent maka ehi bụ Bovivax CBPP + LSD.

instruction: Kedu aha edebanyere aha nke ọgwụ mgbochi CBPP dị na Nigeria?
response: Aha njirimara edebanyere aha nke ọgwụ mgbochi CBPP dị na Nigeria bụ Bovivax CBPP.

instruction: Kedu otu AgResults FMD Vaccine Challenge si edozi oghere ahịa?
response: AgResults FMD Vaccine Challenge na-enye ihe mkpali ego (financial incentives) na ngalaba nkeonwe iji mepụta ọgwụ mgbochi quadrivalent dị elu nke a kwadoro maka East Africa, na-emechi oghere ahịa nke ọma na mpaghara a dị mkpa nke ahụike anụmanụ.

instruction: Kedu otu ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani si eji netwọk mmekọrịta (social networks) dị ka ihe enyemaka anụmanụ?
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na-adabere na netwọk mmekọrịta ha, gụnyere ndị ikwu na ndị obodo, dị ka ihe enyemaka anụmanụ bara uru. Ha na-eji netwọk ndị a maka ịkekọrịta ìgwè ehi n'oge ihe mberede ọrịa, na-enye ha ohere ijikọta akụrụngwa ha ma lekọta anụmanụ ibe ha. Ọzọkwa, netwọk mmekọrịta na-eme ka mgbanwe ihe ọmụma mkpokọta gbasara ụmụ ahụhụ na ọrịa na-eme n'ebe dị iche iche dị mfe, na-enyere ndị ọzụzụ ehi aka ịma ihe na-eme ma gbanwee usoro ha dabere na ya. Ọzọkwa, netwọk mmekọrịta na-arụ ọrụ dị ka usoro ịdọ aka ná ntị mbụ nke na-abụghị nke gọọmentị, na-ekwe ka ndị ọzụzụ ehi zaghachi ngwa ngwa n'ihe iyi egwu na-apụta. Ndị ikwu nọ n'ebe ndị ọzọ na-arụkwa ọrụ dị ka ihe nkwụsị maka anụmanụ ndị chụpụrụ achụpụ, na-enye nchebe maka ndị nọ ná mkpa. Ntụkwasị obi a na netwọk mmekọrịta bụ ihe akaebe maka mkpa nke obodo na imekọ ihe ọnụ na ndụ ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani.

instruction: Kedu ụlọ ọrụ gọọmentị na Nigeria na-achịkwa ọgwụ anụmanụ, oleekwa mgbe e kere onye ntụziaka nlekọta anụmanụ (veterinary directorate) ewepụtara iche?
response: NAFDAC (National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control) bụ ụlọ ọrụ gọọmentị na Nigeria na-achịkwa ọgwụ anụmanụ. E kere ngalaba VMAP ya, nke ewepụtara maka ihe gbasara anụmanụ, na 11 Eprel 2013.

instruction: Gịnị bụ ụdị ọgwụ mgbochi Newcastle Disease ndị ọzọ emepụtara na NVRI Vom?
response: Na NVRI Vom, ụdị ọgwụ mgbochi Newcastle Disease ndị ọzọ emepụtara bụ Intraocular, Lasota strain, na Komarov strain.

instruction: Gbakọọ ngụkọta ọnụọgụ nke Berenil maka ehi nwunye White Fulani
response: Iji chọta ngụkọta nke Berenil maka ehi nwunye White Fulani gị, bido buru ụzọ mụbaa ịdị arọ nke ehi na kilogram site na ọnụọgụ a kwadoro nke 3.5 mg/kg. Ehi ahụ dị kilogram 300, ya mere ngụkọta bụ 300 kg * 3.5 mg/kg = 1,050 mg nke diminazene aceturate, nke ruru gram 1.05.

instruction: Kedu ihe na-esi na inye nkwupụta ụgha pụta n'oge ndebanye aha NAFDAC?
response: Inye nkwupụta ụgha (false declarations) n'oge ndebanye aha NAFDAC nwere ike ịkpata nnukwu nsogbu. Ị nwere ike iche ihu n'ebubo mpụ (criminal liability), nke nwere ike ịkpata nra (fines) na ọbụna ịga mkpọrọ. Ọzọkwa, enwere ike ịkagbu ndebanye aha ụlọ ọrụ gị, na-eme ka arụmọrụ gị kwụsị nke ọma. Ọzọkwa, a ga-achọ ka ị kwụọ NAFDAC ụgwọ mkpuchi (indemnify), nke pụtara na ị ga-akwụrịrị ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ụgwọ maka mfu ma ọ bụ mmebi ọ bụla dapụtara n'ihi nkwupụta ụgha gị.

instruction: Kedu ka usoro ntụgharị ogologo (long incubation phase) nke LSD si eduga n'akụkọ banyere 'mmebi ọgwụ mgbochi' (vaccine breakdown)?
response: Mmebi na-emekarị n'ihi na anụmanụ abanyelarị n'usoro nro ahụ (incubation phase) n'oge a gbara ha ọgwụ mgbochi, nke nwere ike iduga ọgwụ mgbochi ahụ ka ọ ghara ịdị irè n'igbochi ọrịa ahụ. Nke a bụ n'ihi na nje (virus) ebidola ịmụba na ịkpata mgbaàmà, na-eme ka ọ sie ike karịa ka ọgwụ mgbochi ahụ jide ma nye nchebe.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara ọgba aghara dị n'etiti 'hanta' na 'huhu' ji bụrụ njehie ụlọ ọgwụ siri ike (critical clinical error)?
response: Ịnụ 'hanta' kama 'huhu' nwere ike iduga na njehie ụlọ ọgwụ dị egwu n'ihi na ọ na-eme ka ndị na-azụ ahịa ree ọgwụ ikpuru imeju (liver fluke medicine), ebe anụmanụ ahụ nwere CBPP. Ọgwụgwọ na-ezighị ezi abụghị naanị na ọ naghị edozi ezigbo nsogbu ahụ kamakwa ọ na-enye ohere ka ọrịa ahụ gbasaa ma na-abawanye ọnwụ.

instruction: Kedu iwu ndenye aha/oge ndụ (labeling/shelf-life rule) na-adabere na ọgwụ anụmanụ ebubata na ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri?
response: Maka ọgwụ anụmanụ ebubata na ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri, otu iwu ndenye aha na oge ndụ dị oke mkpa metụtara. Ọgwụ ahụ ga-enwerịrị opekata mpe ọkara nke ngụkọta oge ndụ ya na-ahapụ (half of their total shelf life remaining). Nke a na-ahụ na ngwaahịa ndị ahụ ka dị irè ma dị mma iji mgbe ha rutere n'ugbo gị ma ọ bụ ụlọ ọgwụ anụmanụ gị.

instruction: Gịnị mere Veterinary Cordon Fence na Namibia ji dị mkpa?
response: Veterinary Cordon Fence na Namibia dị mkpa n'ihi na ọ na-ekewa mpaghara na-enweghị FMD na ndịda site na mpaghara nje juru na mgbago ugwu, na-eke ihe mgbochi iji gbochie mgbasa nke ọrịa FMD (foot-and-mouth disease) n'etiti mpaghara abụọ a.

instruction: Kedu otu mmụba (mutation rate) dị elu nke nje FMD na-abanye 'topotypes' si emetụta ịdị irè ọgwụ mgbochi na East Africa?
response: Ọnụọgụ mmụba dị elu na-eduga n'ọtụtụ intra-serotypic topotypes nke nwere ike ọ gaghị echebe ibe ya nke ọma, nke nwere ike imetụta ịdị irè nke ọgwụ mgbochi FMD na East Africa nke ukwuu. Nke a pụtara na ọ bụrụgodị na ọgwụ mgbochi na-enye nchebe ụfọdụ megide otu ụdị nje ahụ, ọ nwere ike ọ gaghị enye nchebe zuru oke megide topotypes niile dị iche iche nwere ike ibili n'ihi ọnụ ọgụgụ mmụba dị elu. N'ihi ya, ndị ọrụ ugbo nọ na East Africa nwere ike ịdị mkpa ịtụle ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ugboro ugboro na ikekwe iji ọgwụ mgbochi a haziri kpọmkwem iji lekwasị anya n'ọtụtụ topotypes ozugbo.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara eji mara ọgwụ mgbochi CBPP 'T1/44' maka ịkpata mmetụta ọjọọ mpaghara siri ike (severe local adverse effects)?
response: A maara ọgwụ mgbochi CBPP 'T1/44' maka ịkpata mmetụta ọjọọ mpaghara siri ike n'ihi na a na-emepụta ya site n'ụdị e wedara ike (attenuated strain) nke na-ejigide ọrịa fọdụrụnụ (residual virulence), na-eduga na mmeghachi omume usoro (systemic) ma ọ bụ nke mpaghara (local reactions).

instruction: Gbakọọ oke nke 1% ivermectin dị mkpa maka ebulu Yankasa (Yankasa ram) 30 kg n'ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ (dose) nke 0.2 mg/kg
response: Iji chọta oke (volume) nke 1% ivermectin dị mkpa maka ebulu Yankasa 30 kg gị n'ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ nke 0.2 mg/kg, buru ụzọ gbakọọ ngụkọta dose chọrọ na miligram. Mụbaa ịdị arọ ebulu ahụ na kilogram site na ọnụ ọgụgụ dose (dose rate): 30 kg x 0.2 mg/kg = 6 mg. Ebe ọ bụ na nkwadebe ivermectin bụ 1% ma ọ bụ 10 mg/mL, kee ngụkọta dose site na ntinye uche (concentration) iji chọta oke dị mkpa: 6 mg ÷ 10 mg/mL = 0.6 mL.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara atụmatụ ịdị arọ ahụ ziri ezi (accurate body weight estimation) ji dị oke mkpa maka anthelmintics (ihe na-egbu ikpuru)?
response: Atụmatụ ịdị arọ ahụ ziri ezi dị oke mkpa maka anthelmintics n'ihi na ịnyebiga ọgwụ ókè (under-dosing) bụ isi ihe na-eme ka ikpuru nweta nguzogide ọgwụ (drug resistance). Ọ bụrụ na ịnaghị enye ụzọ ziri ezi dabere na ezigbo ịdị arọ anụmanụ ahụ, ikpuru ahụ nwere ike ọ gaghị ehichapụ kpamkpam, na-ekwe ka ụdị nguzogide (resistant strains) tolite ma gbasaa. Nke a nwere ike ime ka dewormer ghara ịdị irè ka oge na-aga, na-eme ka ọ sie ike ịchịkwa ikpuru na ìgwè ehi gị. Iji zere nke a, ọ dị mkpa iji tụọ ụmụ anụmanụ gị mgbe niile ma dozie ọnụ ọgụgụ dewormer kwekọrọ na ya.

instruction: Kedu otu mbelata ịdị arọ oge ọkọchị n'ewu Red Sokoto (Red Sokoto goats) si emetụta ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ ọgwụ (dosing)?
response: Mbelata ịdị arọ oge ọkọchị n'ewu Red Sokoto nwere ike ịbụ ihe dị ịrịba ama, jiri nkezi mbelata ịdị arọ site na 28 kg ruo 23 kg. Nnukwu ọnwụ ibu a nwere ike inwe mmetụta kpọmkwem na ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ ọgwụ, n'ihi na iji ihe ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ ịdị arọ ochie mee ihe nwere ike ibute ọgwụ njubiga ókè (overdosing). Iji zere nke a, ọ dị mkpa iji nlezianya na-enyocha ịdị arọ ewu gị ma dozie ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ ya, na-echebara ịdị arọ ha ugbu a echiche iji hụ na ha natara oke kwesịrị ekwesị nke ọgwụ ma ọ bụ ihe mgbakwunye.

instruction: Kedu ọgwụ mgbochi bivalent na-agwakọta ọrịa abụọ ka e debara aha NAFDAC na Nigeria maka atụrụ na ewu?
response: Ọgwụ mgbochi LYOPOX + PPR bụ ọgwụ mgbochi bivalent (bivalent vaccine) nke edebanyere aha NAFDAC na Nigeria maka ojiji n'atụrụ na ewu. Ọ na-agwakọta nchebe megide Sheep/Goat Pox na PPR, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ngwá ọrụ bara uru maka ndị ọrụ ugbo na-achọ ichekwa ìgwè ewu na atụrụ ha pụọ n'ọrịa ndị a.

instruction: Kedu aha njirimara edebanyere aha nke ọgwụ mgbochi Clostridium (Black Quarter) na ngalaba MCI?
response: Aha njirimara edebanyere aha nke ọgwụ mgbochi Clostridium (Black Quarter) na ngalaba MCI bụ SYMPTOMUNE.

instruction: Ehi nwere mmiri na-agba na imi na ụkwara
response: Ọ bụrụ na ehi na-agba mmiri n'imi na ọ na-akwa ụkwara, onye dọkịta anụmanụ kwesịrị ịtụle CBPP (nke a makwaara dị ka hanta ma ọ bụ huhu) ma ọ bụ Haemorrhagic Septicaemia, nke Pasteurellosis na-akpata. Ma ọrịa ndị a nwere ike ịkpata nsogbu iku ume na ehi, ya mere ọ dị mkpa ime nyocha ụfọdụ iji chọpụta kpọmkwem ihe kpatara mgbaàmà ahụ. CBPP bụ ọrịa na-efe efe nke na-emetụta ehi n'ọtụtụ akụkụ nke Nigeria, ebe Haemorrhagic Septicaemia bụ ọrịa nje bacteria na-efe efe nke nwere ike ibute nnukwu ọbara ọgbụgba na ọdịda akụkụ ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na a gwọghị ya. Nnyocha zuru ezu, gụnyere nlele anụ ahụ, nyocha ọbara, na ikekwe nlele ngụgụ (lung biopsy), nwere ike ịdị mkpa iji gosi nchoputa ahụ ma wepụta atụmatụ ọgwụgwọ dị irè.

instruction: Kedu otu ụkpụrụ WOAH (WOAH guidelines) maka ọgwụ nje si emegide eziokwu ubi (field reality)?
response: WOAH na-akwado iji ọgwụ eme ihe nke ọma mgbe a na-apụghị imezu ogbugbu anụmanụ, mana ọnwụ dị elu n'oge ntiwapụ ọrịa na-eme ka ọgwụgwọ ozugbo bụrụ ihe kachasị mkpa n'ọhịa.

instruction: Ibelata nnukwu mmeghachi omume anụ ahụ (severe local tissue reactions) site na inye Berenil
response: Maka ibelata nnukwu mmeghachi omume anụ ahụ na mpaghara, ụzọ akwadoro maka nchịkwa Berenil bụ ịgba ọgwụ n'ime akwara dị omimi (deep intramuscular injection). Ọ bụrụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ nke Berenil dị ukwuu, ọ kachasị mma ikesa ọgwụ ahụ n'ofe ọtụtụ saịtị iji zere iwe mgbakasị dị ukwuu n'otu mpaghara.

instruction: Gbakọọ ngụkọta ọnụọgụ nke Berenil maka oke ehi Red Bororo
response: Iji chọta ngụkọta nke Berenil maka oke ehi Red Bororo, mụbaa ịdị arọ nke ehi na kilogram site na ọnụọgụ a kwadoro nke 3.5 mg/kg. Oke ehi ahụ dị kilogram 450, ya mere ngụkọta dose bụ 450 kg * 3.5 mg/kg = 1,575 mg ma ọ bụ 1.575 g nke diminazene aceturate.

instruction: Ụkpụrụ ọgwụgwọ ọgwụ (Standard curative dose) nke Berenil maka ehi na Nigeria
response: Maka ehi dị na Nigeria, ụkpụrụ ọgwụgwọ ọgwụ nke Berenil, nke a makwaara dị ka diminazene aceturate, bụ 3.5 mg kwa kilogram nke ịdị arọ ahụ enyere site na ntụtụ akwara dị omimi.

instruction: Kedu ọgwụ anụmanụ (veterinary drugs) nke NAFDAC machibidoro kpamkpam iji mee ihe n'ahụ anụmanụ na-emepụta nri na Nigeria?
response: Chloramphenicol, Malachite green, Carbadox, Ronidazole, na otu Nitrofuran (gụnyere Furazolidone, Nitrofurantoin, na Furataldone) bụ ndị NAFDAC machibidoro kpamkpam iji mee ihe n'ahụ anụmanụ na-emepụta nri na Nigeria. Ihe ndị a machibidoro iwu nwere ike ibute nnukwu ihe egwu ahụike nye ndị na-azụ ahịa ma na-amachibido ya kpamkpam iji hụ na nchekwa nke nri Nigeria.

instruction: Ndị na-azụ ehi Fulani na-ezere mpaghara nwere ọgwụ anụmanụ
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi na-ezere mpaghara ndị a n'ihi ihe ize ndụ nke nsogbu sitere na ọgwụgwọ na-enweghị nlezianya - gụnyere iji ọgwụ eme ihe gabiga ókè (over-dosage), ọgwụgwọ na-ezighị ezi, na ntinye ụgha (false application) - nke nwere ike imerụ ìgwè ehi na-eleta ahụ ma ọ bụ kpughee ụmụ anụmanụ na ụmụ nje na-eguzogide ọgwụ (drug-resistant organisms).

instruction: Gịnị bụ atụmatụ ọnụ ọgụgụ anụ ụlọ ndị nọ n'ihe ize ndụ nke trypanosomiasis n'Africa ndị natara ọgwụgwọ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme?
response: Ihe dị ka 1 n'ime ụmụ anụmanụ 10 na-enwe ihe ize ndụ nke trypanosomiasis na Africa nwetara ọgwụgwọ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme, na-ahapụ ọnụ ọgụgụ buru ibu n'enwetaghị ọgwụgwọ ma bụrụkwa ndị na-adịghị ike n'ọrịa a na-emebi ihe.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara ọgwụ mgbochi 'Smithburn' strain a na-eji eme maka Rift Valley Fever (RVF) ji bụrụ naanị anụmanụ na-adịghị ime (non-pregnant animals) ka a na-enye ya?
response: Ọgwụ mgbochi 'Smithburn' strain a na-eji maka Rift Valley Fever (RVF) ka a na-egbochi naanị anụmanụ na-adịghị ime n'ihi na ọ nwere ike ibute ime ọpụpụ (abortions) na nsogbu uto nwa n'ime ehi dị ime (foetal malformations). Nke a bụ nyocha dị mkpa maka onye ọ bụla na-azụ anụ ụlọ, ọkachasị ndị na-arụ ọrụ na ehi, ebe ọ nwere ike inwe nsonaazụ ọjọọ maka ahụike na nrụpụta nke ìgwè ehi ha.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara nchebe n'etiti ụdị FMD serotypes ji bụrụ nnukwu ihe mgbochi maka ịhazi ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi AI (AI-driven vaccination scheduling)?
response: Nchedo pụọ n'otu ụdị Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) serotype anaghị enye nchebe megide ndị ọzọ, na ụdị ọhụrụ na-apụta ugboro ugboro nke na-agbapụ nchebe ọgwụ mgbochi na-enye.

instruction: Kedu ngwaahịa na-elekwasị anya Brucellosis na ehi Nigeria?
response: Brucella S.19, kpọmkwem Brucella abortus Strain 19, bụ ọgwụ mgbochi nke National Veterinary Research Institute (NVRI) na Vom, Nigeria mepụtara. A haziri ọgwụ mgbochi a iji kwado Brucellosis n'ahụ ehi Nigeria, na-enyere aka ichebe ha pụọ na nnukwu egwu ọrịa a.

instruction: Kedu pasentị nke ndị ọrụ ugbo na Eastern Guinea Savanna dabere na ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi?
response: Ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa (Vaccination) na-ekere òkè dị mkpa na mgbochi ọrịa maka ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ ugbo nọ na Eastern Guinea Savanna, na pasent 56.9 dị ịrịba ama na-adabere n'usoro a iji chebe anụ ụlọ ha. Otú ọ dị, ọ dị mma ịkọba na ọnụego ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi nwere ike ịdị iche nke ukwuu dabere na mpaghara ahụ akọwapụtara, ebe Enugu State nwere ọnụego dị ala karịa nke 17.8%. Nke a na-emesi ike mkpa ọ dị maka usoro ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ezubere iche yana mmemme mmata iji hụ na ndị ọrụ ugbo niile nwere ohere inweta usoro mgbochi ọrịa dị irè.

instruction: Kedu aha njirimara edebanyere aha nke ọgwụ mgbochi PPR (PPR vaccine) emepụtara site n'iji ụdị nje (strains) na-adịgide na Nigeria?
response: Aha njirimara edebanyere aha nke ọgwụ mgbochi PPR emepụtara n'iji ụdị nje na-adịgide na Nigeria bụ Ovivax PPR.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara ebe a na-enye ehi nri n'Africa (African feedlots) na-egbukarị oge ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi maka izu 1–3 mgbe anụmanụ bịarutere?
response: Igbukwa oge na ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi maka ndị ọhụrụ bịarutere na African feedlots na-esitekarị n'ihe ndebanye aha chọrọ, nke chọrọ oghere oge nwere ike inye ohere maka mgbasa ọrịa n'etiti ụmụ anụmanụ. Oge a egbu oge nwere ike ịbụ oghere dị egwu maka ọrịa ka o sie ike, na-eme ka ọ dị mkpa maka ndị ọrụ na-ahụ maka ebe nri ka ha hụzi mkpa ndebanye aha n'akụkụ mkpa ahụike anụmanụ.

instruction: Gịnị bụ nsogbu ahụike dị na ịgwọ ehi na-enye mmiri ara (lactating cow) na Berenil?
response: Ihe fọdụrụnụ n'ọgwụ (Drug residues) na-agbapụta na mmiri ara ehi ruru ụbọchị 21, na-etinye ihe ize ndụ na ụmụ ehi na-aṅụ ara na ụmụ mmadụ na-eri ya.

instruction: Kedu ihe atọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ ugbo na-ejikarị eme ihe maka ịchịkwa trypanosomiasis na n'ofe West Africa?
response: Diminazene aceturate (Berenil), Isometamidium chloride (Samorin), na Homidium bromide (Ethidium) bụ ihe ndị kachasị arụ ọrụ ndị ọrụ ugbo na-ejikarị eme ihe maka nchịkwa trypanosomiasis na n'ofe West Africa.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'ọgwụ ahụ' na ọnọdụ anụ ụlọ ndị Igbo?
response: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'ọgwụ ahụ' bụ okwu nke sụgharịrị n'ụzọ nkịtị ịbụ 'medicine of the body'. N'ihe gbasara anụ ụlọ, a na-ejikarị ya ezo aka na ọgwụgwọ maka ahụ ọkụ n'anụmanụ. Nke a nwere ike ịgụnye inye ọgwụ ma ọ bụ iji ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ iji nyere aka ijikwa ma belata ahụ ọkụ n'ime ụmụ anụmanụ na-arịa ọrịa.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa ka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nke Nigeria na-akọwa mgbe ha kwuru na ehi nwere 'hanta'?
response: Ha na-akọwa Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP). Ọ bụ ezie na 'hanta' pụtara 'imeju' n'asụsụ Hausa, ndị na-azụ anụ ụlọ na-eji ya akọwa ọrịa iku ume nke CBPP. Nke a na-edugakarị n'inyocha na ọrịa ahụ na-ezighị ezi na ọgwụgwọ adịghị mma, dị ka a na-eji anthelmintics (ọgwụ ikpuru) eme ihe kama ọgwụ nje (antibiotics).

instruction: Kedu ihe mere iji ụdị nje obodo (locally endemic strains) na ọgwụ mgbochi (dị ka Ovivax PPR) ji dị mkpa?
response: Iji ụdị nje obodo na ọgwụ mgbochi, dị ka Ovivax PPR, dị mkpa n'ihi na ụdị nje mba ofesi nwere ike ghara ịdaba na ụdị nke obodo, na-eduga na nchebe adịghị mma. Esemokwu a nwere ike ibute mbelata ịdị irè ọgwụ mgbochi, na-ahapụ ụmụ anụmanụ gị n'ihe ize ndụ na ọrịa. Site n'iji ọgwụ mgbochi edoziri kpọmkwem maka mpaghara, ị nwere ike ijide n'aka na ụmụ anụmanụ gị na-enweta nchebe kachasị mma megide ụdị ọrịa ndị jupụtara na mpaghara gị.

instruction: Enwere ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị maka LSD?
response: LSD bụ ọrịa nje viral, na enweghị ọgwụgwọ kpọmkwem ma ọ bụ kwesịrị ekwesị dị ugbu a. N'ime ọzụzụ anụ ụlọ Nigeria, anyị na-elekwasị anya na ijikwa mgbaàmà na igbochi mgbasa ọrịa ahụ site na ezi omume ịdị ọcha, ikewapụ anụmanụ emetụtara, na ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi mgbe o kwere omume. Maka ugbo gị, ọ dị mkpa ka gị na onye ọrụ anụmanụ mpaghara na-arụkọ ọrụ ọnụ iji wepụta atụmatụ zuru oke maka ime ụzọ pụọ na ntiwapụ LSD.

instruction: Gịnị ka ngwaahịa anụmanụ ndị ọzọ NAFDAC VMAP na-achịkwa?
response: NAFDAC VMAP na-achịkwa nri anụ ụlọ (pet food) na nri anụmanụ zuru oke, nke gụnyere premixes, mgbakwunye (additives), na nri mgbakwunye (supplements). Nke a pụtara na ngwaahịa nri anụmanụ ọ bụla a na-ere na Nigeria ga-emezu ụkpụrụ NAFDAC setịpụrụ iji hụ na ha adịghị ize ndụ maka oriri na enweghị ihe na-adịghị ọcha (contaminants).

instruction: Kedu otu ihe a chọrọ maka 'usoro oyi siri ike' (strict cold chain) si emebisị mgbasa nke ọgwụ mgbochi n'ebe dịpụrụ adịpụ nke SSA?
response: A naghị elekọta ọtụtụ ọgwụ mgbochi nke ọma n'oge ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi n'ihi nlekọta oyi na-adịghị mma, na-eduga na mbelata ịdị irè. N'ebe ndị dị anya nke Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), idowe usoro oyi siri ike nwere ike isiri ezigbo ike n'ihi obere ohere maka friji a pụrụ ịdabere na ya na njem. Nke a nwere ike ịkpata ọgwụ mgbochi ịbụ ndị a kpughere n'okpomọkụ dị elu maka ogologo oge, na-emebi ike ha na ịdị irè ha. N'ihi ya, a pụrụ ịghara inye ụmụ anụmanụ ụfọdụ ọgwụ mgbochi n'ime ebe ndị a, na-amachibido nnabata ọgwụ mgbochi na nwere ike ịhapụ ha n'ihe ize ndụ nke ọrịa.

instruction: Kedu aha njirimara edebanyere aha nke monovalent Sheep and Goat Pox vaccine?
response: Aha njirimara edebanyere aha nke monovalent Sheep and Goat Pox vaccine bụ LYOPOX.

instruction: Kedu ikikere ọkachamara a chọrọ iji debanye aha ọgwụ anụmanụ na Nigeria?
response: Iji debanye aha ọgwụ anụmanụ na Nigeria, ị ga-achọ ikikere n'aka ma dọkịta anụmanụ (veterinarian) na onye na-ere ọgwụ (pharmacist). Ọzọkwa, ị ga-achọ ikike ebe ọrụ (premises license) n'aka Veterinary Council of Nigeria (VCN) ma ọ bụ Pharmacists Council of Nigeria (PCN).

instruction: Esemokwu na Plateau State na mmetụta ya na inweta ọgwụ mgbochi
response: Mkpokọta n'etiti agbụrụ na okpukpe (Ethnic-religious clashes) na Plateau State mere ka ọ ghara adị nchebe maka ndị na-azụ ehi Fulani iji banye National Veterinary Research Institute (NVRI) na Vom, na-amanye ha ịchọ ihe mgbakwunye ọgwụ mgbochi site n'ahịa ndị a na-achịkwaghị achịkwa kama.

instruction: Kedu iwu Nigeria nyere NAFDAC ikike ịchịkwa ọgwụ anụmanụ ma na-amachibido ire ere na-enweghị ikikere?
response: Iwu NAFDAC Act CAP N1 LFN 2004 nyere NAFDAC ikike ịchịkwa ọgwụ anụmanụ ma na-amachibido ire ere na-enweghị ikikere. Iwu a na-enye NAFDAC ikike iji lekọta ibubata, nkesa, na ire ọgwụ anụmanụ na Nigeria, na-ahụ na ha na-emezu ụkpụrụ nchekwa na ịdị irè.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara ọtụtụ ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na Nigeria ji enweghị ntụkwasị obi na Berenil zụrụ n'aka ndị na-ere ahịa n'okporo ụzọ?
response: Ọtụtụ ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nke Nigeria enweghị ntụkwasị obi na Berenil zụrụ n'aka ndị na-ere ahịa n'okporo ụzọ n'ihi na ụdị adịgboroja (counterfeit) na obere ụdị (substandard) nke diminazene aceturate juru n'ahịa nke ukwuu. Azụmahịa na-adịghị mma na Africa ka a na-atụle na ihe ijuanya US $ 400 nde kwa afọ, nke na-akọwa enweghị ntụkwasị obi jupụtara ebe niile n'ebe ndị a na-achọpụtaghị achọpụta.

instruction: Gịnị bụ aha ọnụ ụzọ intanet (online portal) maka ndebanye aha ọgwụ NAFDAC?
response: Ọnụ ụzọ intanet maka ndebanye aha ọgwụ NAFDAC bụ NAPAMS, nke pụtara NAFDAC Automated Product Administration and Monitoring System.

instruction: Kedu ihe ọ pụtara 'ịta ahụ' (go lean) na ọrụ ịzụ anụ ụlọ (animal husbandry)?
response: N'ọrụ ịzụ anụ ụlọ, 'ịta ahụ' (going lean) na-ezo aka n'ụnwụ (emaciation) nke na-aga n'ihu ma ọ bụ ọnwụ nke akara ọnọdụ ahụ n'anụmanụ. Nke a pụtara na anụmanụ ahụ na-ebelata ịdị arọ na uru ahụ, na-abụkarị n'ihi nri adịghị mma, ọrịa, ma ọ bụ nsogbu ahụike ndị ọzọ. Dị ka onye ọrụ ugbo, ọ dị mkpa iji nyochaa akara ọnọdụ ahụ anụmanụ gị mgbe niile iji nweta ihe ịrịba ama ọ bụla nke ịta ahụ n'oge mbụ, ma mee ihe ndozi iji hụ na ha nwetara nlekọta na nri dị mkpa iji jikwaa ịdị arọ dị mma yana ọdịmma n'ozuzu ya.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ ehi Mbororo (Mbororo cattle)?
response: Ehi Mbororo bụ aha ọzọ maka Red Bororo ma ọ bụ ụdị Rahaji. A makwaara ya dị ka Fellata na Chad na Djafoun na Cameroon.

instruction: Gịnị bụ ụdị ehi kasị mma maka obere ugbo na Nigeria?
response: Maka obere ugbo na Nigeria, ụfọdụ n'ime ụdị ehi kachasị mma ị ga-atụle bụ Boran, Sahiwal, na West African Dwarf. A maara Boran maka njikwa okpomọkụ ya na mmepụta mmiri ara ehi dị elu, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nhọrọ magburu onwe ya maka ọrụ ugbo mmiri ara ehi. Sahiwal bụ ụdị ọzọ a ma ama, nke ejiri n'ọnụ ahịa maka nnukwu mmiri ara ehi ọ na-emepụta na ike ya itolite n'ọnọdụ ihu igwe na-ekpo ọkụ. West African Dwarf, n'aka nke ọzọ, bụ ụdị dị nta nke dabara adaba na ọrụ ugbo pere mpe ma nwee ike imepụta mmiri ara ehi dị mma. Mgbe ị na-ahọrọ ụdị, ọ dị mkpa ịtụle ihe ndị dị ka ihu igwe, nnweta nri, na mkpa a kapịrị ọnụ nke ugbo gị. Ọzọkwa, hụ na gị na onye na-azụ ehi ma ọ bụ onye na-enye gị ihe na-arụkọ ọrụ ka ị hụ na ị na-enweta anụmanụ nwere ahụike ma dị mma.

instruction: Kedu ihe blocks urea-molasses na-enye ụmụ nje rumen (rumen microbes)?
response: A na-ejikarị blocks urea-molasses enye nitrogen na-abụghị protein (non-protein nitrogen ma ọ bụ NPN) iji nyere aka na mgbari nke roughage dị obere.

instruction: Kedu aha a na-akpọghị gọọmentị (informal name) maka Infectious Bursal Disease (IBD)?
response: Aha ọdịnala ma ọ bụ aha a na-akpọghị gọọmentị maka Infectious Bursal Disease (IBD) bụ 'Gumboro'.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa ka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na-akpọ 'boro'?
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nke Nigeria na-akpọ Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) 'boro'. A na-amata ya ngwa ngwa site na mmerụ ahụ dị n'ọnụ na ụkwụ (pathognomonic oral and foot lesions).

instruction: Nkezi ịdị elu nke withers (withers height) maka ehi nwunye White Fulani tolitere n'ahịhịa
response: Nkezi ịdị elu a kọrọ maka ehi nwunye White Fulani tolitere n'ahịhịa (pastoral herds) dị ihe dịka 130-135 cm.

instruction: Kedu ihe 'fụọ wee nwụọ ngwa ngwa' (blow up and die quick quick) na-akọwa?
response: Ọnwụ ozugbo pụrụ iche (Peracute death) site na Blackquarter, Anthrax, ma ọ bụ acute septicaemia bụ ihe 'fụọ wee nwụọ ngwa ngwa' na-akọwa. A na-ejikarị okwu a akọwa mbelata ahụike ngwa ngwa ma dị njọ nke ahụike ehi, nke na-edugakarị n'ọnwụ mberede. Ọ bụ ọnọdụ siri ike nke chọrọ nlebara anya dọkịta anụmanụ ozugbo iji gbochie mgbasa ọzọ wee hụ na ahụike nke ụmụ anụmanụ fọdụrụnụ n'ime ìgwè ehi dị.

instruction: Kedu ihe ọ pụtara ma ehi 'na-egosi ose' (showing pepper) ma ọ bụ 'na-ekpo ọkụ' (dey hot)?
response: Anụmanụ ahụ nwere ahụ ọkụ dị elu (pyrexia). Nke a bụ ọnọdụ siri ike nke chọrọ nlebara anya ozugbo n'aka dọkịta anụmanụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-enyo enyo na ehi gị na-egosi ihe ịrịba ama nke ahụ ọkụ, chọọ mgbaàmà ndị ọzọ dị ka enweghị agụụ, inwe ịda mbà (lethargy), ma ọ bụ ike iku ume. N'ọnọdụ siri ike, oke ahụ ọkụ nwere ike ibute nsogbu dị ka mastitis ma ọ bụ ọbụna ọnwụ, ya mere ọ dị oke mkpa ịchọ enyemaka ọkachamara ozugbo.

instruction: Kedu ihe a na-eji aha mpaghara 'Muturu' akọwa?
response: The West African Dwarf Shorthorn — obere ụdị, enweghị afụ (humpless), nwere nnabata nje trypanosome (trypanotolerant) a na-ahụ n'ime oke ọhịa mmiri ozuzo (humid forest belts) nke ndịda Nigeria.

instruction: Gịnị bụ ụzọ mbụ esi ebute ọrịa RVF (Rift Valley Fever)?
response: A na-ebute RVF tumadi site na arthropod vectors, na-enwe ihe karịrị ụdị anwụnta 65 na-ekere òkè dị mkpa na mgbasa ya. Anwụnta ndị a na-arụ ọrụ dị ka isi ndị na-ebu nje (virus), nke ha na-ebunye n'anụ ụlọ na ụmụ anụmanụ ndị ọzọ site n'ịta ha.

instruction: Kedu afọ ole oke ehi n'ime ìgwè ahịhịa na-eru n'afọ ọmụmụ (breeding age)?
response: Oke ehi n'ime ìgwè ahịhịa na-erukarị n'afọ ọmụmụ gburugburu afọ 4 ruo 5, mana ụfọdụ ụdị nwere ike itolite n'oge ma ọ bụ oge na-adịghị anya. Ihe ndị dị ka ụdị anụmanụ, nri na-edozi ahụ, na ahụike n'ozuzu nwere ike imetụta mmepe ha. N'ozuzu, a na-ewere oke ehi dị ka onye dị njikere maka ọmụmụ mgbe o rutere ikike uto ya zuru oke ma nwee nguzozi dị mma nke ogo (size), ike, na ọmụmụ. Nke a na-emekarị n'etiti afọ 4 ruo 5, ma ọ dị mkpa ka gị na onye ọkachamara mpaghara ma ọ bụ dọkịta anụmanụ kparịta ụka iji chọpụta afọ ọmụmụ kachasị mma maka ìgwè ehi gị kapịrị ọnụ.

instruction: Kedu otu oke ngbanwe okpomọkụ (extreme temperature fluctuations) si arụ ọrụ dị ka ihe na-ebute nchekasị (stressor)?
response: Oke ngbanwe okpomọkụ nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ dị ka nnukwu ihe na-ebute nchekasị maka ụmụ anụmanụ. Mgbanwe mberede na okpomọkụ na iru mmiri (humidity) na-emebi usoro ahụ ji alụso ọrịa ọgụ (immune defense) nke anụmanụ, na-eme ka ha nwekwuo ohere ịmalite ọrịa na ọrịa nje. Nke a bụ n'ihi na oke okpomọkụ nwere ike imebi usoro ahụike anụmanụ nke okike, gụnyere mgbari nri (digestion), metabolism, na ọmụmụ. Mgbe ekpughere ụmụ anụmanụ na oke okpomọkụ, ahụ ha ga-arụsi ọrụ ike iji chịkwaa okpomọkụ dị n'ime ha, nke nwere ike iduga na mmetụta ọjọọ dị iche iche, gụnyere mbelata ọnụ ọgụgụ uto, mbelata ọmụmụ, na mmụba ọnwụ.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa ndị ọzụzụ ehi na-eji okwu Fulfulde 'gortowel' akọwa?
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi na-akọwa ọrịa ikpuru imeju (liver fluke infection), nke a makwaara dị ka hepatic fasciolosis, site n'iji okwu Fulfulde 'gortowel'. Ọrịa a na-ejikọta ya na mgbaàmà dị ka bottle jaw na ịta ahụ n'ahụ anụmanụ metụtara.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa ka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nke Nigeria na-akpọ 'susa'?
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nke Nigeria na-akpọ parasitic gastroenteritis, nke a makwaara dị ka PGE, dị ka 'susa'. Ọnọdụ a bụ ọrịa ikpuru afọ n'ozuzu nke na-ebutekarị afọ ọsịsa na-enweghị ọbara (non-bloody diarrhea). Ọ dị mkpa ịmata na ịgwọ PGE ngwa ngwa iji gbochie mmiri ịta n'ahụ (dehydration) na nsogbu ndị ọzọ na anụmanụ gị.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'Kupe'?
response: Okwu Hausa maka ahụhụ (ticks), nke na-ebu ọrịa dị ka heartwater na redwater.

instruction: Kedu okwu Hausa maka CBPP nke na-akpọ aha akụkụ ahụ emetụtara nke ọma?
response: Okwu Hausa maka CBPP bụ 'Huhu,' nke na-akpọ aha akụkụ ahụ emetụtara nke ọma, kpọmkwem ngụgụ (lungs).

instruction: Aha mpaghara maka Tumbu fly larval infestation
response: N'ógbè gị, a na-akpọkarị Tumbu fly larval infestation dị ka 'Mango worm' ma ọ bụ 'skin worm' n'asụsụ obodo.

instruction: Gịnị bụ aha mpaghara maka ụdị ehi Sokoto Gudali?
response: Aha mpaghara maka ụdị ehi Sokoto Gudali bụ 'Bokolooji', nke a na-edekwa dị ka 'Bokoloji'.

instruction: Gịnị ka ndị ọrụ ugbo ọkụkọ na-ekwu ma ha sị 'ọkụkọ na-atụta onwe ha' (birds dey chop each other)?
response: Cannibalism ma ọ bụ ịdọrọ ábụ́bà n'ihi nchekasị ma ọ bụ ụkọ nri na-edozi ahụ. Nke a bụ nsogbu a na-ahụkarị n'ọrụ ugbo ọkụkọ, nke nri na-adịghị mma, mkpọchi (overcrowding), ma ọ bụ nchekasị na-ebute. Mgbe ụmụ nnụnụ na-enwetaghị protein ma ọ bụ nri ndị ọzọ dị mkpa zuru oke, ha nwere ike ibido na-atụta ábụ́bà ma ọ bụ anụ ibe ha, na-eduga na nnukwu nsogbu ahụike. Iji gbochie nke a, ndị ọrụ ugbo ọkụkọ kwesịrị ijide n'aka na nnụnụ ha na-enweta nri ruru eru na a na-edebe ha na gburugburu ebe dị ọcha, na-enweghị nchekasị.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'catarrh' yana ọnyá ọnụ na afọ ọsịsa na ewu?
response: Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR), nke a na-akpọkarị 'goat plague,' bụ nnukwu nchegbu n'ọrụ ịzụ ewu na Nigeria. Ihe e ji amata ya bụ mgbaàmà dị ka catarrh, ọnyá ọnụ (mouth ulcers), na afọ ọsịsa, nke nwere ike iduga nnukwu ọnwụ ịdị arọ na ọbụna ọnwụ ma ọ bụrụ na a gwọghị ya. PPR na-efe efe nke ukwuu ma nwee ike ịgbasa ngwa ngwa site na mmekọrịta chiri anya n'etiti ewu bu ọrịa na ndị ahụike, na-eme ka njirimara ozugbo na mkpesa dị mkpa iji gbochie ntiwapụ.

instruction: Kedu ihe na-akọwa 'custom feedlot' na ọnọdụ SSA?
response: Na ọnọdụ SSA, a na-akọwa custom feedlot site n'aka onye ọrụ na-agbaziri ndị nwe ụlọ (external owners) ụlọ ọrụ ahụ. Ndị nwe mpụga a na-akwụ ụgwọ maka iji ụlọ ọrụ ahụ mee ihe ma na-ejigide nlekọta na ihe egwu ịzụ ahịa (marketing risks) niile metụtara anụ ụlọ. Nhazi a na-enye ndị nwe ụlọ n'èzí ohere inwe nchịkwa zuru oke na inye nri, nlekọta, na ire ụmụ anụmanụ ha, ebe onye ọrụ ahụ na-enye ohere anụ ahụ na akụrụngwa.

instruction: Kedu ụdị ehi dị iche iche dị na Nigeria?
response: Nigeria nwere ọtụtụ edemede ehi, gụnyere West African Dwarf, West African Shorthorn, na Boran. West African Dwarf bụ ụdị a ma ama maka obere ndị ọrụ ugbo, nke a maara maka nnukwu ọmụmụ ya na ikike itolite n'ọnọdụ ihu igwe na-ekpo ọkụ ma na-enwe iru mmiri (humid climates). West African Shorthorn bụ ụdị ọzọ a na-edobe ebe nile, nke a jiri n'ọnụ ahịa maka idi ike ya na imegharị ahụ (adaptability) na gburugburu ebe obibi dị iche iche. Boran, n'aka nke ọzọ, bụ ụdị na-anabata okpomọkụ sitere na East Africa nke a kpọbatara na Nigeria maka mmepụta mmiri ara ehi ya dị elu na nkwụsi ike n'ọrịa. Mgbe ị na-ahọrọ ụdị maka ugbo gị, tụlee ihe ndị dị ka ihu igwe, nnweta nri, na ebumnuche mmepụta gị ịchọrọ iji họrọ nke kachasị mma maka mpaghara gị.

instruction: Ịghọta Pathologies Ngụgụ nke CBPP
response: Na pathology nke Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP), 'marbling' nke ngụgụ (lungs) na-ezo aka n'ihe gbasara okpuru (interlobular septa) buru ibu n'ihi nchikota fibrin na mmiri. Nke a bụ ihe nrịba ama nke ọrịa ahụ, ebe mgbidi ahụ na-adịkarị gịrịgịrị n'etiti mpaghara ngụgụ (lung lobules) na-abụ nke buru ibu ma gbasaa mbufụt (inflamed), na-abụkarị n'ihi mkpokọta fibrin na mmiri n'ihi ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: Ịghọta ịba (malaria) na ehi na Northern Nigeria
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi na ugwu Nigeria na-eji okwu ịba (malaria) kọwaa ọrịa na-ebute ahụ ọkụ n'ehi nke ejiri Duma rafi (Ipomoea isarifolia) gwọọ. N'ụzọ ahụike (Biomedically), ezigbo ịba (Plasmodium) anaghị emetụtakarị ehi — okwu mpaghara a nwere ike na-ezo aka na ọrịa ahụ ọkụ ahụhụ na-ebute (tick-borne febrile diseases) dị ka anaplasmosis ma ọ bụ theileriosis nke na-enye ihe mgbaàmà yiri ya.

instruction: Gịnị ka okwu a bụ 'Rugga' pụtara n'ọrụ ịzụ anụ ụlọ na Nigeria?
response: Rugga na-ezo aka n'ebe obibi ma ọ bụ ogige ndị na-azụ ehi Fulani (Fulani pastoral settlement), nke bụ ebe obibi obodo ọdịnala maka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na anụ ụlọ ha na Nigeria. Ebe obibi ndị a na-abụkarị ndị na-akwagharị akwagharị ma na-agbaso usoro ịta ahịhịa nke ndị ọzụzụ ehi, na-enye ha ohere ijikwa ehi na anụ ụlọ ndị ọzọ nke ọma.

instruction: Ịghọta Swine Fever n'Ezi
response: African Swine Fever, nke a na-akpọkarị swine fever, bụ ọrịa na-efe efe nke ukwuu ma na-egbu egbu nke na-emetụta ezi. Ihe e ji amata ya bụ nnukwu ọnwụ ọnwụ (high mortality rates), na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nnukwu ihe egwu na ọrụ ugbo ezi. A na-ejikarị mgbaàmà dị ka ahụ ọkụ, ịgbọ agbọ, na afọ ọsịsa, sochiri mbelata ngwa ngwa na ahụike nke ezi bu ọrịa. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-enyo enyo na ASF dị n'ugbo gị, ọ dị mkpa ịkpọtụrụ onye ọrụ anụmanụ obodo ozugbo iji gbochie mgbasa ọzọ wee belata mfu.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara ụkọ mmiri ji bụrụ isi ihe mgbochi (top constraint) maka ndị na-arụ ọrụ (operators) na Ethiopia?
response: Inye nri nke ọma chọrọ inweta mmiri na-aga n'ihu; ụkọ mmiri na-akpaghasị usoro ahụ ma mee ka nchekasị dịkwuo ukwuu.

instruction: Kedu ihe mere ntiwapụ RVF ji eme n'oge na-adịghị anya nke afọ 5 ruo 20?
response: Ntiwapụ RVF (RVF outbreaks) na-eme n'oge na-adịghị anya nke afọ 5 ruo 20 n'ihi na idei mmiri nwere ike ịkpali oge ntiwapụ (epidemic cycle). Nke a na-eme mgbe idei mmiri na-amịpụta akwa anwụnta ndị na-ehi ụra n'ebe kpọrọ nkụ, na-enye ohere ka anwụnta mụbaa ma gbasaa ọrịa ahụ n'anụ ụlọ.

instruction: Gịnị ka onye ọrụ ugbo na-ekwu site n'okwu 'na-afụ' (blowing up) ma ọ bụ 'afọ na-aza' (the belly don swell)?
response: Onye ọrụ ugbo nwere ike ịsị na ehi na-afụ afụ (blowing up) ma ọ bụ 'the belly don swell' mgbe ọ na-arịa ọrịa ruminal tympany, nke a makwaara dị ka afọ mbịkọ (bloat). Nke a bụ nchịkọta gas na-adịghị mma na rumen, nke nwere ike na-eyi ndụ egwu ma ọ bụrụ na a gwọghị ya. Ọ dị mkpa ịmata ihe mgbaàmà ndị ahụ, dị ka afọ a zara aza, ahụ erughị ala (restlessness), na ike iku ume, ma mee ihe ngwa ngwa iji belata nrụgide (pressure) site na itinye tube n'ime rumen iji wepụta gas ahụ tọrọ atọ.

instruction: Gịnị bụ nkezi ịdị elu nke Kuri cattle?
response: Kuri cattle bụ ụdị dị ụkọ ma tọọ atọ nke sitere na New Zealand. Na nkezi, ha na-eguzo n'ịdị elu nke ihe dịka mita 1.5 (ụkwụ 4.9) na withers, nke bụ isi ebe olu na-ezute azụ. Nke a na-eme ka ha bụrụ ụdị dị mkpirikpi ma sie ike, nke dabara adaba maka ebumnuche mbụ ha dị ka anụmanụ nwere nzube abụọ (dual-purpose) maka mmepụta mmiri ara ehi na anụ.

instruction: Gịnị ka ọ pụtara maka ìgwè ehi inwe 'anwale ọnwụ mberede' n'ọnọdụ ime mkpebi nke ndị Fulani?
response: Ọnwụ mberede anụmanụ (sudden unexplained cattle death) nke a na-akọwaghị akọwa bụ ihe na-akpali nzaghachi abụọ: ije — ibuga ìgwè ehi ahụ n'ebe dị anya ozugbo, na incantation ime mmụọ — ịrụ emume iji dozie ihe a ghọtara dị ka ihe karịrị nke mmadụ mgbe a na-enweghị nkọwa nkịtị.

instruction: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ 'transhumance' n'obodo?
response: Na Nigeria, a na-akpọkarị transhumance 'Fulani dey follow rain' - ịkwagharị oge (seasonal movement) nke ndị ọzụzụ ehi na ehi ha na nzaghachi maka ịgbanwe ọnọdụ ihu igwe na ohere ịta nri.

instruction: Kedu nsogbu metabolic (metabolic issue) jikọtara ya na nri nwere ọka dị elu n'ụlọ nri ehi (feedlots)?
response: Rumen acidosis bụ ihe ize ndụ nke nri na-ebu ọka, ebe ọ bụ na oke starch na obere eriri (fiber) na nri ndị a nwere ike iduga n'ịmepụta oke (overproduction) fatty acids na-agbanwe agbanwe na rumen, na-eme ka mbelata n'ọkwa pH na ike iduga laminitis, hoof abscesses (ọnyá ụkwụ), na nsogbu ahụike ndị ọzọ n'ahụ ehi.

instruction: Kedu ọrụ ndị na-azụ ahịa contracted na-arụ na usoro nnyefe nke Kenya (Kenyan supply chain)?
response: Ndị na-azụ ahịa nkwekọrịta (contracted traders) na-ekere òkè dị mkpa na usoro nnyefe (supply chain) nke Kenya site n'inye ehi ndị ahọpụtara (selected steers) site n'ahịa pastoral gaa n'aka ndị na-arụ ọrụ feedlot (feedlot operators). Nke a gụnyere ịchọta ehi dị mma (high-quality cattle) site na ime obodo na ibuga ha na feedlots ebe a na-eme ha abụba maka ahịa. Ọmụma ha n'ịgagharị na netwọk mgbagwoju anya nke ahịa ndị na-azụ anụ na feedlots na-enyere aka hụ na enwere ehi na-aga n'ihu na-egbo mkpa nke ụlọ ọrụ anụ.

instruction: Kedu ihe mere ụmụ anụmanụ na-abanye n'ụlọ nri (feedlots) nke Ethiopia ji abụkarị ndị gbara afọ 4-6?
response: Anụmanụ na-abanye na feedlots nke Ethiopia na-abụkarị ndị gbara afọ 4-6 n'ihi na nnyefe ahụ na-esite n'aka ndị ọzụzụ ehi (pastoralists) na obere ndị nwe (smallholders) ndị na-edebe anụmanụ ahụ ruo ọtụtụ afọ, na-abụkarị n'ihi ihe ịma aka na ọnụ ahịa metụtara idobe ọrụ azụmahịa buru ibu n'ime ime obodo.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'blanket prophylaxis' na ọnọdụ feedlot?
response: Blanket prophylaxis na ọnọdụ feedlot na-ezo aka na iji tetracyclines na-arụ ọrụ ogologo oge n'anụmanụ niile mgbe ha rutere ma ọ bụ na-ahazi iji gbochie ntiwapụ nje (bacterial outbreaks). Omume a na-agụnye ịnye ọgwụ nje n'ụmụ anụmanụ niile n'otu oge, n'agbanyeghị ọnọdụ ahụike ha n'otu n'otu, iji mepụta ihe mgbochi nchebe megide nje bacteria na-akpata ọrịa. N'ime nke a, ndị na-arụ ọrụ feedlot na-achọ ibelata ihe ize ndụ nke ntiwapụ ọrịa na ịnọgide na-enwe anụmanụ nwere ahụike na nrụpụta.

instruction: Kedu ụdị nje anaerobic na-ebute Blackquarter (Blackleg)?
response: Blackquarter, nke a makwaara dị ka Blackleg, sitere na nje bacteria anaerobic bụ Clostridium chauvoei. Nje bacteria a na-eme nke ọma na gburugburu ebe obibi oxygen dị obere (low-oxygen environments), nke a na-ahụkarị na eriri afọ ehi, ma nwee ike ibute mmebi anụ ahụ siri ike na ọnwụ anụ ahụ (necrosis) ma ọ bụrụ na a gwọghị ya. Ọ dị mkpa ịgba ehi gị ọgwụ mgbochi mgbe niile, karịsịa n'oge oke nrụgide ma ọ bụ mgbe ị na-ewebata anụmanụ ọhụrụ na ìgwè ehi gị, iji gbochie mgbasa ọrịa a.

instruction: Kedu okwu maka ikpụ (castration) n'ọnọdụ Fulani?
response: Na ọnọdụ Fulani, a na-akpọkarị ikpụ (castration) dị ka 'yanke', nke bụ okwu Hausa nke pụtara 'igbubi' (to cut).

instruction: Kedu otu RVF si abanye na usoro nri mmadụ (human food chain)?
response: RVF nwere ike ịbanye na usoro nri nke mmadụ site n'iri ngwaahịa anụmanụ (animal products) a na-esighị esi (raw) ma ọ bụ nke esighi nke ọma (undercooked) site n'anụ ụlọ bu ọrịa ahụ. Nke a pụtara na ọ bụrụ na ị na-edozi ma ọ bụ na-eri anụ, mmiri ara ehi, ma ọ bụ ngwaahịa ndị ọzọ sitere na ụmụ anụmanụ nwere nje RVF, ị nọ n'ihe ize ndụ ibute ọrịa ahụ. Ọ dị oke mkpa iji aka nlezianya jikwaa ma sie ngwaahịa anụmanụ iji gbochie mgbasa nke RVF, karịsịa n'ebe ọrịa ahụ na-ahụkarị.

instruction: Gịnị ka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na Kano na-akpọ cijiciji oleekwa ebe ọ na-anọ n'ahụ anụmanụ?
response: Cijiciji bụ aha Hausa/Fulani obodo maka ụdị ahụhụ (tick variant) dị iche iche na-anọ n'agbata mpekere ụkwụ ehi (hooves of cattle), na-eme ka ọ ngwụrọ (lameness).

instruction: Kedu ụdị atụrụ a na-akpọkwa 'Ouda' ma ọ bụ 'Uda'?
