response: Ụdị atụrụ ị na-ekwu maka ya bụ Ouda ma ọ bụ Uda, nnukwu atụrụ nwere uwe pụrụ iche (distinctive coat): agba nchara (brown) ma ọ bụ oji na ọkara ihu yana ọcha na ọkara azụ.

instruction: Kedu ụdị ehi a na-akpọkarị 'Bunaji'?
response: Ụdị ehi White Fulani mejupụtara ihe dị ka pasentị 37 nke ehi mba ahụ (national herd) na a na-akpọkarị ya 'Bunaji'.

instruction: Kedu otu ụkọ netwọk kwụsiri ike (lack of established channels) na Kenya si emetụta ịdị mma ụmụ anụmanụ?
response: Enweghị usoro emebere (lack of established channels) na Kenya na-emetụta ogo anụmanụ n'ihi na ndị na-arụ ọrụ (operators) ga-azụrịrị ụmụ anụmanụ ọ bụla dị na ahịa ndị ọzụzụ ehi, nke na-abụkarị ndị tọrọ etọ (older) ma nọrọ n'ọnọdụ adịghị mma. Nke a nwere ike iduga mbelata nke njirimara anụmanụ n'ozuzu ya nke a na-ewebata n'ugbo, na-eme ka o sikwuo ike iru ọkwa ọmụmụ na uto kachasị mma (optimal breeding and growth rates).

instruction: Kedu ọrịa ka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nke Nigeria na-akpọ 'sammore'?
response: Trypanosomiasis, nke a makwaara dị ka African Animal Trypanosomiasis ma ọ bụ AAT, bụ ọrịa a na-akpọ 'sammore' site n'aka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani na Nigeria. Ihe e ji amata ya bụ ịta ahụ (wasting) na anaemia, ọ nwekwara ike inwe mmetụta dị ukwuu na ahụike na nrụpụta ehi (cattle productivity).

instruction: Ịmata White Fulani na Red Bororo na okwu ndị ọzụzụ anụ ụlọ nke Northern Nigeria
response: N'okwu ndị ọzụzụ anụ ụlọ nke ugwu Nigeria, a na-akpọkarị White Fulani 'bunaji', ebe a na-akpọ Red Bororo 'rahaji'. A na-eji okwu ndị a eme ihe n'ọtụtụ ebe n'etiti ndị Hausa iji mata ụdị ehi ndị a pụrụ iche.

instruction: Aha mpaghara maka Contagious Ecthyma (Orf) n'atụrụ
response: Na Nigeria, Contagious Ecthyma (Orf) na atụrụ a na-akpọkarị 'Sore mouth' ma ọ bụ 'mouth disease of sheep'.

instruction: Gịnị bụ aha Hausa maka ijiji tsetse (tsetse fly), onye bụ isi na-ebu trypanosomiasis?
response: Aha Hausa maka ijiji tsetse, nke bụ isi (primary vector) na-ebu trypanosomiasis, bụ 'Kizo' ma ọ bụ 'kizoo'.

instruction: Gịnị bụ 'rago' na 'tunkiya' na Hausa?
response: Rago bụ ebulu (ram), na-ezo aka n'atụrụ nwoke, ebe tunkiya bụ atụrụ nwunye (ewe ma ọ bụ sheep), nke nwere ike ịbụ nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị, ma na-ezo aka n'atụrụ nwanyị.

instruction: Kedu ihe ịta eze (grinding teeth) ma ọ bụ ịta ọnụ nke ya (biting own mouth) na-egosi na ehi?
response: Bruxism, ihe ịrịba ama nke mgbu afọ ma ọ bụ nsogbu metabolic dị ka ruminal acidosis, na-egosipụtakarị site na ịta eze ma ọ bụ ịta ọnụ (biting own mouth) na ehi. Omume a nwere ike ịbụ n'ihi ahụ erughị ala ma ọ bụ ihe mgbu na usoro nri (digestive system), nke ruminal acidosis nwere ike ịkpata site na ihe ndị dị ka nri adịghị mma, ịṅụ obere mmiri (inadequate water intake), ma ọ bụ enweghị ahaghị nhata na rumen (imbalance in the rumen's microbial population). Ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụta omume a n'ehi gị, ọ dị mkpa ịchọpụta ihe kpatara ya ma mee usoro mgbazi iji dozie nsogbu ahụ, nke nwere ike ịgụnye ịgbanwe nri ha, inye mmiri dị ọcha, ma ọ bụ inye ọgwụ iji belata mgbaàmà ahụ.

instruction: Ajụjụ ndị ọrụ ugbo ọkụkọ
response: Mgbe ndị ọrụ ugbo ọkụkọ kwuru 'falling down anyhow', ha na-akọwa ọdịda mberede na akọwaghị akọwa (unexplained collapse) ma ọ bụ ọnwụ nke nnụnụ ha. Nke a nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịrịba ama nke ọrịa siri ike, dị ka velogenic Newcastle Disease, Gumboro, ma ọ bụ Marek's disease. Ọnọdụ ndị a nwere ike ịgbasa ngwa ngwa n'ime ìgwè, ya mere ọ dị mkpa ịchọpụta ihe kpatara ya ma mee ihe ngwa ngwa iji gbochie mfu ọzọ.

instruction: Onye ọrụ ugbo kwuru na ehi anaghị eri nri
response: Mgbe onye ọrụ ugbo kwuru 'she no want chop', ọ bụ ọkọlọtọ na-acha ọbara ọbara (red flag) na ọ dị ihe na-adịghị mma. Anorexia, ma ọ bụ enweghị agụụ nri, bụ isi ihe na-egosi ọrịa system n'ime ehi (systemic illness). Ọ nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịrịba ama nke ọrịa nje (bacterial infection), nje na-ebi n'ahụ (parasites), ma ọ bụ nri na-edozi ahụ na-adaghị nhata. Ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụta na ehi gị anaghị eri nri, ọ dị mkpa nyochaa ihe kpatara ya ma dozie ya ozugbo iji gbochie nsogbu ndị ọzọ. Chọọ maka ihe ịrịba ama ọ bụla nke ọrịa, dị ka afọ ọsịsa, ịgbọ agbọ, ma ọ bụ ịda mbà (lethargy), wee jụọ dọkịta anụmanụ ma ọ bụrụ na ijighị n'aka maka ihe kpatara ya.

instruction: Kedu ka oghere mmiri ekekọrịtara (shared water troughs) si eme ka nnyefe IBR (IBR transmission) dị mfe?
response: Nje (viruses) nwere ike ịgbasa site na ikuku ma ọ bụ kọntaktị mgbe anụmanụ sitere na pensụl ndị gbara ya gburugburu jikọtara ọnụ mmiri (shared water source).

instruction: Gịnị ka okwu 'Gudali' pụtara na Hausa?
response: Na Hausa, okwu a 'Gudali' na-ezo aka n'ehi nwere mpi dị mkpụmkpụ, na ụkwụ dị mkpụmkpụ. Enwere ụdị abụọ a na-ahụ na Nigeria: Sokoto Gudali na Adamawa Gudali.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara nkwalite (booster) kwa afọ ji dị mkpa maka ụdị Neethling LSD (Neethling LSD strain)?
response: Ọgụ ahụ (Protective immunity) chọrọ ka agbaa booster kwa afọ ka ọ nọgide na-arụ ọrụ, na-ahụ na Neethling LSD strain nke Newcastle disease vaccine nọgidere na-enye nchebe kachasị mma maka ìgwè gị.

instruction: Gịnị ka ọ pụtara ma 'kizo don chop the cow'?
response: Okwu a 'kizo don chop the cow' bụ ụzọ e ji akọwa ehi butere trypanosomiasis, ọrịa siri ike nke ijiji tsetse (tsetse fly) na-akpata. Ọnọdụ a nwere ike iduga n'ọnwụ ibu, anaemia, na ọbụna ọnwụ ma a gwọghị ya. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-enyo enyo na ehi gị nwere trypanosomiasis, ọ dị mkpa ịchọ enyemaka dọkịta anụmanụ ngwa ngwa (promptly), n'ihi na ọgwụgwọ mbụ nwere ike ime ka ohere ịgbake dịkwuo mma.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa ndị ọzụzụ ehi na-eji okwu Fulfulde 'dauda' akọwa?
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi na-eji okwu Fulfulde 'dauda' akọwa Haemorrhagic PGE, nke a makwaara dị ka parasitic gastroenteritis na afọ ọsịsa na-agba ọbara (bloody diarrhea).

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'Kadangare'?
response: Kadangare bụ okwu Hausa nke na-akọwa adịghị ike (progressive weakness) na ịta ahụ na ụmụ anụmanụ (emaciation), nke trypanosomiasis ma ọ bụ helminthiasis na-ebute.

instruction: Kedu ụdị atụrụ a maara dị ka 'Balami' n'akụkụ ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ Nigeria (northeastern Nigeria)?
response: Atụrụ Balami (Balami sheep) bụ ụdị buru ibu na-eto ngwa ngwa a maara na ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ Nigeria. A na-ejikọta ya na ewu Sahelian (Sahelian goat) nke otu aha mpaghara ahụ, ya mere hụ na ịchọpụta njirimara anụmanụ tupu ịme mkpebi ọ bụla gbasara ìgwè ewu gị.

instruction: Kedu ihe ọ pụtara ma ehi 'na-efunahụ ọbara' (dey lose blood) n'enweghị ọnyá a na-ahụ anya?
response: Mgbe ị chọpụtara na ehi gị na-efunahụ ọbara (losing blood) n'enweghị ọnyá a na-ahụ anya, ọ na-abụkarị ihe ịrịba ama nke clinical anemia kpatara site na ikpuru dị n'ime (internal parasites) dị ka trypanosomiasis ma ọ bụ babesiosis. Nje ndị a na-ebi n'ime nwere ike imebi usoro ahụ ji alụso ọrịa ọgụ na ehi gị (immune system), na-eduga na mbelata mkpụrụ ndụ ọbara uhie (red blood cells) yana mbelata ikike ha ibunye ikuku oxygen n'akụkụ ahụ dị mkpa. Nke a nwere ike ịbụ nnukwu okwu, ya mere ọ dị mkpa ijikọ aka na dọkịta anụmanụ (veterinarian) iji chọpụta ihe kpatara ya ma mepụta atụmatụ ọgwụgwọ iji lebara nje ndị (parasite infestation) nọ n'ime ahụ nsogbu ahụ anya ma weghachi ahụike ehi gị.

instruction: Kedu ihe Maradi na-ekwu maka ya?
response: Maradi na-ezo aka n'ewu Red Sokoto (Red Sokoto goat), ọkachasị na azụmahịa gafere oke ala (cross-border trade).

instruction: Kedu ihe 'iji imi ya agụ egwu' (singing with its nose) pụtara na ọkụkọ?
response: Na ọkụkọ, 'iji imi ya agụ egwu' bụ ihe mgbaàmà na-egosi nsogbu iku ume (respiratory issues). A na-ejikọtakarị ya na Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD), Infectious Laryngotracheitis (ILT), ma ọ bụ nnukwu Newcastle Disease. Ọnọdụ ndị a nwere ike ịkpata ụda akpịrị (gurgling sounds) ma ọ bụ rales, nke na-abụghị ụda iku ume, ebe ọ bụ na nnụnụ ahụ na-adọgbu onwe ya iku ume. Ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụta ihe mgbaàmà a, ọ dị mkpa ịchọrọ onye dọkịta anụmanụ maka nyocha na ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị iji gbochie mgbasa nke ọrịa ma chebe ahụike ìgwè nnụnụ gị.

instruction: Nchekwa ndụ (Biosecurity) n'ụlọ nri mbufe nke Ethiopia (Ethiopian export feedlots)
response: A na-akọkarị nchekwa ndụ dị ka adịghị mma (deficient) na feedlots mbupụ nke Ethiopia, na omume ịdị ọcha na-adịghị adị maka ndị ọrụ na ndị nleta. Enweghị usoro nchekwa ndụ kwesịrị ekwesị nwere ike iduga mgbasa nke ọrịa na nje ndị na-ebi n'ime n'etiti anụmanụ, na-emebi ahụike na nrụpụta nke anụ ụlọ. Iji melite nchekwa ndụ, feedlots kwesịrị itinye usoro ịdị ọcha siri ike, gụnyere ihicha na iwepụ ọrịa n'ụlọ (disinfection), ịsa aka kwesịrị ekwesị na idebe ihe ọcha maka ndị ọrụ na ndị na-eleta, na njikwa siri ike na mmegharị anụmanụ na ndị mmadụ n'ime na n'èzí (premises).

instruction: Gịnị bụ kpochapụwo njirimara (classical hallmark) nke ọrịa RVF (RVF epidemic)?
response: Ime ọpụpụ mberede (sudden onset of abortion storms) n'anụmanụ ruminants (anụ na-atụgharị nri n'afọ) yana ọnwụ nke ụmụ anụmanụ (deaths of young animals) na ikpe mmadụ (human cases).

instruction: Kedu ihe 'akpụkpọ anụ na-apụ apụ' (skin don peel) ma ọ bụ 'akpụkpọ anụ na-adapụ' (skin dey fall) na-akọwa?
response: Dermatophilosis, nke a makwaara dị ka Streptothricosis ma ọ bụ Rain Rot, bụ ọrịa akpụkpọ anụ nke nje bacteria (bacterial skin infection) na-eme ka akpụkpọ ahụ wepụ ma ọ bụ daa. Ọnọdụ a na-ahụkarị na ehi, karịsịa na mpaghara nwere nnukwu iru mmiri (high humidity) na mmiri ozuzo.

instruction: Kedu ihe 'olu gbagọrọ agbagọ' (twisted neck) ma ọ bụ 'olu na-atụgharị' (neck dey turn) pụtara na ọkụkọ?
response: Torticollis, nke a makwaara dị ka 'olu na-tụgharị', bụ ihe akwara metụtara (neurological sign) velogenic Newcastle Disease, ọrịa nje na-efe efe nke ukwuu ma na-egbu egbu nke na-emetụta ọkụkọ. Ọ bụrụ na ịhụ olu nnụnụ gbagọrọ agbagọ ma ọ bụ tụgharịrị n'otu akụkụ, ọ bụ ihe ngosi siri ike na ìgwè nnụnụ gị nwere ike ibute ọrịa Newcastle Disease. Ọnọdụ a nwere ike igbu egbu ma a gwọghị ya, ya mere ọ dị oke mkpa ime ihe ngwa ngwa wee kpọtụrụ onye ọrụ ahụike anụmanụ (local veterinary officer) maka nchoputa ziri ezi na ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị.

instruction: Kedu ụlọ ọrụ na-amanye (enforces) usoro ịdị ọcha maka ụmụ anụmanụ na oke ala (border)?
response: Ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka ịmanye usoro ịdị ọcha maka ụmụ anụmanụ n'ókè (border) bụ NAQS, nke pụtara Nigerian Agricultural Quarantine Service. Ha na-arụ ọrụ dị mkpa n'igbochi mgbasa nke ọrịa anụmanụ na ụmụ ahụhụ (pests) site na ịhụ na anụmanụ na-abanye ma ọ bụ na-ahapụ obodo ahụ (country) na-agbaso ụkpụrụ ahụike (health standards) siri ike.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa ka ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nke Nigeria na-akpọ 'bakale'?
response: Ndị ọzụzụ ehi Fulani nke Nigeria na-akpọ Brucellosis ka 'bakale', ọrịa a jikọtara chiri anya na ọdịda ọmụmụ (reproductive failure) na oké ime ọpụpụ (abortion storms) n'ehi ha.

instruction: Kedu ahịhịa na-enye obere nri (leguminous forage shrub) a na-akwado nke ọma maka 'ogige dị ndụ' (living fences) na nkwado protein na Nigeria?
response: Leucaena leucocephala na Gliricidia sepium bụ nhọrọ a ma ama maka 'ogige dị ndụ' (living fences) na mgbakwunye protein na Nigeria. A na-eji obere osisi nri (leguminous forage shrubs) ndị a akpọrọ ihe maka ikike ha nwere inye ụmụ anụmanụ protein dị n'okike (natural source of protein), ebe ọ na-ejekwa ozi dị ka nhọrọ na-adigide na gburugburu ebe obibi maka ime ogige (fencing). A mara Leucaena leucocephala maka nnukwu protein ya, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nhọrọ magburu onwe ya maka ehi mmiri ara ehi na anụmanụ ndị ọzọ na-atụgharị nri (ruminant animals), ebe a na-ejikarị Gliricidia sepium maka ike ya idobe nitrogen na ala ma na-enye ndò (shade) maka anụmanụ.

instruction: Gịnị bụ ọgwụ mgbochi antimicrobial (antimicrobial) a na-ejikarị eme ihe n'ụlọ nri SSA (SSA feedlots)?
response: Oxytetracycline bụ isi ọgwụ maka ịgwọ ọrịa nnyefe ọzọ nke FMD (FMD secondary infections), CBPP, na BRD.

instruction: Kedu otu uzuzu (dust) si ebelata mkpochapụ mucociliary (mucociliary clearance) n'ime ehi (feedlot cattle)?
response: Ụmụ irighiri uzuzu na-egbochi ma na-eme ka usoro ihe ndị dị ndụ (biological mechanisms) e mere iji kpochapụ nje (bacteria) pụọ na tract daa mbà. Nke a nwere ike iduga n'ịmepụta ihe ndị na-akpata ọrịa (pathogens) na nsị (toxins) n'ime usoro iku ume, na-eme ka ehi feedlot bụrụ ndị nwere ike ịdaba na ọrịa iku ume. Usoro mkpochapụ mucociliary bụ ihe nchebe dị mkpa nke na-enyere aka iwepụ uzuzu, nje bacteria, na ụmụ irighiri mba ofesi (foreign particles) pụọ na ngụgụ (lungs), mana mgbe emebiri ya, ọ nwere ike inwe nnukwu nsonaazụ maka ahụike na ọdịmma nke ehi.

instruction: Kedu ihe mere zụrụ oke ehi (bulls) site na ahịa Borena na Ethiopia ji bụrụ nnukwu nsogbu nchekwa ndụ (biosecurity risk)?
response: Ahịa ndị a nwere akụkọ ihe mere eme (history) nke ọrịa anụmanụ transboundary (transboundary animal diseases) dị ka Foot and Mouth Disease, Lumpy Skin Disease, na Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia, na a na-azụkarị oke ehi na-enweghị ihe ọmụma ọ bụla gbasara ọnọdụ ahụike ha, na-eme ịzụrụ oke ehi n'ahịa Borena ka ọ bụrụ ihe dị ịrịba ama maka nchekwa biosecurity n'ugbo gị.

instruction: Ihe mgbaàmà ehi (Cattle symptoms) - ụkwụ fụrụ akpụ (swollen leg) na ịda ngwụrọ (limping)
response: Ụkwụ fụrụ akpụ (Swollen leg) na ịda ngwụrọ (limping) na ehi nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịrịba ama nke ọtụtụ ọnọdụ, gụnyere Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD), Foot Rot, ma ọ bụ oke akọrọ (severe tick paralysis). Foot Rot bụ nje bacteria na-akpata mbufụt na mgbu (inflammation and pain) na ụkwụ, ebe FMD bụ ọrịa nje na-efe efe (highly contagious viral disease) nke na-emetụta ọnụ, ụkwụ, na eze (teats) nke ehi. Oke tick ahụhụ akpọnwụ (Severe tick paralysis), n'aka nke ọzọ, na-eme mgbe ụmụ ahụhụ gbakwunyere na akpụkpọ anụmanụ wee gbaa mmiri fụfụ egbu egbu nke nwere ike ịkpata mgbaàmà akwara, gụnyere ịda ngwụrọ (limping). Ọ dị mkpa ka onye dọkịta anụmanụ nyochaa anụmanụ ahụ iji chọpụta ihe kpatara mgbaàmà ahụ wee nye ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị.

instruction: Kedu ka oke mgbasa (high prevalence) nke subclinical BRD na ụlọ nri Africa (African feedlots) si agbagọ (skew) amụma 'Nkezi Uto Kwa Ụbọchị' (Average Daily Gain ma ọ bụ ADG predictions)?
response: Clinical na subclinical Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD) na-ebelata Nkezi Uto Kwa Ụbọchị (Average Daily Gain), na-ebute mkpokọta mbelata (overall reduction) na arụmọrụ uto. Subclinical BRD, kachasị, nwere ike ịbụ nnukwu ihe ịma aka na ụlọ nri Africa (African feedlots), n'ihi na ọ na-agakarị enweghị njirimara ruo mgbe oge agaala (too late), na-akpata nwayọ nwayọ mbelata (gradual decline) na ahụike na nrụpụta (productivity) anụmanụ. Nke a nwere ike iduga n'ịbelata arụmọrụ nri, ịba ụba ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnwụ (mortality rates), na n'ikpeazụ, ADG dị ala. Iji buo amụma ziri ezi (accurately predict) ADG, ọ dị mkpa ime usoro nlekota na njikwa siri ike iji chọpụta ma chịkwaa BRD, gụnyere nyocha ahụike (health checks), usoro ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa (vaccination programs), na usoro nchekwa ndụ (biosecurity measures) iji gbochie mgbasa ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: Kedu otu ọrịa (endemicity) nke CBPP si dị iche na SSA n'ọnọdụ ya na Europe ma ọ bụ America?
response: A kpochapụwo CBPP n'ọtụtụ akụkụ nke ụwa belụsọ maka Africa, ebe ọ ka na-ebutekarị (endemic) n'ọtụtụ mba SSA.

instruction: Kedu ụdị (breed) nke ndị ọzụzụ ehi toro maka ịka mma n'iguzogide ọrịa (resisting diseases)?
response: Ndị White Fulani, nke a makwaara dị ka Bunaji, bụ ụdị nwere oke uru (highly valued breed) n'etiti ndị ọzụzụ ehi maka nguzogide ha pụrụ iche pụọ n'ọrịa (exceptional resistance to diseases). Etoola ụdị a maka ike ya iguzogide nsogbu ahụike dị iche iche, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nhọrọ na-ewu ewu maka ndị nọ na ụlọ ọrụ anụ ụlọ (livestock industry). Usoro mgbochi siri ike (robust immune system) na ike ha (hardiness) bụ isi ihe na-enye aka na nkwụsi ike ha kachasị elu pụọ n'ọrịa.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ ịkekọrịta ìgwè ehi (herd sharing) na ọnọdụ ọzụzụ anụ ụlọ nke Africa (African pastoral sense), nakwa n'okpuru ọnọdụ dị aṅaa ka a na-ebute ya?
response: Ịkekọrịta ìgwè ehi (Herd sharing) bụ omume ịkekọrịta ehi n'etiti ndị ikwu na ụmụaka tolitere bi n'ebe dị iche iche mgbe ọrịa ma ọ bụ mbuso agha (pest invasion) na-eyi ìgwè ehi egwu. Ọ na-akpata ngwa ngwa n'oge ọnọdụ mberede iji belata ọnụ ọgụgụ (mass casualties) site na nkewa (physically separating) ụmụ anụmanụ na ibe ha.

instruction: Ịghọta Ndị Na-ebu (Carriers) CBPP
response: Ndị na-ebu (Carriers) nwere ọrịa na-adịghị ala ala (chronic infection) na-edobe nje (organisms) dị ndụ n'ime oghere ngụgụ gbanyere mkpọrọgwụ (encapsulated lung lesions) ma bụrụ nnukwu ebe nnyefe nke ọrịa. Ndị na-ebu (carriers) ehi (bovine carriers) a na-enweghị ụlọ ọgwụ (nonclinical) na-ekere òkè dị mkpa n'ịgbasa Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) site na ichekwa nje bacteria na ngụgụ (lungs), ọbụlagodi mgbe ha dị mma na mpụga. Nke a pụtara na ha nwere ike amaghị ama na-ebunye (unknowingly transmit) ọrịa ahụ n'ehi ndị ọzọ, na-akwado mgbasa nke CBPP n'ime ìgwè ma ọ bụ mpaghara (herd or region).

instruction: Gịnị bụ ụzọ bara uru maka ticks na mange mgbe acaricides adịghị (unavailable)?
response: Mgbe acaricides adịghị, ụzọ bara uru (practical alternative) maka ijikwa ticks na mange bụ iji engine oil e jichara mee ihe ma ọ bụ mmanụ ọkụ (kerosene). Otú ọ dị, ọ dị mkpa iburu n'uche na ụzọ ndị ọzọ a nwere nnukwu ihe mwepu (drawbacks), gụnyere iwuli ihe fọdụrụnụ (residue buildup) na ihe egwu (potential cancer risks) ọrịa kansa. N'agbanyeghị ihe ize ndụ ndị a, ụfọdụ ndị ọrụ ugbo ahụla ha ka ha dị irè na ọnọdụ mberede. Ka o sina dị, ọ dị mkpa inyocha (explore) ụzọ ndị ka mma na nke na-adigide (sustainable options) mgbe o kwere omume.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara AI nwere ike iji leghara obere anya nnyefe anya (transmission distance) nke CBPP n'okpuru ọnọdụ ihu igwe (climatic conditions) dị na Africa?
response: N'agbanyeghị na kọntaktị chiri anya (close contact) na-abụkarị mkpa, enwere ike ibunye ọrịa ahụ ruo 200m n'okpuru ọnọdụ ihu igwe (climatic conditions) mara mma, nke nwere ike iduga AI na mbelata (underestimate) ebe mgbasa nke Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) nwere ike iru ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dabere naanị na ezi uche zuru oke gbasara mmekọrịta chiri anya ịbụ mkpa maka mgbasa.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara polyarthritis na ụmụ ehi ji bụrụ ihe nrịba ama nchoputa (critical diagnostic indicator) dị oke mkpa maka CBPP nke AI nwere ike ileghara anya?
response: Polyarthritis na ụmụ ehi bụ ihe nrịba ama nchoputa dị oke mkpa maka CBPP n'ihi na Mmm, ụdị onye nnyefe nje ahụ, nwere ụdị (distinct tropism) maka nkwonkwo (joints) ehi ruru ọnwa 6, na-emetụta (frequently affecting) nkwonkwo carpal na tarsal n'ụzọ dị iche. Nke a pụtara na nje bacteria na-elekwasị anya wee banye n'ime nkwonkwo ụmụ ehi na-eto eto, na-ebute nnukwu arthritis na-egbu mgbu ma na-akụda mmụọ. Ọ bụrụ na AI ga-eleghara (overlook) ihe mgbaàmà a, ọ nwere ike iduga n'igbu oge ma ọ bụ nchoputa adịghị mma, nke nwere ike inwe nnukwu mmetụta maka ahụike na ọdịmma nke ụmụ anụmanụ emetụtara.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara nchoputa anụmanụ n'otu n'otu (individual animal diagnosis) nke CBPP na-eji serological tests (nnwale serological) na-anaghị arụ ọrụ mgbe ụfọdụ (often ineffective)?
response: Nnyocha (Serological analyses) serological bara uru maka nyocha nke ìgwè anụmanụ (herd-level investigation) mana ọ bụghị maka nchoputa onye n'otu n'otu (individual diagnosis), ebe a na-ahọrọ PCR.

instruction: Kedu otu ọdịdị oge (seasonal nature) nke ọrịa si emetụta nzere (tracking)?
response: Ntiwapụ ọrịa ejikọtara ya na ihu igwe mmiri ozuzo / ọkụ (wet/warm weather) yana ọnụ ọgụgụ oge na-ebu nje (seasonal vector peaks), na-eme ka ọ dị mkpa iji nyochaa ọnọdụ ndị a (monitor these conditions) nke ọma iji nyochaa (track) mgbasa nke ọrịa nke ọma. Ka okpomọkụ na-ebili na iru mmiri na-abawanye, ihe ize ndụ (risk) nke nnyefe ọrịa na-arị elu, na-abụkarị ihe jikọtara ya na oge kachasị elu maka ụmụ ahụhụ na-ebu ọrịa dị ka anwụnta (mosquitoes) na ahụhụ (ticks). Site n'ịghọta usoro oge ndị a, ị nwere ike ịtụ anya nke ọma (anticipate) ma jikere (prepare) maka nsogbu (potential outbreaks) ndị nwere ike ime, na-agba mbọ na-echebe ụmụ anụmanụ gị ma na-egbochi mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: N'ịzụ ehi na ugwu Nigeria (northern Nigerian cattle herding), gịnị bụ ọnọdụ ọdịnala (traditionally) ejiri gbaa ahịhịa gbara gburugburu ọkụ (burning the surrounding bush), gịnịkwa bụ ihe na-akpata n'azụ arụmọrụ ya (mechanism behind its effectiveness)?
response: A na-eji ịgba ọkụ (Bush burning) ahịhịa achịkwa ọrịa nfụ (tick infestation). Ọ na-arụ ọrụ (works) site na ibibi akwa (tick eggs) nke nfụ na igbu nfụ na nymph (nymph stages) n'ime ahịhịa (living in vegetation), si otú a na-emebi usoro ndụ nke nfụ n'èzí (breaking the tick's off-host life cycle) anụmanụ ahụ wee belata nrụgide (infestation pressure) oria na ìgwè ehi (herd).

instruction: Gịnị mere mmụta ahụike ọha (public health education) ji dị oke mkpa (critical) n'oge ọrịa RVF (RVF epizootic)?
response: Mmụta ahụike ọha (Public health education) dị mkpa n'oge ọrịa (epizootic) Rift Valley Fever (RVF) n'ihi na ọ na-enyere aka igbochi ọrịa metụtara ụmụ mmadụ. Nke a dị mkpa karịsịa (particularly important) mgbe a na-ejikwa ụmụ anụmanụ butere ọrịa, dị ka mgbe a na-amụ nwa, na-akpụ isi, ma ọ bụ na-egbu. Ọ bụrụ na eweghị nlezianya kwesịrị ekwesị, nje nwere ike ịbufe ndị mmadụ site n'ịkpọtụrụ anụ ahụ (animal tissues) butere ọrịa ma ọ bụ mmiri (bodily fluids) n'anụmanụ, na-eduga ná nnukwu ọrịa ma ọ bụ ọbụna ọnwụ. Ya mere, ịkụziri (educating) ọha na eze otu esi ejikwa na kpochapụ ụmụ anụmanụ butere ọrịa n'enweghị nsogbu dị oke mkpa na igbochi mgbasa nke RVF na mmadụ.

instruction: Kedu otu ọrịa (endemicity) FMD si emetụta ntinye ego na Zambia?
response: A na-eche na njupụta FMD bụ ihe kpatara ntinye ego na-adịghị mma na ngalaba anụ ụlọ nke obodo ahụ, ebe ndị na-etinye ego na-elekarị ihe ize ndụ nke ntiwapụ ọrịa anya dị ka ihe dị oke elu (too high) iji kwado ụgwọ ịbata (costs of entry). Echiche a nwere ike iduga na enweghị ntinye ego (lack of investment) na ngalaba ahụ, na-egbochi uto na mmepe ya. N'ihi ya, ụlọ ọrụ anụ ụlọ na Zambia nwere ike ịdọgbu onwe ya n'ọrụ iji ruo ikike ya zuru oke, na-emetụta ọnọdụ akụ na ụba na nchekwa nri n'ozuzu nke obodo ahụ.

instruction: CBPP ọ̀ bụ zoonotic (ọrịa anụmanụ na-efe mmadụ)?
response: Enweghị ihe akaebe na-egosi na mmadụ na-ebute CBPP, nke pụtara na ọ bụghị ọrịa a na-esi n'ahụ ehi bunye ndị mmadụ (transmitted from cattle to people). CBPP, ma ọ bụ Contagious Bovine Pleuro-pneumonia, na-emetụta ehi ma bụrụ nnukwu nchegbu maka ụlọ ọrụ anụ ụlọ na Nigeria, karịsịa na mpaghara ebe ọrịa a jupụtara.

instruction: Nsogbu nchoputa (Diagnostic pitfalls) nke ịmata Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) n'oge mmalite ọrịa (incubation phase)
response: Mgbe ị na-agbalị ịmata Lumpy Skin Disease na mmalite ya, otu n'ime nnukwu ihe ịma aka bụ na ihe ịrịba ama mbụ dị ka ahụ ọkụ na anya mmiri na-agba (lacrimation) anaghị akọwapụta kpọmkwem ma nwee ike iji ya nwee mgbagwoju anya ngwa ngwa na ọrịa ndị ọzọ. Ọ bụghị ruo izu 2-5 ka ibutere ọrịa ahụ ka ụdị ọnyá nodular (nodular lesions) na-amalite ịpụta, na-eme ka ọ dị oke mkpa iji nyochaa ehi gị anya nke ọma n'oge a ma tụlee usoro nchoputa ndị ọzọ dị ka nyocha ọbara ma ọ bụ PCR iji kwado ọnụnọ LSD.

instruction: Ịmata ahụhụ (tick vector) na-ebu Heartwater na Nigeria
response: Na Nigeria, ụdị ahụhụ bụ isi na-ahụ maka ibunye Heartwater, nke a makwaara dị ka Cowdriosis, bụ Amblyomma variegatum. Ụdị ahụhụ a bụ ihe dị ịrịba ama na-ebu (vector) ọrịa ahụ, nke na-emetụta ehi na anụ ụlọ ndị ọzọ. Ọ dị mkpa iji nyochaa maka Amblyomma variegatum na mpaghara gị ma kpachara anya dị mkpa iji gbochie mbuso agha nke ahụhụ na ibelata ihe ize ndụ nke nnyefe Heartwater.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ aha Hausa mpaghara maka Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) nke na-egosi 'oke ụkwara' (hacking cough)?
response: Aha Hausa obodo maka Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) bụ Huhu, nke na-ejikọta ya na njirimara 'ụkwara na-adịghị akwụsị akwụsị' n'ahụ ehi butere ọrịa ahụ. Ọrịa a bụ isi nchegbu n'ọtụtụ ìgwè ehi Nigeria, na ịmata mgbaàmà ya ozugbo dị oke mkpa maka njikwa na njikwa dị irè.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara nchoputa RVF na anụ ụlọ ji egbu oge (delayed)?
response: A na-achọpụta ntiwapụ ọrịa n'anụ ụlọ naanị mgbe achọpụtachara ya na mmadụ mpaghara ahụ, nke nwere ike iduga n'igbu oge n'ịchọpụta na idozi nsogbu ahụ n'ụmụ anụmanụ. Nke a bụ n'ihi na RVF nwere ike ịpụta n'ụzọ dị iche n'ime ụmụ mmadụ na anụ ụlọ, yana ihe mgbaàmà n'ime ụmụ anụmanụ nwere ike ịdị nro ma ọ bụ na-akọwaghị akọwa, na-eme ka ọ sie ike ịchọpụta ọrịa ahụ n'oge (detect the disease early on). N'ihi ya, ọ dị mkpa ịnọgide na-enwe oke nchezi ma mejuputa usoro nleba anya na nyocha oge niile iji nweta RVF n'anụ ụlọ tupu ọ gbasaa.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'ịgba ọsọ ụlọ mposi' (toilet run) ma ọ bụ 'nsị mmiri' (watery stool) n'ọkụkọ?
response: A na-akpọkarị afọ ọsịsa jikọtara na Newcastle Disease, Gumboro, ma ọ bụ coccidiosis 'toilet run' ma ọ bụ 'watery stool' na ọkụkọ. Ọnọdụ ndị a nwere ike ibute nnukwu nsogbu ahụike na ọbụna ọnwụ na nnụnụ, ya mere ọ dị mkpa ịchọpụta ihe kpatara ya wee mee ihe ozugbo iji gbochie mgbasa nke ọrịa.

instruction: Mmetụta nke mmachibido azụmahịa (trade ban) nke Ijipt n'afọ 2005/2006 na Ethiopia
response: Mmachibido iwu azụmahịa (trade ban) nke Ijipt n'afọ 2005/2006 nwere mmetụta dị ukwuu na Ethiopia, na-eme ka mba ahụ tụfuo ihe karịrị nde dọla US 14 na ego mbata (revenue). Ihe kpatara mmachibido iwu a bụ nchegbu maka ọrịa, nke butere nkwụsị na azụmahịa n'etiti mba abụọ ahụ.

instruction: Gịnị mere ịnweta ahịa (market access) ji dị ka ihe mgbochi dị elu (higher constraint) karịa ọrịa?
response: Ndị na-arụ ọrụ (Operators) na-ebute ihe ịma aka gbasara ego ozugbo (immediate financial hurdles) dị ka ịnweta ahịa (market access) na ọnụ ahịa nri karịa ihe ize ndụ ọrịa n'ihi na ihe ndị a bụ ihe ịma aka na-emetụta arụmọrụ ha kwa ụbọchị na uru ha nweta (bottom line). Ịnweta ahịa, karịsịa, bụ nnukwu nchegbu ebe ọ na-emetụta ikike ire ngwaahịa ha wee nweta ọnụ ahịa ziri ezi (fair prices), na-eme ka ọ bụrụ okwu dị mkpa karịa ihe egwu ọrịa, nke, ọ bụ ezie na ọ dị mkpa, a na-ahụkarị dị ka nsogbu oge ogologo.

instruction: Kedu mfu na-apụtaghị ìhè (indirect losses) nke FMD?
response: Ndị a gụnyere ọnụ ahịa njikwa (control costs), nyocha nyocha, na mmetụta ego nke ịnwepụ ikike ịbanye (denied access) n'ahịa mba ụwa.

instruction: Kedu otu ọnọdụ onye na-ebu ọrịa na-apụtaghị ìhè (latent carrier status) maka Infectious Bovine Rhinotracheitis (IBR) si egbochi azụmahịa?
response: Ehi butere ọrịa zoro ezo (Latently infected cattle) na-eje ozi dị ka isi iyi ọrịa a na-ahụkarị ma na-anọchi anya mmachi na azụmahịa mba ụwa (international trade). Nke a bụ n'ihi na ndị na-ebu ọrịa na-apụtaghị ìhè (latent carriers) nwere ike ịmaghị ama gbasaa nje ahụ n'ụmụ anụmanụ ndị ọzọ, nwere ike iduga ntiwapụ na mpaghara ma ọ bụ obodo ọhụrụ. N'ihi ya, mba nwere ike itinye ihe mgbochi n'ịbubata ehi site na mpaghara nwere oke IBR (IBR prevalence), iji chebe anụ ụlọ ha wee debe ọkwa enweghị ọrịa. Nke a nwere ike inwe nnukwu nsogbu akụ na ụba maka ndị ọrụ ugbo na ụlọ ọrụ anụ ụlọ n'ozuzu ya.

instruction: Otu RVF si apụta (Clinical presentation) na mmadụ na ụmụ ehi ọhụrụ (neonatal calves)
response: N'ime ụmụ mmadụ, RVF na-ejikarị ihe mgbaàmà yiri influenza pụta, mana n'ụmụ ehi a mụrụ ọhụrụ (neonatal calves), ọ na-akpata ọnọdụ siri ike ma na-eyi ndụ egwu (life-threatening condition), nke ejiri ahụ ọkụ, jaundice, na n'ụzọ dị mwute, ruo 100% ọnwụ (mortality). Nke a na-eme ka ọ pụta ìhè mkpa dị oke mkpa maka nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ ozugbo yana usoro nchekwa ndụ siri ike (strict biosecurity measures) iji gbochie mgbasa nke RVF na mpaghara ihe ize ndụ, karịsịa n'ógbè ebe ọrịa ahụ juru.

instruction: FMD ọ bụ ihe ize ndụ zoonotic?
response: A na-ewere FMD, ma ọ bụ Foot and Mouth Disease, dị ka obere ihe ize ndụ zoonotic na mmadụ. Nke a pụtara na ọ bụ ezie na ọ bụ isi ọrịa na-emetụta anụ ụlọ, e nwere obere ohere nke ibunye ya ndị mmadụ. Otú ọ dị, ọ ka dị mkpa iji aka nlezianya na-emeso anụmanụ butere ọrịa ahụ ma zere kọntaktị chiri anya (close contact) iji belata ihe ize ndụ ọ bụla nwere ike ime.

instruction: Kedu ihe 'ọnya ọnụ' (mouth sore) na 'ọnya ụkwụ' (leg sore) n'otu oge na ewu / atụrụ pụtara?
response: Mgbaàmà kpochapụwo nke Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). Ọrịa nje a na-efe efe na-emetụta ụmụ anụmanụ nwere ụkwụ gbawara agbawa (cloven-hoofed animals) dị ka ewu na atụrụ, na-akpata mmerụ ahụ ma ọ bụ ọnyá na ọnụ na ụkwụ ha, nke nwere ike ịkpata nkwarụ (lameness) na ahụ erughị ala. Ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụta mgbaàmà ndị a, ọ dị mkpa ikewapụ ụmụ anụmanụ metụtara ozugbo ma chọọ nlebara anya ahụike dọkịta anụmanụ iji gbochie mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ n'ụmụ anụmanụ ndị ọzọ na ìgwè gị.

instruction: Gịnị mere ndị na-arụ ọrụ feedlot (feedlot operators) ji eleghara ọrịa anya dị ka ihe mgbochi n'ime nnyocha (surveys)?
response: Ndị na-arụ ọrụ (Operators) na-agụnyekarị ịbanye n'ahịa (market access), ụgwọ nri, na ụkọ mmiri dị ka ihe ịma aka ndị dị oke mkpa karị, na-ekpuchi (overshadowing) ọrịa dị ka ihe mgbochi na nyocha ha.

instruction: Kedu otu ijikwa 'ụmụ eweghara ewegha' (aborted fetuses) si etinye ndị ọrụ n'ihe ize ndụ?
response: Mmekọrịta kpọmkwem (Direct contact) na anụ ahụ anụmanụ butere ọrịa n'oge oke ime ọpụpụ (abortion storms) bụ nnukwu ihe ize ndụ maka ọrịa mmadụ. Mgbe ha na-ejikwa ụmụ a mụchara (aborted fetuses), ndị ọrụ nọ n'ihe ize ndụ nke ibute ọrịa dị ka brucellosis, leptospirosis, na Q fever, nke a pụrụ ibunye site na ịkpọtụrụ anụ ahụ metụtara ọrịa, mmiri, ma ọ bụ gburugburu adịghị mma. Ọ dị mkpa ka ndị ọrụ na-eyi akụrụngwa nchebe onwe ha (personal protective equipment), gụnyere uwe aka (gloves), masks, na nchebe anya (eye protection), na ịgbaso usoro biosecurity kwesịrị ekwesị iji belata ihe ize ndụ nke ibute ọrịa.

instruction: Kedu ihe dị iche n'etiti 'anya kpuchiri ekpuchi' (dull eye) na 'anya na-enwu gbaa' (shine eye)?
response: Anya na-enwu gbaa bụ ihe ịrịba ama nke anụmanụ dị mma ma mụrụ anya (alert animal), ebe anya gbara ọchịchịrị na-egosi ọrịa na-adịghị ala ala (systemic illness), akpịrị ịkpọ nkụ (dehydration), ma ọ bụ ihe mgbu na anụmanụ.

instruction: Kedu ọrụ njikwa ihe ndị na-ebu nje (vector control) na-arụ na igbochi RVF?
response: Njikwa Vector na-ekere òkè dị mkpa n'igbochi Rift Valley Fever (RVF), mana ọ nwere ike bụrụ ihe ịma aka n'ihi agwa dị iche iche na mgbagwoju anya nke vector anwụnta. Anwụnta ndị a nwere omume gburugburu ebe obibi dịgasị iche iche (varying ecological habits), na-eme ka ọ sie ike itinye usoro njikwa dị irè. Otú ọ dị, enwere ike ịnweta ịchịkwa ndị bi n'anwụnta site na nchikota nke ụzọ ndị dị ka iwepụ ebe ọmụmụ, iji ọgwụ na-egbu ahụhụ (insecticides), na iwebata ndị na-ahụ maka njikwa ndu (biological control agents) dị ka anwụnta larvae na-eri anụ (mosquito larvae predators). Site na ibelata ọnụ ọgụgụ anwụnta, enwere ike ịbelata ihe egwu nnyefe RVF nke ukwuu, mana ọ dị mkpa iburu n'obi na njikwa nje (vector control) na-akachasị dị irè ma ejiri ya na usoro mgbochi ndị ọzọ dị ka ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa (vaccination) yana nchọpụta ọrịa n'oge (early disease detection).

instruction: Kedu otu 'rumen atony' si arụ ọrụ dị ka ihe ịrịba ama ụlọ ọgwụ nke BRD na ehi (feedlot cattle)?
response: Rumen atony bụ ihe ịrịba ama ụlọ ọgwụ dị ịrịba ama nke Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD) n'ụlọ nri ehi. Ọ na-apụta dị ka gaunt abdomen (afọ na-enweghị nri), nke bụ ngosipụta doro anya nke ọrịa ahụ. Mgbe rumen emetụta, ọ nwere ike iduga mbelata n'iri nri (feed intake), mgbari mgbari belata (reduced digestion), yana adịghị mma n'ozuzu na anụmanụ. A na-ejikọta nke a na mgbaàmà ndị ọzọ dị ka ịda mbà (lethargy), mfu agụụ (loss of appetite), na ike iku ume (difficulty breathing). Ekwesịrị ịkpọtụrụ onye na-ahụ maka anụmanụ iji gosi nchoputa ahụ (confirm the diagnosis) ma nye ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị iji gbochie nsogbu ndị ọzọ.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara AI nwere ike iji kọwahie (misinterpret) ebe etiti 'sit-fast' (necrotic cores) na LSD?
response: Nodules na-abụ necrotic (akụkụ nwụrụ anwụ) wee kewapụ na akpụkpọ anụ gbara ya gburugburu dị ka etiti 'sit-fast' (sit-fast cores), nke bụ ihe e ji amata ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: Ịghọta Rift Valley Fever (RVF) n'anụ ụlọ
response: A na-achọpụtakarị Rift Valley Fever (RVF) na anụ ụlọ naanị ma enyochaa ya n'ahụ mmadụ, nke nwere ike bụrụ nsogbu maka itinye ọnụ n'oge mbụ (early intervention). Ọnụ ọgụgụ buru ibu nke ime ọpụpụ (near-simultaneous abortions) n'otu oge bụ ihe nrịba ama nke ntiwapụ RVF na ụmụ anụmanụ, na-eje ozi dị ka onye nche (sentinel) maka ntiwapụ mmadụ (human outbreaks). N'ikwu ya n'ụzọ ọzọ, 'oké ime ọpụpụ' (abortion storms) a nwere ike igosi ọnụnọ nke RVF na mpaghara gị, na-enye ohere maka ime ihe ozugbo (prompt action) iji kpuchido ma anụmanụ ma ahụike mmadụ.

instruction: Kedu ụmụ nje (pathogen) na-akpata Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD)?
response: Ihe na-akpata Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) bụ Neethling virus, nke so na Capripoxvirus genus. Nje virus a na-ahụ maka mmerụ akpụkpọ ahụ nwere mkpụkọ (lumpy skin lesions) na mgbaàmà ndị ọzọ metụtara LSD na ehi.

instruction: Kedu isi ọdịiche dị n'ahụike n'etiti FMD na Bovine Ephemeral Fever (BEF)?
response: FMD na-akpata ọfụma ma ọ bụ mmebi (distinctive vesicles or erosions) n'ọnụ na n'ụkwụ, ebe Bovine Ephemeral Fever (BEF) na-ebute nkwarụ mberede (sudden lameness), mgbu ụkwụ na-agbanwe agbanwe (shifting leg pain), na oke ahụ ọkụ, mana na-enweghị ọfụma pụrụ iche (characteristic vesicles) metụtara FMD.

instruction: Gịnị bụ ngosipụta ahụike na-emekarị nke African Animal Trypanosomiasis (AAT) na zebu cattle?
response: Ịta ahụ na-adịghị ala ala (Chronic wasting), ụkọ ọbara na-aga n'ihu (progressive anaemia), na ahụ ọkụ na-ebilikarị (intermittent fever) bụ ngosipụta ahụike na-ahụkarị nke African Animal Trypanosomiasis (AAT) na zebu cattle. Mgbaàmà ndị a nwere ike ịbụ n'ihi mmetụta nje (parasite) na-enwe na mkpụrụ ndụ ọbara uhie nke anụmanụ (red blood cells) yana ahụike n'ozuzu ya, na-eduga n'ịjiri nwayọọ daa mbà n'ọnọdụ anụmanụ ma ọ bụrụ na a gwọghị ya.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'dry cow' (ehi kpọrọ nkụ) na gbasara ọrịa?
response: Ehi na-enye nwa ara (lactating cow) nke kwụsịrị na mberede ịmịpụta mmiri ara ehi n'ihi nchekasị (stress), mastitis, ma ọ bụ ọrịa. Nke a nwere ike ịbụ ọnọdụ dị oke egwu, n'ihi na ehi akọrọ na-enwekarị ọrịa ma chọọ njikwa nke ọma iji gbochie nsogbu ndị ọzọ, dị ka ọrịa udder (udder infections) ma ọ bụ nsogbu ahụike ndị ọzọ.

instruction: Gịnị bụ mkpa nke 'tsetse belt' dị?
response: Belt tsetse bụ mpaghara gburugburu ebe obibi (geographic zone) na Middle Belt ebe ijiji tsetse jupụtara. Mpaghara a dị ịrịba ama n'ihi na ijiji tsetse bụ isi ihe na-ebute (primary vectors) trypanosomiasis, nke a makwaara dị ka nagana, ọrịa na-emebi emebi nke na-emetụta ehi na anụ ụlọ ndị ọzọ. Belt tsetse na-ebute oke iyi egwu nye ịzụ anụ ụlọ na ọrụ ugbo n'ọhịa na mpaghara a, na-eme ka ọ dị mkpa ka ndị ọrụ ugbo mee ihe iji gbochie ma chịkwaa mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'fara' na gbasara ahụike anụ ụlọ?
response: Blowfly strike, nke a makwaara dị ka myiasis, bụ ọnọdụ siri ike ebe ikpuru (maggots) na-amụba n'ọnyá dị na anụmanụ gị. Nke a nwere ike na-agbawa obi karịsịa maka atụrụ, ewu, na anụ ụlọ ndị ọzọ, ebe ọ nwere ike iduga oke mgbu, ibute ọrịa (infection), na ọbụna ọnwụ ma a gwọghị ya. Iji gbochie fara, hụ na a na-asachapụ ọnyá (wounds) anụmanụ gị ma kee ya akwa ozugbo, tụleekwa itinye ọgwụgwọ topical iji gbochie ijiji (blowflies).

instruction: Kedu otu esi ebufekarị Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) n'etiti ehi na ìgwè (herd)?
response: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) na-agbasa n'etiti ehi na ìgwè ehi site n'ikuku (aerosol transmission) na mmekọrịta ozugbo (direct contact) na mmiri na-esi n'afụ pụta (vesicular fluid). Nnyefe aerosol na-eme mgbe anụmanụ butere ọrịa na-akwa ụkwara, uzere (sneezes), ma ọ bụ na-eku ume, na-ebute nje virus n'ime ikuku, nke ụmụ anụmanụ ndị ọzọ nwere ike kukuo. Mmekọrịta ozugbo na mmiri afụ (vesicular fluid) na-eme mgbe ọnyá ma ọ bụ ọnya (blisters or sores) anụmanụ metụtara na-abata n'ahụ ma ọ bụ akpụkpọ anụ (mucous membranes) nke anụmanụ ọzọ, na-ekwe ka nje virus banye onye na-ebu ọhụrụ. Ụzọ nnyefe abụọ a nwere ike iduga mgbasa FMD ngwa ngwa n'ime ìgwè, na-eme ka ọ dị mkpa itinye usoro nchekwa ndụ (biosecurity measures) siri ike iji gbochie nnabata na mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: Gịnị bụ aha mpaghara (local term) maka idide (maggot) ju n'ọnyá?
response: N'mpaghara gị, mbuso ikpuru n'ọnyá (maggot infestation in wounds) a na-akpọkarị 'Worm dey inside the wound' ma ọ bụ 'maggot wound.' Ndị ọrụ ugbo obodo (local farmers) na ndị na-elekọta anụmanụ na-ejikarị okwu a kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ikpuru gbajupụtara na ọnyá (maggots have infested a wound), na-edugakarị na nsogbu ndị ọzọ (further complications) na ibute ọrịa.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ ECF?
response: East Coast Fever bụ nnukwu ihe ize ndụ maka ewebata ụdị ehi mmiri ara (exotic dairy breeds). Ọ bụ ọrịa ụmụ ahụhụ na-ebute (tick-borne disease) nke nwere ike inwe mmetụta jọgburu onwe ya na ehi, ọkachasị ndị si n'akụkụ ebe ọrịa a na-abụghị nke obodo (not native). Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme atụmatụ ịmebata ụdị ọhụrụ n'ugbo gị, gbaa mbọ hụ na ị kpachara anya iji gbochie mgbasa nke ECF, dị ka ijikwa usoro njikwa ahụhụ (tick control measures) na ileba anya n'ìgwè ehi gị anya (monitoring your herd) mgbe niile.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa anụmanụ bụ njirimara 'ire osisi' (woody tongue)?
response: Actinobacillosis, nke nje bacteria Actinobacillus lignieresii kpatara, bụ nnukwu ọrịa na ehi nke a na-ejikarị mara ya na 'ire osisi' pụrụ iche (distinctive 'woody tongue'). Ọnọdụ a na-abụkarị n'ihi nje bacteria na-ebute ire (infecting the tongue), na-eduga ná njigide (hardening) na nrụrụ nke anụ ahụ ire (deformation of the tongue tissue), nke nwere ike ịkpata nnukwu nsogbu na ihe isi ike maka anụmanụ ahụ iri nri ma ọ bụ ịṅụ ihe ọṅụṅụ. Actinobacillosis nwekwara ike imetụta akụkụ ahụ ndị ọzọ, gụnyere ngụgụ, imeju, na nkwonkwo, na a na-agbasakarị ya site na mmekọrịta kpọmkwem na ụmụ anụmanụ (infected animals) butere ọrịa ahụ ma ọ bụ nri na mmiri na-adịghị mma.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ okwu mpaghara (local term) maka post-parturient hypocalcaemia (milk fever)?
response: Na Nigeria, okwu mpaghara maka post-parturient hypocalcaemia, nke a makwaara dị ka mmiri ara ehi ọkụ (milk fever), bụ 'Ehi ahụ adaala' (The cow don fall) ma ọ bụ n'asụsụ Yoruba, 'malu wo'. Ọnọdụ a na-eme mgbe ọkwa calcium nke ehi dara (drops) mgbe o mụsịrị nwa, na-eduga n'ihe mgbaàmà dị ka adịghị ike uru ahụ, ịma jijiji (tremors), na ike iguzo ọtọ. Ọ dị mkpa ịmata ihe nrịba ama (recognize the signs) ma chọọ nlekọta ahụike anụmanụ ngwa ngwa (veterinary care promptly) iji gbochie nsogbu (complications) na ịhụ na mgbake ehi ahụ dị mma.

instruction: Kedu ọrịa zoonotic (zoonotic disease) na-akpata undulant fever (ahụ ọkụ na-abịakarị) na ụmụ mmadụ na ime ọpụpụ (abortion) na njedebe atọ (third trimester) n'ime ehi?
response: Brucellosis, nke nje bacteria (bacteria) Brucella abortus kpatara, bụ ọrịa zoonotic nke na-emetụta ma ụmụ mmadụ ma ehi. N'ime ụmụ mmadụ, ọ nwere ike ibute undulant fever, nke e ji ihe ngosipụta na-emekarị nke ahụ ọkụ (fever), ọsụsọ (sweating), na mgbu uru ahụ (muscle pain) mara. N'ime ehi, Brucella abortus nwere ike ịkpata ime ọpụpụ (abortion) na njedebe atọ (third trimester) nke ịtụrụ ime (pregnancy), na-eduga ná nnukwu mfu akụ na ụba (economic losses) maka ndị ọrụ ugbo. A na-agbasakarị ọrịa a site na ịkpọtụrụ anụ ahụ anụmanụ butere ọrịa ahụ (infected animal tissues), dị ka placentas ma ọ bụ ụmụ eweghara ewegha (aborted fetuses), ma ọ bụ site na mmiri ara ehi ma ọ bụ ngwaahịa mmiri ara ehi merụrụ emerụ (contaminated dairy products).

instruction: Gịnị ka 'afọ buru ibu' (big stomach) — nke na-abụghị ịtụrụ ime (not pregnancy) — na ewu pụtara?
response: Afọ mbịkọ (Bloat), ascites (nchikota mmiri), ma ọ bụ nnukwu ọrịa ikpuru (severe worm infestation), nke a makwaara dị ka bottle jaw, niile nwere ike bụrụ ihe nwere ike ime ka afọ ewu yie ka ọ buru ibu. Ọrịa afọ mbịkọ (Bloat) na-eme mgbe afọ ewu na-ejupụta na gas, na-abụkarị n'ihi iribiga nri kpọrọ nkụ akụkụ (dry feed) ma ọ bụ ịṅụ oke mmiri. Ascites bụ ọnọdụ ebe mmiri na-agbakọta na afọ, nke ọrịa imeju ma ọ bụ nsogbu ahụike ndị ọzọ nwere ike ibute. Nnukwu ikpuru gbajupụtara (Severe worm infestation), n'aka nke ọzọ, nwere ike ibute agba zaghị aza (swollen jaw) na afọ n'ihi na ikpuru dị n'ahụ ewu. Ọ dị mkpa ịgakwuru onye dọkịta anụmanụ (veterinarian) iji chọpụta ihe kpatara ya ma wepụta ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị (necessary treatment).

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ okwu mpaghara (local term) maka Marek's Disease?
response: A na-akpọkarị Marek's Disease 'Leg paralysis disease' ma ọ bụ 'wing drop disease' n'okwu mpaghara.

instruction: Kedu ụzọ na-ahụkarị (typical route) nke nnyefe maka Bovine Tuberculosis na ìgwè ehi ịta ahịhịa (pastoral herds)?
response: Bovine Tuberculosis na-ebute ọrịa n'ime ìgwè anụ ọhịa site na ụzọ iku ume (respiratory route), karịsịa site na ikuku (inhalation), na-emekarị n'oge ịhịa ibe ha nso n'abalị (close huddling at night) mgbe ụmụ anụmanụ na-anọrịrị n'akụkụ ibe ha. Mmekọrịta chiri anya (close contact) a na-enyere nje bacteria aka ịgbasa ngwa ngwa site n'otu anụmanụ gaa na nke ọzọ, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ usoro mgbasa ozi na-ahụkarị (common mode of transmission) n'ime ntọala ìgwè ehi (herd settings).

instruction: Kedu ihe 'sit-fast' lesions jikọtara ya na?
response: Ọnyá njirimara (characteristic) 'sit-fast' jikọtara ya na Necrotic centers nke Lumpy Skin Disease nodules na-emecha adapụ (slough off).

instruction: Kedu ọrụ flunixin meglumine na-arụ n'ịgwọ ọrịa FMD?
response: A na-ejikarị Flunixin meglumine eme ihe na njikọ nke ọgwụ nje (antibiotics) iji nyere aka na njikwa ikpe Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). A kọwo na ọ nwere mmeghachi omume usoro magburu onwe ya (excellent systemic response) mgbe ejiri ya n'akụkụ ọgwụ nje, nke nwere ike inye aka ibelata ihe mgbaàmà (alleviate the symptoms) na ịkwado ahụike zuru oke (overall health) nke anụmanụ metụtara.

instruction: Ịghọta CBPP na ehi
response: N'ime nlele (post-mortem) nke ehi nwere contagious bovine pleuropneumonia (CBPP), 'sequestrum' bụ akụkụ anụ ahụ ngụgụ nwụrụ anwụ nke ihe nfụkọrịta (fibrous tissue) kpuchiri. Nke a bụ nchọpụta dị ịrịba ama (significant finding), ebe ọ na-egosi ọrịa na-adịghị ala ala (chronic infection) na ọnọdụ onye na-ebu ọrịa ahụ (carrier status). Ọnụnọ nke sequestrum na-egosi na ehi ahụ enweela CBPP ogologo oge ma nwee ike ibunye ọrịa ahụ n'ụmụ anụmanụ ndị ọzọ, ọbụlagodi ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị ka ahụike (healthy). Nke a bụ nleba anya dị mkpa maka ndị na-azụ ehi (cattle farmers), n'ihi na ọ nwere ike imetụta ahụike na nrụpụta (productivity) nke ìgwè ha n'ozuzu ya.

instruction: Ịmata nje ndị dị n'ime (internal parasites) na ehi Nigeria
response: Haemonchus placei, nke a makwaara dị ka Barber's pole worm, bụ isi ihe nje dị n'ime na-ahụ maka 'bottle jaw' ma ọ bụ submandibular oedema na ehi Nigeria n'oge mmiri ozuzo. Nje a (parasite) na-eto n'ọnọdụ mmiri mmiri (wet conditions) ma nwee ike ibute nnukwu nsogbu ahụike (health issues) na ehi, ya mere ọ dị mkpa iji nyochaa ìgwè ehi gị nke ọma wee mejuputa usoro njikwa ahụhụ dị irè (effective parasite control measures) iji gbochie mmụba.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara ezinụlọ (clan) Rahaji ji gbanwere ehi ọbara ọbara ha maka Bunaji mgbe ha na-akwaga n'ebe ndịda (south)?
response: Ndị ezinụlọ Rahaji gbanwere ehi ọbara ọbara (red stock) ha maka ehi Bunaji mgbe ha na-akwaga n'ebe ndịda n'ihi ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnwụ (high mortality) dị elu n'etiti anụmanụ ọbara ọbara (red animals). Ehi Bunaji na-esikarị ike (resilient) ma daba adaba maka ihu igwe ndịda (southern climate), na-eme ka ha bụrụ nhọrọ kacha baa uru (practical choice) maka ebe obibi ọhụrụ ezinụlọ ahụ.

instruction: Kedu ihe abụọ ụdị Rahaji anaghị anabata nke ọma?
response: A maara ụdị Rahaji maka inwe mmetụta (sensitive) n'ihe abụọ kachasị: ọrịa ndị metụtara iru mmiri (humidity-related diseases) na nri adịghị mma (poor nutrition). Iru mmiri dị elu nwere ike ibute nsogbu iku ume (respiratory issues) na nsogbu ahụike ndị ọzọ, ebe nri na-enweghị nri (nutrients) dị mkpa nwere ike imebi ahụike (overall health) na nrụpụta (productivity) ụmụ anụmanụ. Ọ dị mkpa iji hụ na ebe obibi ikuku na-eku nke ọma (well-ventilated) yana ezigbo nri (balanced diet) maka ụdị Rahaji iji hụ na ezigbo ahụike na ọdịmma ha dị mma.

instruction: Ihe ọzọ pụrụ iche maka FMD karịa antimicrobial
response: Tri-Solfen bụ nhazi ọnya nkwụnwụ ahụ mpaghara (topical anesthetic wound formulation) nke na-enye ihe ọzọ na-abụghị nke nje (non-antimicrobial alternative) maka Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). Achọpụtala na ọ ka mma karịa parenteral oxytetracycline na nnwale ubi (field trials), na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nhọrọ bara uru maka ijikwa FMD n'ụzọ na-adabereghị n'ịgwọ ọgwụ nje (antimicrobial treatments).

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara 'obere mpaghara' (small colony ma ọ bụ SC) nke Mycoplasma mycoides subsp. mycoides (Mmm) ji bụrụ ihe a na-elekwasị anya n'ihe gbasara Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP)?
response: Mmm, nke a maara na mbụ dị ka ụdị 'obere mpaghara' (small colony), bụ nje a kapịrị ọnụ na-akpata (causative agent) CBPP nke na-aga n'ihu na-enye Sub-Saharan Africa nsogbu (plague). Nje bacteria a na-ahụ maka ọrịa na-emebi ihe nke na-emetụta ìgwè ehi, na-ebute mfu akụ na ụba (economic losses) dị ịrịba ama yana nchegbu ọdịmma anụmanụ (animal welfare). Dị ka isi ihe lekwasịrị anya (primary focus), Mmm bụ ebumnuche nyocha (target of research), usoro njikwa (control measures), na mbọ mgbochi (vaccination efforts) iji belata mmetụta nke CBPP na mpaghara ahụ.

instruction: Gịnị bụ kpochapụwo njirimara ahụike (hallmark clinical sign) nke Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) na nnukwu ikpe (acute cases)?
response: Ihe e ji amata ụlọ ọgwụ nke Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) n'ọnọdụ nnukwu ọrịa (acute cases) bụ nnukwu nsogbu iku ume (severe respiratory distress), nke a makwaara dị ka dyspnoea, na ụdị pụrụ iche (characteristic) 'elbows-out' nke onye ọrịa. Ọnọdụ a bụ n'ihi mbọ anụmanụ na-agba imezi (expand) oghere igbe ya (chest cavity) iji kwụọ ụgwọ maka ike iku ume (difficulty in breathing), na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe ngosi (key indicator) nke ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: Kedu otu ogo (size) nke ụdị Muturu si metụta nnabata ya na trypanosomiasis (tolerance of trypanosomiasis)?
response: Ụdị Muturu bụ ụdị nwere obere ahụ (small-bodied breed) nwere nnabata eke (natural tolerance) dị elu — a na-akpọ ya (trypanotolerance) — nye ọrịa ahụ, nke pụtara na o nwere ike ịnagide (withstand) mmetụta trypanosomiasis nke ọma karịa ụdị ukwuu.

instruction: Gịnị mere nkwenye ụlọ nyocha (laboratory confirmation) ji dị mkpa maka FMD n'Africa?
response: Ihe mgbaàmà FMD na ahụike nwere ike ịdịgasị site na nke dị nro ruo na nke siri ike, nke na-eme ka o sie ike ịchọpụta dabere naanị na mgbaàmà (symptoms alone). Nkwenye ụlọ nyocha dị mkpa maka nchoputa ziri ezi (accurate diagnosis), na ọ na-achọ ikewapụ na njirimara nke nje virus (virus) site na usoro ọdịnala (culture) ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa (molecular techniques), dị ka PCR ma ọ bụ ELISA. Nke a dị oke mkpa n'Africa, ebe FMD jupụtara na nwere ike inwe mmetụta akụ na ụba dị ukwuu (significant economic impacts) na ọrụ ugbo (livestock farming). N'enweghị nkwenye ụlọ nyocha, nchoputa adịghị mma (misdiagnosis) nwere ike iduga ọgwụgwọ adịghị mma (inappropriate treatment) na usoro njikwa (control measures), nke nwere ike imezi (exacerbate) mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ.

instruction: Ịkwado ụdị (Confirming serotypes) nje FMD
response: Maka ịkwado ụdị (serotypes) nje FMD, ule nchoputa (diagnostic test) a na-ewere dị ka ọkọlọtọ ọla edo (gold standard) bụ ELISA ma ọ bụ PCR, karịsịa na vesicular fluid (mmiri ọfụma) ma ọ bụ epithelium. ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay) na PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) abụọ bụ usoro nwere mmetụta dị elu (highly sensitive) yana nke a kapịrị ọnụ (specific methods) maka ịchọpụta nje FMD. Mgbe ị na-eji ule ndị a, ọ dị mkpa ịnakọta ma nyochaa ihe nlele (samples) site na vesicular fluid ma ọ bụ epithelium, n'ihi na nke a na-enye nsonaazụ kacha zie ezie (most accurate results). Usoro a na-enyere aka ikwenye ọnụnọ (confirm the presence) nke FMD virus serotypes pụrụ iche, nke dị oke mkpa maka itinye usoro njikwa (targeted control measures) yana igbochi mgbasa nke ọrịa ahụ ozugbo.

instruction: Gịnị bụ 'mmiri maka afọ' (water for the belly)?
response: Ascites, na-ejikọta ya na nkụda obi (heart failure) ma ọ bụ ọrịa imeju (liver disease), bụ ọnọdụ ebe mmiri (fluid) na-agbakọta na oghere afọ (abdominal cavity), na-enye mpụta nke 'mmiri maka afọ'.

instruction: Kedu ụdị ahụhụ (tick species) bụ isi na-ebu Heartwater (Ehrlichia ruminantium) na Nigeria?
response: Amblyomma variegatum bụ ụdị ahụhụ (tick species) bụ isi na-ahụ maka ịnyefe Heartwater, nke a makwaara dị ka Cowdriosis, na Nigeria. A na-ekesa ụdị ahụhụ a n'ọtụtụ ebe n'ofe mba ahụ ma bụrụ onye na-ebu (significant vector) maka ọrịa a, nke nwere ike ibute ọrịa siri ike (severe illness) na ọnwụ na ehi na anụmanụ ndị ọzọ.

instruction: Oge nro (Incubation period) maka Lumpy Skin Disease n'okpuru ọnọdụ mpaghara
response: Oge nro (incubation period) maka Lumpy Skin Disease n'okpuru ọnọdụ ubi (field conditions) na-adịkarị site na izu 2 ruo 4. Nke a pụtara na mgbe ekpughere ehi n'ọrịa (virus) ahụ, ọ nwere ike iwepụta oge ọ bụla (take anywhere) site na izu 2 ruo 4 ka mgbaàmà pụta. Ọ dị mkpa nyochaa ìgwè ehi gị anya (monitor your herd closely) n'oge a ma mee ihe ngwa ngwa (take prompt action) ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụta ihe ịrịba ama ọ bụla nke ọrịa ahụ, dị ka ọnya anụ ahụ (skin lesions) ma ọ bụ ahụ ọkụ (fever).

instruction: Kedu ihe 'ehi ahụ anaghị atụfu ime' (the cow don't abort) na-egosi?
response: Ọnwụ ime na mberede (Spontaneous loss of pregnancy) bụ nnukwu okwu na ehi, nke a na-akpọkarị 'the cow don't abort' (a maara ya n'ezie ka ọpụpụ n'emeghị ihe ọ bụla) na mpaghara (local parlance). Nke a nwere ike bụrụ ọkọlọtọ na-acha ọbara ọbara (red flag) maka brucellosis, ọrịa zoonotic nke na-emetụta ehi ma nwee ike ibunye ya mmadụ. Ihe e ji amata brucellosis bụ nsogbu ịmụ nwa (reproductive problems), gụnyere ime ọpụpụ mberede (spontaneous abortion), nwa nwụrụ anwụ (stillbirths), na amụghị nwa (infertility). Ọ bụrụ na ị hụ oge ime ọpụpụ ugboro ugboro n'ìgwè ehi gị, ọ dị mkpa ịgakwuru dọkịta anụmanụ (consult a veterinarian) iji wepụ (rule out) brucellosis na ihe ndị ọzọ nwere ike ibute ya.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'ahụ ọkụ nnyefe' (transit fever) ma ọ bụ 'ahụ ọkụ njem' (shipping fever)?
response: Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD) na-abụkarị n'ihi nchekasị nke njem (stress of transport), nke a na-akpọkarị 'transit fever' ma ọ bụ 'shipping fever'. Ọnọdụ a nwere ike ịkpata site na njikọta ihe dị iche iche (combination of factors), gụnyere nrụgide anụ ahụ (physical stress) nke na-ebugharị ehi, mgbanwe na okpomọkụ (temperature) na iru mmiri (humidity), na mkpughe n'ebe ndị na-ebute ọrịa (pathogens) nọ n'oge njem.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'kịtịkpa maka ewu / atụrụ' (chicken pox for goat/sheep)?
response: Sheep and Goat Pox (SGP) bụ ọnọdụ ị na-ezo aka na ya. Ọ bụ ọrịa nje viral na-emetụta ma atụrụ ma ewu, na-akpata mgbaàmà dị ka ọnyá anụ ahụ (skin lesions), ahụ ọkụ, na enweghị agụụ nri (loss of appetite). SGP na-efe efe nke ukwuu (highly contagious) ma nwee ike ibunye site na ịkpọtụrụ ozugbo na anụmanụ butere ọrịa ma ọ bụ ihe adịghị mma (contaminated materials). Ọ bụrụ na ị na-enyo enyo na ewu gị nwere oria, ọ dị mkpa ikewapụ ha ozugbo ma jụọ onye ọrụ anụmanụ mpaghara (local veterinary officer) maka nyocha (diagnosis) na ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị (proper treatment).

instruction: Kedu ihe atọ bụ isi na-egbochi (limiting factors) ụdị White Fulani?
response: A mara ụdị White Fulani maka ọganihu uto ya (impressive growth rate) dị mma yana ikike ịmịpụta (production potential) mmiri ara ehi dị elu, ma ọ na-echekwa ihe ịma aka dị iche iche ihu. Isi ihe atọ na-egbochi (limiting factors) ụdị a bụ tozuru oke mmekọahụ n'oge adịghị anya (late sexual maturity), nke pụtara na ha na-ewe ogologo oge iji ruo afọ ịmụ nwa (reproductive age), ogologo oge ịmụ nwa (long calving interval), nke bụ oge dị n'etiti ịmụ nwa, na nwa obere oge (short lactation), nke bụ oge mmepụta mmiri ara ehi mgbe amuchara nwa. Ihe ndị a nwere ike imetụta ahụike na arụmọrụ (productivity and efficiency) n'ozuzu nke ụdị White Fulani na mpaghara gị.

instruction: Gịnị bụ anụ ahụ kacha dị iche (most distinctive physical feature) nke mpi ehi Kuri (Kuri cattle horns)?
response: A maara ehi Kuri maka mpi ha (distinctive horns) pụrụ iche, nke fụrụ afụ (inflated) na nwekwara anya spongy n'ile anya. Njirimara a pụrụ iche na-ekewa ha pụọ na ụdị ndị ọzọ na ọ bụ ihe pụtara ìhè (notable feature) na ụmụ anụmanụ ndị a.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ ụtụ isi 'Jangali' (Jangali tax)?
response: Ụtụ 'Jangali' bụ akụkọ ihe mere eme (historical) ma na-adị ugbu a dị ka ụtụ (tax levied) a na-atụ n'isi ehi. Ọ bụ nnukwu ibu ego (financial burden) nye ọtụtụ ndị na-azụ anụ ụlọ, ọkachasị n'ime ime obodo ebe ehi bụ nnukwu isi mbata (source of income) na ibi ndụ (livelihood).

instruction: Kedu ụdị (breed) kachasị ukwuu ma gbasaa na Nigeria?
response: White Fulani, nke a makwaara dị ka Bunaji, bụ ụdị kachasị ukwuu na nke gbasara ebe niile (most widespread breed) na Nigeria. Ha bụ ụdị ehi na-agbasi ike ma na-agbanwe agbanwe (hardy and adaptable), dabara adaba na ihu igwe dị iche iche (diverse climate) na mpaghara ala nke mba ahụ. Ebe ogo ha dị egwu (impressive size) na nrụpụta mmiri ara ehi (high milk production) dị elu, ọ bụghị ihe ijuanya na a na-ahụ ha n'ọtụtụ akụkụ nke mba ahụ, site na savannas ruo na ala ahịhịa (grasslands).

instruction: Gịnị bụ 'akuya', 'bunsuru', na 'biri akuya'?
response: Akuya na-ezo aka na ewu nwunye (doe or female goat), ebe bunsuru ma ọ bụ biri akuya na-akọwapụta oke ewu (buck, which is the male goat). Ịghọta usoro ndị a dị mkpa maka ndị ọrụ ugbo Nigeria ijikwa ìgwè ewu ha (manage their goat herds) nke ọma wee mee mkpebi ziri ezi (informed decisions) gbasara ịzụ, inye nri, na nlekọta ahụike.

instruction: Ịmata ụdị ehi 'enweghị mkpọ' (humpless) n'akwụkwọ ndị Nigeria
response: Ụdị a kọwara dị ka 'humpless' (na-enweghị akpụ) nwere azụ kwụ ọtọ (straight back) yana nnukwu ọkpọiso (broad forehead) n'akwụkwọ Nigeria bụ Muturu ma ọ bụ N'Dama. Ejiri ụdị abụọ a mara maka njirimara anụ ahụ pụrụ iche (distinctive physical characteristics), nke na-edobe ha iche n'ụdị ehi ndị ọzọ dị na mpaghara ahụ.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara eji bubata (imported) ehi N'dama na Nigeria?
response: Ebubatara (imported) ehi N'dama na Nigeria n'ihi otu àgwà ha pụrụ iche (unique trait) nke ịbụ ndị na-anabata trypano (trypano-tolerant), nke pụtara na ha nwere mmasị iguzogide ọrịa (resistant) ahụ nke ijiji na-ebute (tsetse fly-borne disease) nke na-emetụta ọtụtụ ụdị ehi obodo. Ọzọkwa, ha buru ibu karịa ụdị Muturu, na-eme ka ha bụrụ ihe onwunwe bara uru (valuable asset) nye ndị ọrụ ugbo Nigeria na-achọ ịbawanye mmepụta anụ ụlọ ha na mkpụrụ anụ ha (meat yield).

instruction: A na-eme atụmatụ ịwepụ ahịa kwa afọ (off-take rate per annum) maka ehi na-ata ahịhịa n'ala obodo (communal rangelands)
response: Maka ehi na-ata ahịhịa ọdịnala (communal rangelands), ọnụ ahịa iwepụ atụmatụ kwa afọ (estimated off-take rate per annum) nwere ike ịdịgasị iche dabere n'ihe ndị dị ka nrụgide ịta ahịhịa (grazing pressure), mmiri ozuzo (rainfall), na ogo ala (land quality). Agbanyeghị, ọnụọgụ e hotara (commonly cited range) nke ukwuu dị n'etiti 2 na 10% kwa afọ, nke pụtara na site na ngụkọta ọnụ ọgụgụ ehi (total cattle population), enwere ike iwezuga ma ọ bụ gbuo 2 ruo 10% kwa afọ iji kwado ìgwè ahụike (sustainable herd). Ogo nke a (rate) nwere ike ibute (influenced) ọnọdụ ndị akọwapụtara n'ugbo gị ma ọ bụ mpaghara gị, ya mere ọ dị mkpa iji nyochaa (monitor) mgbanwe anụmanụ gị wee megharịa (adjust) atụmatụ iwepụ gị n'ụzọ dabara adaba.

instruction: Kedu agro-industrial by-product na Nigeria bụ isi mmalite (major source of energy) n'ihe oriri (cattle rations) ehi?
response: Bran ọka (Maize bran) na irighiri ọka wit (wheat offal) bụ nnukwu agro-industrial by-products na Nigeria nke na-arụ ọrụ dị ka isi mmalite nke ike n'ịnye nri ehi. Mkpo ọka (Maize bran), karịsịa, bụ nri nwere fiber dị elu site na usoro egwe ọka, ebe irighiri ọka wit bụ by-product na mmepụta ntụ ọka (wheat flour production). Enwere ike iji ha abụọ wepụta ike (essential energy) dị mkpa maka ehi, ọkachasị n'oge agụụ (high demand) ma ọ bụ mgbe isi mmalite ike ndị ọzọ dị ụkọ (scarce). Mgbe ị na-etinye ngwaahịa ndị a n'ihe oriri ehi, ọ dị mkpa iji nhata (balance) ọdịnaya ike ha (energy content) na ebe nri ndị ọzọ iji hụ na ezigbo nri ruru eru.

instruction: Kọwaa ụdị nne na nna (parent breeds) nke ehi Keteku
response: Keteku bụ obe kwụsiri ike (stabilized cross) n'etiti ụdị Muturu na Zebu nke ehi. Ngwakọta a na-achọ (crossbreeding) ijikọta àgwà ndị achọrọ (desirable traits) nke ụdị nne na nna (parent breeds) abụọ ahụ iji mepụta nwa (offspring) siri ike (robust) yana na-arụpụta ihe.

instruction: Ụkpụrụ mbata (migration patterns) ehi Rahaji na Nigeria
response: Ụdị ehi Rahaji dị na Nigeria na-agakarị ibugharị n'oge (migrate seasonally), na n'oge udu mmiri (wet season), ha anaghị anwakarị ịga n'ihu ndịda karịa Kaduna (further south than Kaduna). O nwere ike ịbụ n'ihi nnweta ahịhịa maka ịta nri na akụrụngwa mmiri (water resources), nke na-abakarị (more abundant) n'ugwu (north) n'oge a. Ka ọkọchị na-abata, ha nwere ike ịga n'ihu ndịda na-achọ ọnọdụ ịta ahịhịa ka mma (better grazing conditions).

instruction: Gịnị bụ ụdị ehi Kuri (Kuri cattle breed)?
response: Ụdị ehi Kuri bụ ụdị pụrụ iche (unique) ma na-adọrọ mmasị sitere na mpaghara Ọdọ Mmiri Chad (Lake Chad region). Otu n'ime njirimara ya kachasị pụta ìhè bụ nnukwu mpi (enormous, hollow horns) ụmụ anụmanụ a nwere. N'ụzọ na-akpali mmasị, mpi ndị a abụghị naanị maka ihe nkiri; a na-eji ha eme ihe (buoyancy) iji nyere ha aka sere mmiri (swim), na-ekwe ka ehi Kuri na-egwu mmiri ma na-aga n'ime mmiri n'enweghị nsogbu. Mgbanwe a dị ịrịba ama emeela ka ehi Kuri nwee ike ịnọgide na gburugburu mmiri ya (aquatic environment) ma nyekwa aka na nlanarị (survival) na ọganihu ya n'ógbè ahụ.

instruction: Ihe ndị na-esi na nzaghachi Neethling (Neethling response) pụta maka nnabata ndị nwe ehi (cattle owner compliance)
response: Mmeghachi omume ọjọọ nke anụ ahụ nwere ike (adverse skin reactions) imetụta omume onye nwe (owner's attitude) wee bute oge igbu azụ ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi (reticence to vaccinate), nke nwere ike ibelata ịdị irè zuru oke nke mmemme ọgwụ mgbochi (vaccination programs). Nke a na-ewute nke ukwuu n'ebe ndị nwe ehi nwere ike ịdị na-ala azụ iji nweta usoro ọgwụ mgbochi n'ihi ihe dị iche iche, gụnyere ọnụ ahịa, ohere ịnweta nlekọta anụmanụ, ma ọ bụ echiche na-ezighị ezi (misconceptions) gbasara nchekwa ọgwụ mgbochi. N'ihi ya, ọ dị mkpa maka ndị dọkịta anụmanụ na ndị ọrụ mgbasawanye iji gboo nchegbu ma ọ bụ mmeghachi omume ọjọọ ọ bụla ngwa ngwa na ịnye ozi doro anya, nke dabeere na ihe akaebe (evidence-based information) iji meere ndị nwe ehi obi iru ala banyere uru nke ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa (benefits of vaccination) na usoro dị na ebe iji belata ihe egwu (minimize risks).

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'Wuro'?
response: Ngalaba ụlọ (household unit) ma ọ bụ ebe ogige ehi dị (site of the cattle camp).

instruction: Kedu ihe pụrụ iche (distinguishing) ọdịdị mpi (horn morphology) nke ụdị ehi Kuri?
response: A maara ụdị ehi Kuri maka ọdịdị (morphology) mpi ya pụrụ iche, nke e ji nnukwu mpi (very large), nwere nro (bulbous), na ekpere aṅụ (honeycomb-textured). Njirimara pụrụ iche (unique feature) a na-ewepụta Kuri site n'ụdị ndị ọzọ na bụ akụkụ pụtara ìhè (notable aspect) n'ọdịdị (appearance) ya.

instruction: Kedu ụdị ehi bụ 'Azuwarac' dị iche iche achọtara n'ókè ugwu Nigeria (northern borders of Nigeria)?
response: Ehi 'Azuwarac' a na-ahụ na mpaghara ugwu nke Nigeria bụ ụdị dị iche iche (variety) nke ụdị Sokoto Gudali.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ 'isi fụrụ akpụ' (swollen head) n'ime ọkụkọ?
response: Ọtụtụ mgbe Infectious Coryza ma ọ bụ Mycoplasmosis na-akpata isi fụrụ akpụ na ọkụkọ. Ọnọdụ abụọ a nwere ike iduga oké ọzịza na mbufụt (inflammation) n'isi, olu, na ihu, a pụkwara iso ya nwee mgbaàmà ndị ọzọ dị ka mmiri si n'anya na imi na-agbapụta, yana enweghị agụụ n'ozuzu. Ọ bụrụ na ịhụ ọzịza (swelling) ọ bụla pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ mwepu n'ìgwè ọkụkọ gị, ọ dị mkpa ịkpọtụrụ onye ọrụ anụmanụ obodo maka nchoputa ziri ezi (proper diagnosis) na ọgwụgwọ, ebe ọnọdụ ndị a nwere ike ịgbasa ma gbasaa ngwa ngwa ma a gwọghị ya.

instruction: Kedu ụdị nwere njikọ chiri anya (most associated) na ụdị obere (subgroups) Fulani nọ na Mambilla Plateau?
response: Red Bororo, nke a makwaara dị ka Rahaji, bụ ụdị kachasị nwee njikọ na Fulani na Mambilla Plateau. Ụdị a dabara adaba n'ọnọdụ obodo ahụ (local conditions) ma abụwo akụkụ dị mkpa nke ọdịbendị Fulani (Fulani culture) na omume nlekọta anụ ụlọ (livestock management practices) ruo ọgbọ (generations).

instruction: Gịnị bụ ahụkarị uwe agba (typical coat color) nke Sokoto Gudali?
response: Sokoto Gudali bụ nke a maara maka ụcha (coat colors) ya, nke gụnyere ude ụcha otu (uniform cream), isi awọ (light grey), ma ọ bụ dun. Agba ndị a bụ njirimara nke ụdị (characteristic of the breed) ahụ ma nwee ike ịdịgasị iche dabere n'anụmanụ ọ bụla.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara iwere mmiri (water intake) ji dị oke mkpa maka ehi na-eri nri (fed) nkụ oge ọkọchị nwere fiber (high-fibre dry-season diets)?
response: Mmiri dị mkpa (absolutely essential) maka ehi na-eri nri na-acha nkụ oge ọkọchị (high-fibre dry-season diets) n'ihi na ọ na-arụ ọrụ dị mkpa (crucial role) na nhazi ịgbaze (microbial fermentation process) nje nke na-eme na usoro nri (digestive system) ha. N'ime usoro a, ụmụ irighiri ihe (microbes) na-emebi fiber dị na nri ha, na-ewepụta nri ehi ahụ nwere ike ịmịcha (absorb). Ọ bụrụ na ehi enweghị mmiri (not enough water) zuru oke, usoro a nwere ike imebi n'ụzọ siri ike, na-eduga ná nsogbu nsị na nwere ike ọbụna ịkpata mkpuchi nke omasum na abomasum - akụkụ abụọ dị oke mkpa nke afọ ha na-ahụ maka ịmịkọrọ (absorbing) nri na mmiri. Iji gbochie nsogbu ndị a, ọ dị mkpa ijide n'aka na ehi nwere ohere (access to plenty of clean, fresh water) ịnweta nnukwu mmiri dị ọcha na nke dị ọhụrụ mgbe niile, ọkachasị n'oge ọkọchị mgbe iwere fiber (fibre intake) dị elu.

instruction: Kedu ọnọdụ ihu igwe (climate condition) nke Rahaji nwere ike idowe onwe ya?
response: Rahaji na-adaba adaba (well-suited) n'ọnọdụ ihu igwe akọrọ na ọkara nkụ (arid and semi-arid climate conditions), na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ezigbo nhọrọ maka ndị ọrụ ugbo nọ na mpaghara akọrọ (dry regions) nke Nigeria. Ike ya na ike ya itolite (thrive) n'ebe ndị nwere oke mmiri ozuzo (limited rainfall) na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ụdị (popular breed) a ma ama na ndị na-azụ anụ ụlọ n'ime ebe ndị a.

instruction: Nkezi afọ mmalite ịmụ nwa mbụ (Average age at first calving) maka ehi Bunaji na ìgwè ehi (pastoral herds)
response: Maka ehi Bunaji n'ime ìgwè ịta ahịhịa, nkezi afọ na-amụ nwa mbụ dị gburugburu afọ 4.75. Nke a bụ nwata dị obere ma e jiri ya tụnyere ụfọdụ ụdị ndị ọzọ, ọ bụkwa n'ihi n'akụkụ ụfọdụ n'ihi na a maara ehi Bunaji maka oke ọmụmụ ha na ikike ime mgbanwe maka ụdị ịta nri dị iche iche. Agbanyeghị, ọ dị mma ịmara na ehi n'otu n'otu nwere ike ịdị iche, na ihe ndị dị ka nri na-edozi ahụ, ahụike, na mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa nwere ike imetụta afọ nke ehi bu ụzọ amụ nwa. N'ikwu okwu n'ozuzu, agbanyeghị, afọ 4.75 bụ akara dị mma maka ihe ị ga-atụ anya ya n'aka ehi Bunaji n'ìgwè ehi.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ ewu 'Kano Brown' na 'Bornu White'?
response: Kano Brown na Bornu White ewu bụ ụdị agba mpaghara (regional color variants), ma ọ bụ ụdị, nke Red Sokoto (Maradi) ewu. A maara ụdị a maka ịdị ike ya na mmegharị ya (adaptability), na-eme ka ọ dabara nke ọma n'ọnọdụ gburugburu ebe obibi dị iche iche na Nigeria.

instruction: Gịnị bụ nzube nke 'ndabere' (backgrounding) na ntọala feedlot (feedlot setting)?
response: Ndabere (Backgrounding) bụ nzọụkwụ dị mkpa n'ịkwadebe ụmụ ehi maka feedlot site n'ịgbanwe rumen ha iji tinye uche (concentrates) na ịhụ na ha dị mma ma gbaa ọgwụ mgbochi. Usoro a na-enyere aka ịgbanwe (transition) ụmụ ehi ahụ pụọ n'ihe oriri nke ahịhịa gaa na nke dị elu na nri mgbakwunye (concentrates), nke kachasị mma maka ọnọdụ ebe a na-enye nri ehi (feedlot). N'ime nke a, ịnwere ike ibelata ohere nke nsogbu nsị na nsogbu ahụike ndị ọzọ nwere ike ibilite mgbe ewepụtara ụmụ ehi na mberede na nri nwere mgbakwunye dị ukwuu. Backgrounding na-enyekwa ohere iji gbaa ụmụ ehi ọgwụ mgbochi (vaccinate) ma lebara nsogbu ahụike ọ bụla enwere ike tupu ha abanye na feedlot, nke nwere ike inye aka belata ohere nke ọrịa na imeziwanye arụmọrụ (overall performance) n'ozuzu ya.

instruction: Kedu njirimara na-eme ka ọdịiche dị na Adamawa Gudali na Bunaji?
response: Akpụ (hump) kwụ n'efu bụ ihe kachasị dị iche nke na-esetịpụ Adamawa Gudali na Bunaji. Akpụ (hump) a bụ njirimara anụ ahụ pụrụ iche (notable physical trait) nke ụdị Adamawa Gudali, na-eme ka ọ dị mfe ịmata ya na ịmata ọdịiche dị na ụdị ndị ọzọ dị ka Bunaji.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ ụdị ehi Wadara (Wadara cattle breed)?
response: Ụdị ehi Wadara bụ ụdị zebu a na-ahụ na mgbago ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ (northeastern) Nigeria, ebe ndị obodo Shuwa Arab na Kanuri na-achị ya.

instruction: Hazie (Rank) ụdị ehi anọ dị na Nigeria site n'ọnụọgụ atụmanya nke ọnụ ọgụgụ anụmanụ (estimated population size) n'ime Nigeria
response: Ụdị White Fulani nwere atụmanya ọnụ ọgụgụ (estimated population) kachasị ukwuu na Nigeria, na-esote Sokoto Gudali, mgbe ahụ Red Bororo, na n'ikpeazụ Adamawa Gudali, nke nwere obere ọnụ ọgụgụ.

instruction: Kedu ụdị (breed) a na-ewu ewu maka ikike ya ime nke ọma n'ọnọdụ ebe nwere mmiri na ala (semi-aquatic conditions)?
response: A maara ụdị Kuri maka ike ya dị ịrịba ama itolite n'ọnọdụ obere mmiri (semi-aquatic conditions). N'ịbụ onye sitere na mpaghara Niger Delta, ụdị a siri ike dabara adaba na mpaghara mmiri jupụtara na ya, ma nwee ike inye nri na mmiri na n'elu ala. Njirimara ya pụrụ iche (unique characteristics) na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nhọrọ magburu onwe ya maka ndị ọrụ ugbo nọ n'ebe ahịhịa ịta nri nwere oke ma ọ bụ ebe mmiri dị ngwa ngwa.

instruction: Gịnị bụ njirimara anụ ahụ bụ isi nke mpi Sokoto Gudali (Sokoto Gudali horns)?
response: Sokoto Gudali bụ ụdị ehi a maara maka njirimara ya (distinctive characteristics), na otu njirimara anụ ahụ bụ isi nke mpi Sokoto Gudali bụ na ha fọrọ nke nta ka ha ghara ịdị, na ọtụtụ ndị ehi a kapịrị ọnụ enweghị mpi (polled) ma ọ bụ na-enwe mpi dị obere na enweghị ntoputa.

instruction: Gịnị bụ njirimara ụcha (coat colour) nke ụdị Red Bororo (Rahaji)?
response: Ụdị Red Bororo (Rahaji) ka ejiri ụcha na-acha uhie uhie gaa na mahogany (deep red to mahogany), nke bụ otu n'ime ihe dị iche na ya.

instruction: Ịchọpụta ụdị ehi (cattle breed) Nigeria
response: Ụdị (breed) ị na-ajụ maka ya bụ Red Bororo, nke a makwaara dị ka Rahaji. A na-amata ya site na njirimara ya pụrụ iche (distinctive features), gụnyere ntị na-agbada na mpi ogologo, gbara ọkpụrụkpụ (long, thick horns). Red Bororo bụ ụdị ewu ewu na nke a ma ama na Nigeria, na-enweta ihe nrite maka isi ike ya (hardiness) yana ngbanwe (adaptability) maka ọnọdụ obodo.

instruction: Gịnị kpatara eji ahụ ọnyá ngụgụ (lung lesions) n'ihe karịrị pasentị iri anọ (40%) nke ehi na feedlots South Africa (South African feedlots) n'agbanyeghị na agwọbeghị ya maka BRD?
response: A na-ejikọtakarị ọnyá (lesions) ngụgụ nke ehi nọ n'ụlọ nri South Africa (South African feedlots) na subclinical ma ọ bụ ikpe a na-atụfughị ​​nke Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD). Nnyocha e mere egosiwo na a gwọbeghị ọnụ ọgụgụ dị ukwuu nke ehi nwere ọnyá ngụgụ, na-egosi na ọtụtụ ikpe BRD na-adịghị achọpụta ma ọ bụ na-adịchaghị njọ iji kwado ọgwụgwọ. Nke a na-eme ka ọ pụta ìhè mkpa ọ dị inyocha (monitoring) ahụike ehi nke ọma, ọkachasị n'ebe a na-eri nri (feedlots) nwere oke ehi dị ukwuu ebe ihe ize ndụ (risk) nke nnyefe ọrịa dị elu. Nnyocha ndị dọkịta anụmanụ oge niile (Regular veterinary check-ups) na ntinye n'ọrụ usoro mgbochi ọrịa (disease prevention strategies) nwere ike inye aka belata ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ọnyá ngụgụ (lung lesions) na imeziwanye ahụike ehi (cattle health) n'ozuzu ya.

instruction: Kedu steeti abụọ na Nigeria ka amara na akụkọ n'akụkụ Kaduna dị ka steeti atọ kacha mkpa na-emepụta ehi (ruminant-producing states)?
response: Steeti Kano na Sokoto (Kano and Sokoto states) bụ ndị a kwetara na akụkọ ihe mere eme n'akụkụ Kaduna dị ka steeti atọ kacha mkpa na-emepụta ehi (ruminant-producing) na Nigeria. A mara steeti ndị a ogologo oge maka ọnụ ọgụgụ ehi (significant cattle populations) ha dị ịrịba ama yana onyinye ha na ụlọ ọrụ anụ ụlọ nke mba ahụ (livestock industry).

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ ọdịdị pụrụ iche nke mpi White Fulani (White Fulani horns)?
response: White Fulani, bụ ụdị a na-ewu ewu na Nigeria, a maara maka nnukwu mpi ya, nke na-enwekarị ọdịdị lyre (lyre-shaped), na-atụgharị gaa n'èzí wee banye n'ime na arc pụrụ iche (distinctive arc). Ụdị pụrụ iche (unique shape) a bụ otu n'ime njirimara (most recognizable characteristics) kachasị ewu ewu ma bụrụkwa ihe na-egosi akụkọ ihe mere eme (rich history) na ihe nketa (heritage) ya.

instruction: Kedu ụdị Nigeria (Nigerian breed) ka a na-ekwukarị na ọ nwere udo karị ma dị mfe ijikwa maka ọrụ ụgbọ njem (draught work)?
response: Sokoto Gudali ka a na-ekwukarị na ọ na-enwekwu udo na ọ dị mfe ijikwa maka ọrụ ebu anụ (draught work). A na-akpọ ụdị Nigeria a maka ụdị (calm temperament) udo ya, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nhọrọ a ma ama maka ndị ọrụ ugbo chọrọ anụmanụ a pụrụ ịdabere na ya yana dị nwayọ (gentle work animal). Ụdị udo ya na-emekwa ka ọ dị mfe ijikwa (handle) na ịzụ (train), nke dị mkpa maka ọrụ ndị chọrọ ngagharị na njikwa nke ọma (careful maneuvering and control).

instruction: Kedu ụdị ehi enweghị mkpụkọ (no hump), azụ kwụ ọtọ (straight back), na isi obosara (broad head)?
response: A maara ụdị Muturu maka njirimara ya (distinctive characteristics), gụnyere azụ kwụ ọtọ (straight back) na isi sara mbara (broad head). Ọ bụ ezigbo nhọrọ (popular choice) nye ndị ọrụ ugbo na Nigeria n'ihi ike na ngbanwe ya (hardiness and adaptability) maka ọnọdụ mpaghara ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-achọ ụdị na-adaba na nkọwa gị, Muturu bụ ezigbo nhọrọ ịtụle.

instruction: Idebe oge ịmụ nwa dị ụbọchị 365 (365-day calving interval) n'ịzụ ehi na Nigeria (Nigerian cattle farming)
response: Iji nọgide na-enwe oge ịmụ nwa (calving interval) nke ụbọchị 365, ehi aghaghị ịmaliteghachi azụ (re-breed) n'ime oge a kapịrị ọnụ (specific timeframe) mgbe ọ mụsịrị nwa. Oge ọmụmụ ọmụmụ a na-atụ aro (recommended breeding interval) dị n'etiti ụbọchị 80 ruo 85 post-calving (mgbe amuchara nwa). Nke a na-enye ohere maka oge ime ụbọchị 365 (365-day gestation period), na-eme ka ọ bụrụ oge ịmụ nwa na-agbanwe agbanwe. Ọ dị mkpa inyocha ahụike ọmụmụ (reproductive health) ehi ma gbanwee usoro ọmụmụ (breeding schedule) n'ụzọ ga-eme ka ị nweta nsonaazụ kacha mma (optimal results).

instruction: Olee ebe ụdị ehi Azawak (Azawak breed) si bụrụ obodo (native) ya?
response: Ụdị Azawak sitere na ndagwurugwu Azawak (Azawak valley), nke dị na mpaghara ugwu ọdịda anyanwụ (north-west) nke Nigeria.

instruction: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ehi (number of cows) a tụrụ aro maka oke ehi (mature bull) tozuru oke n'ịkwa n'ụzọ okike (natural mating)
response: Na okike eke (natural mating), oke ehi yetoro okenye na-enwekarị ike ijere ma ọ dịkarịa ala ehi 20, mana ọnụ ọgụgụ a nwere ike ịdị iche dabere na ihe ndị dị ka ụdị nke ehi na ọdịmma (quality) nke ịta ahịhịa. N'ikwu okwu n'ozuzu, ehi nwere nkezi (good fertility) ọmụmụ dị mma na ume (vigor) nwere ike ijikwa nnukwu ìgwè, ma ọ dị mkpa inyocha ahụike (monitor the bull's health) ehi na ọdịmma (well-being) nke ehi iji hụ na oge ịmụ nwa na-aga nke ọma (successful breeding season).

instruction: Ịmata ụdị ehi dị na Nigeria
response: Ụdị ehi Nigeria a na-akpọ maka mpi (lyre-shaped) nke dị ka ngwá egwú lyre (outward-curving horns) na-ehulata n'èzí bụ White Fulani, nke a na-akpọkwa Bunaji. A na-akwụghachi ụdị ehi a ugwo maka ọdịdị mpi ya (impressive horn shape) a na-eji ya eme ihe na mmemme ịgafe obe (crossbreeding programs) iji kwalite (improve) mpi nke ụdị ehi Nigeria ndị ọzọ.

instruction: Mata ụdị ehi West African dwarf short-horn (ụdị obere na mpi nkenke)
response: Ụdị (breed) ị na-achọ bụ Muturu, ezigbo nhọrọ na nhọrọ siri ike (hardy choice) maka ndị na-arụ ọrụ obere (small-scale farmers) na Nigeria na akụkụ ndị ọzọ nke West Africa. A maara maka obere nha (compact size) ha na iwu siri ike (robust constitution), Muturu ewu dabara adaba n'ọnọdụ ihu igwe (climate) ma nwee ike itolite (thrive) n'ọtụtụ ebe nri, gụnyere nchọgharị (browse) na ihe ọkụkụ hapụrụ (crop residues). Ha dịkwa nfe ijikwa ma nwee ike ịbụ ezigbo nhọrọ (good option) maka ndị ọhụrụ n'ọrụ ubi ewu (goat farming).

instruction: Kedu ọrụ 'Sarkin Pawa' na agbụ nri (cattle value chain) ehi na Nigeria?
response: Sarkin Pawa bụ onye isi ma ọ bụ onye ndu (leader) nke òtù ndị na-egbu anụ (butchers' guild), na-arụ ọrụ dị mkpa n'ime agbụ uru (value chain) ehi Nigeria. Ha na-ahụ maka (oversee) ihe omume nke ndị na-egbu anụ (butchers) na ndị na-azụ ahịa anụ (meat traders), na-ahụ na a na-ejikwa ehi na nhazi nke ọma n'enweghị nsogbu na mmetụta mmadụ (safely and humanely). Ọkwá a (position) dị oké mkpa iji nọgide na-enwe àgwà na iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe (quality and integrity) nke inye anụ (meat supply), yana na mmanye iwu (enforcing regulations) na ụkpụrụ n'ime ụlọ ọrụ ahụ (standards within the industry). Sarkin Pawa na-eje ozi mgbe mgbe dị ka onye na-ekpezi n'etiti (mediator) ndị na-egbu anụ na ndị na-azụ ehi, na-akwado azụmahịa (facilitating transactions) na idozi esemokwu (resolving disputes). N'ime nke a, ha na-enye aka na nrụpụta (efficiency) zuru oke yana nkwado (sustainability) nke agbụ ehi (cattle value chain) na Nigeria.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ isi oke nri (nutritional limitation) maka ehi dị na Nigerian Savanna n'oge ọkọchị?
response: N'oge ọkọchị (dry season) dị na Nigerian Savanna, nnukwu nsogbu nri maka ehi bụ obere protein (crude protein) na nnukwu fiber (fibre content) n'ahịhịa kpọrọ nkụ (standing hay), nke na-abụkarị ahịhịa a na-ata ata. Nke a adabaghị (imbalance) nwere ike iduga mbelata n'ịgba nri (reduced feed intake) yana ahụike n'ozuzu ya metụtara na ehi. Ọ dị mkpa iji nri ndị na-emepụta protein (high-quality protein sources) dị mma dị ka achịcha mkpụrụ ogho (cottonseed cake) ma ọ bụ nri soybean (soybean meal) mee nri ha, iji hụ na ha nwetara nri (necessary nutrients) dị mkpa iji nọgide na-enwe ahụike na arụmọrụ ka mma (optimal health and productivity).

instruction: Kedu agba na-ahụkarị maka ehi Wadara (Wadara cattle)?
response: A maara ehi Wadara ka ọ na-abịa na agba dị iche iche (variety of colors), gụnyere ọbara ọbara gbara ọchịchịrị (dark-red), oji (black), nwere agba abụọ (pied), ma ọ bụ aja aja (brown). Agba ndị a nwere ike ịdịgasị iche n'ofe ụmụ anụmanụ dị iche iche, mana anọ ndị a bụ ndị a na-ahụkarị jikọtara na ụdị a.

instruction: Olee ebe a na-achọtakarị ọtụtụ ehi na Nigeria?
response: Ihe ka ọtụtụ n'ehi (majority of cattle) na Nigeria dị na mgbago ugwu (northern parts) nke mba ahụ, ebe ihu igwe (climate) na ọdịdị ala (geography) dị mma maka nnukwu ọrụ ehi (large-scale cattle farming). Mpaghara a gụnyere steeti dịka Kano, Kaduna, na Sokoto, ebe ịzụ ehi (cattle herding) bụbu ọdịnala (tradition) ogologo oge yana isi mbata (source of livelihood) dị ịrịba ama maka ọtụtụ obodo.

instruction: Gịnị bụ nkezi (average height) ogo ehi White Fulani?
response: Nkezi dị elu nke ehi White Fulani (White Fulani cow) dị ihe dị ka 130 cm. A maara ụdị a maka ọdịdị (impressive stature) ya na-akpali mmasị na ọdịdị siri ike (robust build), na-eme ka ọ daba adaba maka mmiri ara ehi (dairy) na mmepụta anụ (beef production) ehi na Nigeria.

instruction: Kedu nri na-ezukarị maka ehi ebe ịta ahịhịa (pastoral cattle) na mbubreyo mmiri na ọkọchị?
response: Maka ehi ebe ịta ahịhịa na ngwụcha mmiri ozuzo na oge ọkọchị, ike (energy) na mineral (minerals) na-ezukarị. Nke a bụ n'ihi na ahịhịa ndụ (lush grasses) na ebe nri anụ (forages) dịnụ n'oge ndị a jupụtara na nri ndị a dị mkpa (essential nutrients). Otú ọ dị, ọ bara uru ịmara na ịdị mma na oke ihe oriri ndị a nwere ike ịdị iche iche dabere na ọnọdụ a kapịrị ọnụ na mpaghara gị, n'ihi ya, ọ bụ ezigbo echiche oge niile (good idea) iji nyochaa (monitor) ahụike ehi gị wee dozie (adjust) nri ha ka o siri dị.

instruction: Kpakpando n'ime ehi (Stargazing in cattle) bụ nke ejikọtara kpochapụwo na ọnọdụ metabolic ma ọ bụ nje (metabolic or infectious condition)?
response: Stargazing na ehi bụ akara (classic sign) ngosi kpochapụla nke Polioencephalomalacia ma ọ bụ ọrịa Heartwater, ọkachasị ụdị ụbụrụ ya (cerebral form). Ọnọdụ abụọ a nwere ike ibute ihe mgbaàmà n'ụbụrụ (neurological symptoms), gụnyere ọdịdị 'stargazing' ebe anya ehi na-edozi (fixed) n'otu ebe, na-esonyerekarị ihe ịrịba ama ndị ọzọ dị ka enweghị nhazi (loss of coordination), ịma jijiji (tremors), na ike ilo (difficulty swallowing). Ọrịa Heartwater na-ebute (caused by) nje bacteria Ehrlichia ruminantium, nke e bufere site na akọrọ (ticks), ebe Polioencephalomalacia jikọtara ya na ụkọ thiamine (thiamine deficiency), karịsịa na ehi nwere mkpụrụ ọka nwere oke iru mmiri (high-moisture grains) ma ọ bụ silages (ihe ọkụkụ ndụ a kụrụ maka nri anụ). Ọ bụrụ na ị na-enyo ọnọdụ ọ bụla n'ime ìgwè gị enyo, ọ dị mkpa ịgakwuru dọkịta anụmanụ (consult a veterinarian) maka nyocha na ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ekwesị (proper diagnosis and treatment).

instruction: Olee ebe etiti njupụta (nucleus) ọnụ ọgụgụ ehi Kuri (Kuri cattle population) dị?
response: Etiti (nucleus) njupụta ọnụ ọgụgụ ehi Kuri (Kuri cattle population) dị na mpaghara ebe mbụ (former) Ọdọ Mmiri Chad, nke gbasara ọtụtụ mba (several countries) na West Africa, gụnyere Nigeria, Chad, na Cameroon. Mpaghara a abụwo ebe obibi ọdịnala (traditional habitat) nke ụdị ehi Kuri (Kuri cattle breed) ruo ọtụtụ narị afọ (centuries), na ebe ị ga-ahụta oke anụmanụ (largest concentration) ndị a pụrụ iche (unique) na ndị siri ike (hardy animals).

instruction: Kedu oge ndụ na-arụpụta ihe (productive life range) maka ehi na Nigeria dịka Mbap (1996) si kwuo?
response: Nlekọta ndụ na-arụpụta ihe (productive life range) maka ehi na Nigeria, dị ka Mbap (1996) siri kwuo, na-adịkarị n'etiti afọ 9 na 14. Oge a nwere ike ịdịgasị iche dabere na ihe ndị dị ka ụdị, nri na-edozi ahụ, yana njikwa ahụike n'ozuzu (overall health management), mana 9 ruo 14 bụ oge a na-ehota (commonly cited range) ugboro ugboro maka ehi na Nigeria.

instruction: Gịnị bụ obe etiti (cross between) nke ụdị ehi 'Biu'?
response: Ụdị ehi Biu bụ obe n'etiti Zebu na Savannah Muturu. Ịgafe nke a pụrụ iche (unique crossbreeding) bu n'obi (aims to combine) ijikọta àgwà ndị a na-achọsi ike (desirable traits) nke ma ụdị nne na nna (parent breeds), dị ka ịnagide okpomọkụ (heat tolerance) na ịrụpụta mmiri ara ehi dị elu (high milk production), iji mepụta ehi na-arụpụta ihe ma na-amị mkpụrụ nke dabara (suitable) adaba maka ọnọdụ ọrụ ubi Nigeria.

instruction: Kedu ihe bụ ịgafe ehi (cattle crossbreed) nke Keteku?
response: Ehi Keteku gbasaa (Keteku cattle crossbreed) bụ njikọ kwụsiri ike n'etiti ụdị Muturu na Bunaji/Zebu (Muturu and Bunaji/Zebu breeds). Ngwakọta (combination) a na-ejikọta njirimara na-achọsi ike nke trypano-tolerance site na ụdị Muturu yana ahụ (body size) ka ukwuu nke Bunaji/Zebu. Ebumnuche ịzụ (crossbreed) ibe a bụ imepụta ehi na-arụpụta ihe nke kwesịrị ekwesị (suitable) maka ọnọdụ ọrụ ubi (farming conditions) dị iche iche.

instruction: Chọpụta mpaghara akọwapụtara (specific zone) na Nigeria ebe ehi White Fulani (Bunaji) na-anọghị nke ọma
response: Ndị ọcha (White Fulani), nke a makwaara dị ka Bunaji, bụ ụdị ewu ewu (popular breed) na Nigeria, mana ha na-anọghị nke ukwuu (significantly absent) na mpaghara ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ (South east region). Nke a bụ n'ihi njirimara ala na ihu igwe (geography and climate) nke mpaghara ahụ, nke na-adịghị mma maka mkpa nke ụdị (breed's needs). A na-ahụkarị Bunaji n'ime savannas na ala ahịhịa (grasslands) nke ugwu Nigeria, ebe ha na-eme nke ọma na okpomọkụ na ọnọdụ ọkọchị (hot and dry conditions).
